Comments (English): [ MY TALE OF WOE ] || ---------------- || Includes installation-sorta true. Installation is defined as a two step process. One, the dishwasher is delivered and the representative examines the proposed installation site, and tells you if it meets their criteria. The hole where the old dishwasher had been did not. Problems to be corrected before actual installation arrives: 1, foot long copper water supply to old washer had to be cut flush to back wall and capped. 2, current code says power to the dishwasher has to be able to be turned on/off with an accessible switch, so the dual 110V outlet on the back wall of the dishwasher hole could not be used. First thought was the dual outlet under the sink. Quickly rejected as I realized I would have to run the garbage disposal to power the dishwasher. To use the outlet behind the dishwasher, I had to find an outlet strip with a right angle flat plug that has a switch, not that easy. Then it had to be mounted under the sink. 3, the single connection outlet hot water valve for the sink has to be replaced with a dual so the dishwasher would have a connection. 4, an air gap valve (not included in the installation kit) has to be bought and provided, luckily the sink already had an available 1.5 inch hole for the air gap where the soap dispenser was and didn't to have one drilled through the ceramic or the whole sink replaced. The message to delay the installation team's arrival got lost and they showed up before all of the above was finished. Their was both a positive and negative side to the premature arrival, this team noticed that the garbage disposal didn't have a connection for the dishwasher and a new garbage disposal had to be purchased. The team offered, that for an additional $250.00, they could take care of a couple of the above items when they returned.Then, while working under the sinks, the P-trap for the regular sink was bumped and started leaking. It turned out that all of the drain pipes for that sink had to be replaced which included the chromed right angle piece that goes into the 2 inch galvanized pipe and was solidly rusted in place! What a nightmare that was.Finally, everything was done, the dishwasher installed, and it pretty quietly, works great!

The house is overall gray and white, so I bought it to add a point with charcoal color, but the color was out of stock, so it was initially canceled. I couldn't wait any longer, so I ordered Kota White. Since there were many twists and turns from the pre-installation visit (the interior design company didn't make a place for the dishwasher in the kitchen furniture and just hastily put it together), I wondered if it would be installed. I was more worried than excited, but the pre-installation technician who came again provided thorough and kind service. _ The interior design company did it roughly, so they added wood boards to the floor, but since the dishwasher uses steam and water, there was a risk of the wood boards corroding, so they cut out the wood floor and needed to reinforce the step, but if they did it themselves, it would cost an additional fee (50,000 won), and they felt sorry for that part, so they told me to ask the interior design company to do it because the additional fee was expensive, but I thought that would delay the timing again, so I just paid the additional construction fee and asked them to do it. But, they raised two for the price of one (because the level was too low and I thought the height wouldn't match), and they even did a film repair job in case both sides would corrode^^_ They did the installation as an extra, and the installers installed it perfectly and explained everything in detail without leaving anything out. Since I'm a dishwasher beginner, there were many things I didn't know and was curious about, but they explained everything in detail one by one with a bright expression without showing any annoyance^^. I think this is why I use Samsung appliances. How can each and every one of the installers be so kind;;; I'm really so grateful. After installing it, the color was a bit gray. I even thought it went better than charcoal. . I'll soon be freed from the hell of washing dishes, right? I'll be able to experience a new world where I can leave my aunt behind and spend more time with my kids;;. Everyone worked really hard!

Sentence (English): It cleans well, is VERY quiet, and holds lots of dishes.
Comments (English): [ Nice dishwasher overall ] || ---------------- || It cleans well, is VERY quiet, and holds lots of dishes. My have three wishes for it, though. One is that you could do a delay start FROM the dishwasher and not just the app. I don't always have my phone with me when I'm loading the dishwasher and we pay higher rates for electricity at certain times of day, so I prefer it to run overnight. Also, it doesn't have a lock on the door, and it's hard to tell when it's on because it is so quiet and the buttons are on the top of the door and cannot be seen once the door is closed. The red light at the bottom helps, but also doesn't tell me how long it still has to run, which means I HAVE to use the app for those features. Lastly, the way the door is constructed, there are two pieces of metal at the top of the door near the handle and one of them is rather sharp (it's kind of the side of the piece of metal). My husband opens the door with the back of his hand nearest the dishwasher and it cut him a couple of times. I open it with my palm towards the dishwasher and have been fine. Overall, it does a great job cleaning everything, and everything gets dry--even on the eco setting! The picture I attached shows where the two pieces of metal join. It is the piece on the top, lying flat, that is a little sharp.

One is that you could do a delay start FROM the dishwasher and not just the app. I don't always have my phone with me when I'm loading the dishwasher and we pay higher rates for electricity at certain times of day, so I prefer it to run overnight. Also, it doesn't have a lock on the door, and it's hard to tell when it's on because it is so quiet and the buttons are on the top of the door and cannot be seen once the door is closed. The red light at the bottom helps, but also doesn't tell me how long it still has to run, which means I HAVE to use the app for those features. Lastly, the way the door is constructed, there are two pieces of metal at the top of the door near the handle and one of them is rather sharp (it's kind of the side of the piece of metal). My husband opens the door with the back of his hand nearest the dishwasher and it cut him a couple of times. I open it with my palm towards the dishwasher and have been fine. Overall, it does a great job cleaning everything, and everything gets dry--even on the eco setting! The picture I attached shows where the two pieces of metal join. It is the piece on the top, lying flat, that is a little sharp.

Sentence (English): I thought long and hard about choosing a dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ BOSCH built-in dishwasher with "projector" ] || ---------------- || I thought long and hard about choosing a dishwasher. Most of the equipment we bought for our new home came from a Korean manufacturer, but we decided to buy a dishwasher "from Germany". The choice of this model was dictated by the gimmick of a "projector" that displays the time on the floor. Apart from that, it has everything you need, many programs and functions. It is economical, quiet, washes thoroughly and although I have only been using it for a few days, I am satisfied. I hope it serves you without failure for many years.

Wybór tego modelu podyktowany był bajerem w postaci 'projektora' wyświetlającego czas na podłodze. Poza tym ma wszystko co potrzebne, wiele programów i funkcji. Jest oszczędna, cicha, myje dokładnie i choć używam jej dopiero kilka dni jestem zadowolony. Oby służyła bezawaryjnie długie lata.

Sentence (English): I have no complaints about the product itself.
Comments (English): [ Poor Delivery/Installation Negates Purchase ] || ---------------- || I have no complaints about the product itself. Delivery fiasco made it impossible to even try this dishwasher out. Despite reading reviews about poor delivery and installation service of Costco appliances, I thought maybe I'd have a better experience. I was wrong. My delivery was scheduled for a Saturday about three days after my purchase. The time frame for delivery was 1:00 p.m. to 5:00 p.m. At about 2:00 p.m. I happened to be checking my emails and saw an email from the delivery/installment company stating that I had miss my delivery and needed to reschedule. I called them and was told that the delivery driver had been at my house at 12:20 p.m., could not get hold of me, waited an hour, and then left. I told the person on the phone that this was not true. No one had been at my house at 12:20 or at any time. No one had rung the doorbell, and my phone showed no calls made to me by the driver at that time or at any time that day. I received an apology, but still had to reschedule for a week later. The following week, the driver/installer did actually arrive. However, he said that he could not get my old dishwasher out without damaging my cabinetry and he would not be able to get the new one in without having my cabinet modified. I was told to again reschedule after modifying my cabinet. I took him at his word. Subsequently, however, doing my research and consulting with other installers, I discovered that what he said was not true. I then returned my dishwasher purchased at Costco ( a 24 inch) and purchased another dishwasher (also a 24 inch) elsewhere. I then had my old dishwasher removed and the new one installed with no modification of my cabinetry, no damage to my cabinetry and no problem whatsoever. I am a big Costco fan, an Executive Member, and I do a lot of shopping at Costco. I really do love Costco for its pricing and its wonderful refund policy and customer service. Costco should know, however, that the third party installers it hires for appliance delivery and installation are doing it no favors. Sorry, Costco. You lost a sale on this one.

Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. # The interior is so spacious and it washes the dishes very well^^ # Product name: My Dear Dishwasher 12-person, Ivory, MDWEF1233G(A)-KR. # Reason for purchase. I have been using a 6-person product from another company for 8 years. As a family of 4, 6-person was not enough to handle the dishes. However, this time, I purchased the My Dear Dishwasher 12-person My Dear Dishwasher, Ivory, MDWEF1233G product as a Coupang Experience Group product. # Purchase review. First, after ordering, I called the technician on the morning of the delivery date, received the product on the same day, and had another technician visit the next day to thoroughly install it. Since it was our first time using a 12-person built-in, we installed it in the space where the gas range, 3-drawer cabinet, and sink were removed, and it fit perfectly and was installed beautifully. It was installed without additional installation costs. After installation, I just added detergent and ran a test run and used it right after dinner. Previously, when using for 6 people, I used to put in frying pans, large plates, and pots by hand and then used rice bowls, soup bowls, small bowls, and chopsticks. The interior of the My Dear 12-person dishwasher is wider than I thought, so it can hold a large amount of dishes. First, I used it after washing the dishes with only water and then using half the detergent, and the dishes were washed very cleanly.^^ And the My Dear 12-person dishwasher can wash a lot of dishes at once even in homes with large families or guests, saving time and effort. High-temperature washing and various washing modes thoroughly wash away grease and stains. It also has a high energy efficiency rating, so you can save on electricity bills, and it is good for the environment because it uses less water than regular dishwashing. It is easy to operate with a digital display and touch panel, and you can choose from a variety of washing programs, so it is convenient to use. And it has a function that dries the dishes quickly after washing, so you can use them right after washing. The ivory color and sophisticated design go well with the kitchen interior. The Mydia dishwasher is a must-have item for large families or busy daily lives to save time and manage dishes efficiently. ^^ # Mydia dishwasher product description. 1. Sensational and modern design: Compact design that allows for efficient space design. 2. 9 washing courses for the beginning of delicate washing: Hygienic management with powerful three-dimensional and high-temperature washing. - Luxurious, intuitive control panel (intuitive panel design) - Various washing courses (customized washing such as automatic, strong, night, and deep washing) - 75C high-temperature washing (mode suitable for highly soiled dishes) 3. Powerful washing without gaps up and down Powerful dual washing nozzles on the upper and lower sides - Overwhelming cleaning power with three-dimensional water streams coming from various angles. 4. Customized washing according to the degree of contamination - Cleaner with high-temperature water washing - Effective washing of grease and hardened food, etc. 5. Large-capacity design for 12 people that can be washed at once - Ample space to wash various dishes such as pots - Upper tray whose position can be adjusted with customized height adjustment 6. Efficient space utilization - 3-tier basket design - Efficient separate washing according to the size of the dishwasher and plate 7. Air drying and automatic door opening - Fast and powerful drying system - In addition to removing moisture and odors through air fan operation and automatic door opening, it has a lock function, an additional dishwashing function, and various other functions. #This product is a review written after receiving it from Coupang Experience. #If my product review was of any help to you, please let me know.
Comments (Original): 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료 제공받아 작성한 리뷰입니다.  # 내부가 넓어서 너무 좋고 그릇세척이 아주 잘 돼요^^ #제품명: 마이디어 식기세척기 12인용, 아이보리, MDWEF1233G(A)-KR. #구매동기. 타사제품 6인용을 8년째 사용했어요. 4인 가족으로 6인용으론 설겆이 감당이 안되더라구요. 그런데 이번에  마이디어 식기세척기 12인용 마이디어  식기세척기, 아이보리, MDWEF1233G제품을 쿠팡체험제 품으로 구매하게 되었습니다. #구매후기. 우선 주문후 배송 지정일 오전에 기사님 전화 통화후 당일 제품배송 받고 다음날 다른분 기사님 방문으로 꼼꼼하게 설치 받았습니다. 저흰 12인용 빌트인이 처음이라 가스레인지 3단 서랍 장 싱크대를 빼낸자리에 설치하였는데 딱 맞고 예쁘게 설치가 되었습니다. 설치비 추가금없이 설치 하였습니다. 설치후 세제만 넣은후 시운전을 해보고 바로 저녁식사후 바로 사용하였습니다. 이전에 6인용 사용시 후라이펜이나 큰접시 냄비등은 손설겆이후 밥공기 국그릇과 작은 공기, 수저젖가락  정도 넣고 사용 하였습니다. 마이디어 식기세척기 12인용 내부가 생각보다 더 더 넓어 대용량으로 그릇이 들어가요. 4인가족 식사후 나오는 그릇 원만해서 다들어가서 너무 편리해요. 전 동선도 계수대와 가까이 설치해 애벌설겆이후 바로  넣어 사용할수 있어 정리하는 시간이 10분 안에 주방정리가  되어저녁시간이 많이 남게되어 너무 좋습니다. 우선 저는 물로만 애벌설겆이후 사용후 세제 반만넣어 사용하였는데  그릇들이 뽀독뽀독  깨끗하게 잘 씻겨져 나와요.^^ 그리고 마이디어 식기세척기 12인용 식기세척기는 대가족이나 손님이  많은 집에서도 한 번에 많은 양의 식기를 세척할 수 있어 시간과 노력을  절약할 수 있어요. 고온 세척과 다양한 세척 모드를 통해 기름기와 찌든 때를 잘  씻어 줘요. 또한 에너지 효율 등급이 높아 전기 요금을 절약할 수 있구요  일반 설겆이 할 때보다 물 사용량이 적어 환경 보호에도 좋구요. 디지털 디스플레이와 터치 패널로 쉽게 조작할 수 있으며,  다양한 세척 프로그램을 선택할 수 있어 사용시 편리해요. 그리고 세척 후 식기를 빠르게 건조시켜 주는 기능이 있어,  세척 후 바로 사용할 수 있어요. 아이보리 색상과 세련된 디자인으로 주방 인테리어와 잘 어울립니다. 마이디어 식기세척기는 대가족이나 바쁜 일상 속에서 시간을 절약하고,  효율적으로 식기를 관리할 수 있는 필수템입니다..^^ # 마이디어 식기세척기 제품설명.  1. 감각적이고 모던한 디자인:효율적인 공간 설계가 가능한 컴팩트한 디자인.  2.섬세한 세척의 시작 9가지 세척 코스:강력한 입체 및 고온 세척으로  위생적인 관리. -고급스러운 텆디형 조작부(직관적인 패널 디자인) -다양한 세척코스(자동,강력,야간,통세척 등 맞춤형세척) -75°c고온세척(오염도가 높은 식기류에 적합한 모드)  3.위아래 빈틈없는 강력한 세척 상/하단 강력한 듀얼 세척 노즐 -여러 각도에서 나오는 입체 물살의 압도적인 세척력.  4.오염도에 따른 맞춤형 세척 -고온수 세척으로 더욱 깨끗하게 -기름때 및 굳어버린 음식물 등의 효과적인 세척  5.한 번에 세척이  가능한 12인용 대용량 설계 -넉넉한 공간으로 냄비 등 다양한 식기 세척이 가능 -맞춤형 높이조절로 위치 조절이 가능한 상단 트레이  6.효율적인 공간 활용 -3단 바스켓 설계 -오영도 및 접시 크기에따라 효율적인 분리 세척  7.송풍 건조 및 자동 문 열림 -빠르고 강력한 건조 시스템 -송풍 팬 작동 및 자동 문 열림으로 습기 및 냄새 배출  이외에도 잠금기능, 세척중 식기 추가 기능, 다양한 기능. #이 제품은 쿠팡체험제품에서 제공받아 작성한 구매후기입니다. #제 제품후기가 조금이나마 도움이 되셨다면 도움돼요 꼭 부탁드립니다.

Sentence (English): #This is a review after receiving the product through the Five Senses Review program and personally using and styling it.
Comments (English): #This is a review after receiving the product through the Five Senses Review program and personally using and styling it. These days, Real. This one works harder than the main dishwasher. It's small, but it's powerful! [Design] The transparent door lets you see inside, so you can check the washing status. Watching it spin is healing for no reason :) The minimalist and clean exterior goes well with any space.~ [Function] The boiling water sterilization function removes 99.999% of harmful bacteria (official certificate available), so you can put baby dishes in and spin them. The automatic door opening allows for moisture to escape, so there's no need to worry about odors. The low-temperature mode also allows for delicate washing of glasses, wine glasses, and other items. [Convenience] It's a no-installation/no-punching product, so you can use it in rented furniture without burden. It's easy to move, so I installed it in my desired space.~~ The two-tier basket ensures space efficiency.~ [Size/Usability] The main dishwasher is large, so you have to collect all the dishes before spinning it, which creates a subtle smell and makes you constantly look for dishes to wash. It's so convenient to be able to put them in and spin them right after every meal.~~ It seems especially suitable for washing small amounts of dishes or baby products. It's a small size with a high practicality! I recommend it as a sub dishwasher next to the main one or as an entry-level dishwasher.~~~

Comments (English): [ As expected, LG is the best when it comes to dishwashers! ] || ---------------- || I've been buying new kitchen appliances since moving, and the one I'm most satisfied with is the **'LG Dios Objet Collection Built-in 14-Person Dishwasher (DEE6BGE)'**. The premium 3-tier basket allows for easy storage of large containers like pots and pans, and the adjustable height of the top basket allows for easy arrangement of dishes of various sizes. Even greasy frying pans are squeaky clean, and glassware is crystal clear, free of stains, making it much cleaner than hand washing. The addition of a steam function also alleviates hygiene concerns. The operation is also very intuitive. The touch panel on top allows me to check the operation status even with the door closed, and I can easily select the desired mode with a single touch. The various cycles allow me to frequently use the "Auto" mode for everyday use, and I feel safe because I wash the children's dishes separately in the "Sterilization" mode. Finally, I was very satisfied with the Coupang Rocket installation service. He provided friendly explanations before and after installation, and he even checked the product's condition thoroughly, which gave me confidence. Overall, this product has it all: design, performance, and practicality. It's quieter than before, the cleaning power has improved significantly, and the design is also very satisfying, which has significantly reduced the stress of washing dishes every meal. If you're considering a dishwasher, I highly recommend it! It's a busy day! If my review helped you make a purchasing decision, please click "Helpful." ^^ Thank you!

Comments (English): [ As expected, LG is the best when it comes to dishwashers! ] || ---------------- || I've been buying new kitchen appliances since moving, and the one I'm most satisfied with is the **'LG Dios Objet Collection Built-in 14-Person Dishwasher (DEE6BGE)'**. We're a family of four, and it's incredibly convenient to be able to unload all the dishes that pile up after three meals a day at once. The previous model was a bit lacking in capacity and its internal layout was inefficient, but this model's internal basket design is much more intuitive and flexible. The premium three-tier basket accommodates large containers like pots and pans without a problem, and the adjustable top basket allows for easy arrangement of dishes of various sizes. And thanks to the "Tornado Wash" function, which sprays powerful water from all directions like a mop, the cleaning power is incredibly satisfying. Even greasy frying pans are squeaky clean, and glass cups are crystal clear and stain-free, much cleaner than hand washing. The drying performance has also been significantly upgraded compared to my previous dishwasher, so when I open the door after washing, the dishes are almost dry and ready to be stored away. The addition of a steam function also alleviates hygiene concerns. The operation is also very intuitive. The touch panel at the top allows me to check the operation status even with the door closed, and I can easily select the desired mode with a single touch. The various cycles allow me to frequently use the "Auto" mode for everyday use, while the "Sterilize" mode provides a separate wash for the kids' dishes, giving me peace of mind. Finally, I was extremely satisfied with Coupang's Rocket Installation service. The technician arrived two days after ordering and quickly installed the dishwasher. He did a great job of fitting it perfectly into my existing built-in space. He provided helpful instructions before and after installation, and even checked the condition of the product, which instilled confidence in me. Overall, this product has it all: design, performance, and practicality. It's quieter than before, has much better cleaning power, and the design is so satisfying that washing dishes every meal is a huge relief. If you're considering a dishwasher, I highly recommend it! So, until the inlet can be modified, I can't assess its performance. We'll see how much wear they'll have over time. The water intake for the rotating sprinklers is made from three holes that attach to the intermediate tray. We'll also see how much wear they'll have as they separate and insert into the tray day after day. The rest looks good, with details like the height adjustment of the intermediate tray, the ability to remove a row of plate holders and leave a flat area for placing dishes or large objects, and the third cutlery tray is a great way to free up space on the lower tray. If I can update this post when it's up and running, I'll share my impressions.

Sentence (English): All I can say is, Welcome to my kitchen!
Comments (English): [ Welcome to my kitchen ] || ---------------- || All I can say is, Welcome to my kitchen! It's time to meet the new and gorgeous DW90F89T0U 38 dBA Bespoke Smart Dishwasher with a 3rd Rack Washing System. We chose the white glass, and this is a beautiful, feature-packed dishwasher. In fact, let's talk about those features: 3rd Rack Washing System, Whisper Quiet 38 dBA Noise Level, StormWash+™ System, Smart Dry with AutoRelease™ Door, AI Wash, 2.25" LCD User Interface, ENERGY STAR® Most Efficient 2025, stainless steel interior tub, and fingerprint-resistant finish. And talk about convenience features—this is loaded! Wi-Fi connectivity with the SmartThings app, smooth glide rails, Cookware Flex Rack, digital leak sensor, stemware zone, silverware basket, 16 place settings, 3-step height adjuster, and adjustable tines.If you're like my family, who loves to overstuff the dishwasher knowing there's no way it will clean everything, this powerhouse is perfect. Of course, this is not recommended, but I tried it overstuffed just to see, thinking at least half wouldn't get washed. It feels like magic—they go in dirty, and the dishes come out clean from every angle. This beauty finds a way to clean. With all this power, we can still hardly hear it running. The three-rack system with powerful jets is something I've never seen, and it works amazingly. It really makes it have so much room to add extra cups, etc., and still get powerful jet cleaning. Finish that off with the auto-open dry feature, and there are literally no water spots. Note: We do use Jet Dry and have a water softener in our home. Also, if AI is something you might be on the fence about, don't worry; this built-in AI is all about making your cleanup easy. It allows your washer to get better and better as it learns your usage. I can't say enough good things about this dishwasher. It's beautiful! It has every feature you could ever need in a dishwasher and more. It's powerful, it's quiet, and we absolutely love it. If you're in the market for a dishwasher and want something that will clean with amazing results, get better as you use it, and looks gorgeous, this is the one. This is a must-have for my kitchen, and I highly recommend you check it out.

Sentence (English): This is my first time using a dishwasher.
Comments (English): This is my first time using a dishwasher. Since I live alone, I don't have a lot of dishes to wash, but it is so convenient not having to get my hands wet. I understand why people call it "Auntie." First of all, unlike other products, the design is very sleek, and the remaining time is displayed on the bottom like a head-up display, which is convenient. It opens by gently pushing rather than pulling, and since the sensitivity isn't too high, there doesn't seem to be a risk of it opening due to children playing. As for performance, I haven't used other products so I can't compare, but comparing it to hand washing, it doesn't come out as clean as washing by hand. In particular, grease on pots and rice cooker roots didn't come off completely, so pre-washing seems essential. I haven't removed the water filter yet, but since it says it only needs to be replaced once a year, I think it will be fine. Also, perhaps because the water in my house has a lot of potassium, limescale is still visible even after using rinse aid. Looking at it by type of dish, ceramic plates and cups seem to wash really well. However, water stains on induction pots and cast iron cookware don't come off completely (I suspect it's an issue with my tap water), though it seems to work better if you place the dishes at a slight angle. Even though you have to pre-wash them, it significantly reduces dishwashing time. Since I usually don't do the dishes every day and tend to let them pile up, I think this would be great for someone like me.

Sentence (English): I researched dishwasher's via Consumer Reports, I also fortunately had a family member who recommended the Bosch brand.
Comments (English): [ Pleased with Bosch ] || ---------------- || I researched dishwasher's via Consumer Reports, I also fortunately had a family member who recommended the Bosch brand. I've given the rating of 4 stars due to the claim that you just need to get the 'chunks' off of your dishes, that you don't need to totally rinse them. I'm a rinser, and my research indicated that dishwashers have sensors to determine the residue on dishes and adjust themselves accordingly. So, I put the machine to test and left residue on the dishes (mainly plates). Unfortunately there was a plate that food was still on after a cycle. Therefore, I will still rinse my dishes. Other than that, I've been very pleased with the dishwasher. I especially like how quiet it is! It has been hard to adjust on how to put the dishes in from my last dishwasher. The racks are not as, what I would call "user friendly." That's just one of those things you work around and figure it out! We are basically pleased.

It is worth analyzing what height of dishes you want to wash because I currently lack the height in the upper basket. Only densely arranged ladders fold down. The outermost places on the lower basket are practically unusable because there is no point in putting small plates there and large plates or boards catch on the sides of the dishwasher. The upper basket has a strange single sparse ladder and a strangely angled part of the basket - cups with a large diameter, for example, are difficult to place there and smaller ones are a waste of space. The small height adjustment of the middle basket does not help (in another dishwasher I had 3 height levels). There are 5 loaded programs. To have a short program (1h10) or even just soaking, you have to install an application on your phone - so how can I tell someone to put the dishes in? Does a woman have to do everything? Or should every person, even a child, have a Bosch application in the house? Misunderstanding. Pros: the dishwasher itself informs about the need to wash the filter because it has some kind of sensor - something for lazy people. There is good access almost to the pump, so if something unwanted gets into it, it is quite easy to remove it yourself. Removing the filters is so-so - other manufacturers (my previous dishwashers) have nicer solutions. A metal bottom - now a rarity - I consider it a plus. The dishwasher washes dishes that are not dried on quite well - such ongoing washing even with a smaller amount of "detergent" (e.g. half a tablet) is ok.

I guess I should be happy that a new pump is only $85 (some models $216) but that means my under warranty part is still an out of pocket expense. Also, they are a disorganized mess. I log into my account which shows my dishwasher, but when I online chat with their service they don't have access to any of that information like my name, address, email, etc, even though you can see it on my account. Overall can't recommend LG dishwashers or their service org.

Sentence (English): I have been washing dishes by hand for 10 years since I got married, but I really hate doing dishes these days and I feel like it is a waste of time.
Comments (English): I have been washing dishes by hand for 10 years since I got married, but I really hate doing dishes these days and I feel like it is a waste of time. However, I couldn't think of buying a dishwasher because my house is small, but I happened to see this product because it is slim and can be used in small houses, and I bought it at a good price during a sale. In conclusion, I am so satisfied that I feel aggrieved because I didn't buy a dishwasher until now. I was worried about the color, but I chose ivory, and I like it because it is not a yellowish ivory, but a light and clean color. The installation technician contacted me in advance and was very kind, so there was no problem. The dishwasher is said to be a big deal, but it is enough for a family of three to run after one meal. It feels cleaner than when a person does it. I can't say that it doesn't make noise when it runs, but it wasn't so much that I was concerned about it. When it's done, the door opens automatically to let out the heat and the dishes dry slowly, so I think it's okay even if there is no hot air drying function. Of course, it's hard to put in large cooking utensils like pots and frying pans, so I just wash those by hand. I wash small things like dishes, cups, and spoons. I hate washing dishes more, so I am very satisfied with just handling these things. 저도 그거 못견디는 1인인데, 싱크대안 그릇건조? 하는 그 스텐망을 통째로 넣어보라 하시더라구요, 전 그거 걸리적거려서 늘 갖다버렸는데 앗 하고는 쿠팡 새벽배송으로 방금 도착했어욤ㅎㅎ 맨밑에 1단을 빼서 옆에 두고 해보니 그것도 나쁘진 않으나 너무커서 무겁고 불편하네요ㅋ  저희 식구들에겐 넘 빅사이즈라 하루 한번도 못돌리는 곤란한 사이즈에 보이지 않는 코스는 정말 별로인데 카운터탑보다 훨~~~씬 조용해요ㅎㅎㅎ 소음은 거의 없어서 좋네요, 33평에선 카운터탑 돌려두면 온집에 윙윙 했거든요,  여튼 집안 상황따라 설치를 신중히 고민하시고 구매하시길 바랍니다요 ㅎㅎ 제기준엔 비싼 가격이라^^;  // 다들 말하잖아요, 가전은 무조건 최고로 큰놈으로다가!!! 예... 형편껏 젤큰놈! 맞네요, 그랬어요 맞는말씀들!ㅋ 비스포크 카운터탑은 코팅 냄비-팬은 약간 상하는것 같던데 이건 그렇지않아요, 물살이 더 쎄서 그런지 우짠지~  작은 망 2개를 사서 씽크대에 두고 1차세척 후에 또는 세척함서 세재 묻힌채로 요래조래 1층에 두개를 넣고 2층엔 큰접시나 냄비 정도를 넣어요, 3층은 조리도구 넣으라시던데 갠적으로는 너무 낮아서 과도나 주걱 정도는 모를까..눕혀도 눕혀도 걸립니다, 저희집 뒤집개조차 안되더라고요ㅋ 만든사람은 살림 안해보셨나... 생각도 잠시 했구만요ㅋ 세재 묻힌때는 나름 급속으로 해도 표준이랑 10분밖에 차이가 안나요, 덩치가 있어 그런가 금방은 끝낼수없나보다 했는데 헹굼만 따로 없는게 너무너무너무 아쉽네요.  세정력 부분은 얼마간 써보니 카운터탑 보다는 좋다는 결론예요 무엇보다 문짝에 물자국이 안생겨요 다되고 나면 문이 빼꼼 열리거든요, 먼지도 안들가겠다싶게ㅋ 열어서 선반 다 빼면서 혹시라도 고인물 뒤집어빼면 문짝에 물튀고 바로 못닦는날은 금방 자국되고 그랬는데(카운터탑때) 이건 잘닦이네요, 그게 안닦이고 그래서 뭐지 했는데 같은세재 쓰는데 얘는 깔끔하게 처리됩니다요ㅎㅎ  이틀에 한번 돌리다시피 해서 좀 버겁지만 적응해감서 잘쓰고있는 중입니다!^^

Sentence (English): The size of the countertop was just right for our dishwasher, but when we moved this time, we bought it to match the size that was already there.
Comments (English): <Additional review after a few weeks of use> Previously, we were using a bespoke countertop. We are a family of 4, 1 cat, for a total of 5 people. We don't eat much and don't eat side dishes at all. We only use chopsticks when necessary. We also don't eat much, so it's a bit ambiguous. The size of the countertop was just right for our dishwasher, but when we moved this time, we bought it to match the size that was already there. It was too expensive for my standards, so I was going to buy an LG, but when we moved and reduced the square footage from 33 to 25, I was scared because of the different brands of washing machines and dryers. Since the dryer is Samsung, it went up in a row, and at that time, I was impressed by the hard work of the Sam Song Man and shouted, "Sam Song is the best!" and bought a Samsung. Two days after purchasing it? The interior designer made an appointment to check the installation location and situation and checked it thoroughly. It was the weekend, but they came to install it on Monday. Two people came, and one of them did most of the work and the other one seemed to be a young person learning. They told me about various things about my sink that I didn't know about, took measures, and installed it thoroughly. It's so big that I was surprised. The interior is very spacious. Pots and frying pans come out with every meal, and it's convenient to put them in, but I don't know about the cleaning power because I usually wipe it with a basic dishwashing sponge. However, there are a few inconvenient points! First of all, the LCD screen is not visible. It's so inconvenient. You can't see what it's doing. I didn't see it closely, but it's hard to believe-_-;; I want to use it without the drying function, because it eats up all the electricity. But you can't set it separately. Power drying! You can cancel it. Even if you cancel it at the end, you have to see what step it is. Of course, if you just open it, it's written above, but only the sign that it's open appears in the middle, so when you close it, it turns on its own again, and that's not a secret. I use Coupang's powdered dishwashing detergent because it has the best cleaning power, so I don't use liquid or tablets, but if I don't put in rinse, the water just puddles up, so I have no choice but to use rinse, but it's annoying. I have to pour a lot of detergent -_-;; I saw this tip from a housekeeper on YouTube, but when we do the first wash and put the dishwasher in, water + detergent, etc. run down for a moment, right? I'm one of those people who can't stand that, but drying dishes in the sink? He told me to put the entire stainless steel net in, I always threw it away because it was in the way, but oh, it just arrived with Coupang's early morning delivery. I took out the bottom one and put it next to me, and it wasn't bad, but it's too big, so it's heavy and uncomfortable. It's too big for my family, so it's an inconvenient size that I can't turn it even once a day, and the invisible course is really not good, but it's much~~~ quieter than a countertop. It's nice because there's almost no noise. In my 33 pyeong house, when I turned the countertop, it made a buzzing sound throughout the house. Anyway, I hope you think carefully about the installation depending on your household situation and then buy it. It's expensive by my standards^^; // As everyone says, when it comes to appliances, you should definitely get the biggest one! Yes. The biggest one you can afford! That's right, that's right! Bespoke countertops seem to damage coated pots and pans a little, but this one doesn't. I don't know if it's because the water current is stronger or what~ I bought two small nets and put them on the sink, and after the first wash or while washing, I put two on the first floor with detergent on them and put large plates or pots on the second floor. The third floor is supposed to be for cooking utensils, but personally, it's so low that I don't know about a spatula or a fork. It gets caught even when I lay it down. Even my spatula didn't work. Did the person who made it never do housework? I thought about it for a moment. When detergent is on, it only takes 10 minutes compared to the standard time even if I speed it up. I thought it wouldn't be able to finish it quickly because it's big, but it's so, so, so disappointing that there's no separate rinsing function. As for the cleaning power, after using it for a while, I concluded that it is better than the countertop. Above all, there are no water marks on the door. When it's done, the door opens wide. I open it so that no dust will get in, and when I take out all the shelves, if I spill water, water will splash on the door, and if I don't wipe it right away, marks will form right away (when using the countertop). This one cleans well. I wondered why it didn't clean, but this one cleans cleanly when I use the same detergent. It's a bit difficult to use it once every two days, but I'm getting used to it and using it well! ^^

I'm one of those people who can't stand that, but drying dishes in the sink? He told me to put the entire stainless steel net in, I always threw it away because it was in the way, but oh, it just arrived with Coupang's early morning delivery. I took out the bottom one and put it next to me, and it wasn't bad, but it's too big, so it's heavy and uncomfortable. It's too big for my family, so it's an inconvenient size that I can't turn it even once a day, and the invisible course is really not good, but it's much~~~ quieter than a countertop. Anyway, I hope you think carefully about the installation depending on your household situation and then buy it. It's expensive by my standards^^; // As everyone says, when it comes to appliances, you should definitely get the biggest one! Yes. The biggest one you can afford! That's right, that's right! Bespoke countertops seem to damage coated pots and pans a little, but this one doesn't. I don't know if it's because the water current is stronger or what~ I bought two small nets and put them on the sink, and after the first wash or while washing, I put two on the first floor with detergent on them and put large plates or pots on the second floor. Did the person who made it never do housework? I thought about it for a moment. When detergent is on, it only takes 10 minutes compared to the standard time even if I speed it up. I thought it wouldn't be able to finish it quickly because it's big, but it's so, so, so disappointing that there's no separate rinsing function. As for the cleaning power, after using it for a while, I concluded that it is better than the countertop. Above all, there are no water marks on the door. When it's done, the door opens wide. I open it so that no dust will get in, and when I take out all the shelves, if I spill water, water will splash on the door, and if I don't wipe it right away, marks will form right away (when using the countertop). This one cleans well. I wondered why it didn't clean, but this one cleans cleanly when I use the same detergent. It's a bit difficult to use it once every two days, but I'm getting used to it and using it well! ^^

저도 그거 못견디는 1인인데, 싱크대안 그릇건조? 하는 그 스텐망을 통째로 넣어보라 하시더라구요, 전 그거 걸리적거려서 늘 갖다버렸는데 앗 하고는 쿠팡 새벽배송으로 방금 도착했어욤ㅎㅎ 맨밑에 1단을 빼서 옆에 두고 해보니 그것도 나쁘진 않으나 너무커서 무겁고 불편하네요ㅋ  저희 식구들에겐 넘 빅사이즈라 하루 한번도 못돌리는 곤란한 사이즈에 보이지 않는 코스는 정말 별로인데 카운터탑보다 훨~~~씬 조용해요ㅎㅎㅎ 소음은 거의 없어서 좋네요, 33평에선 카운터탑 돌려두면 온집에 윙윙 했거든요,  여튼 집안 상황따라 설치를 신중히 고민하시고 구매하시길 바랍니다요 ㅎㅎ 제기준엔 비싼 가격이라^^;  // 다들 말하잖아요, 가전은 무조건 최고로 큰놈으로다가!!! 예... 형편껏 젤큰놈! 맞네요, 그랬어요 맞는말씀들!ㅋ 비스포크 카운터탑은 코팅 냄비-팬은 약간 상하는것 같던데 이건 그렇지않아요, 물살이 더 쎄서 그런지 우짠지~  작은 망 2개를 사서 씽크대에 두고 1차세척 후에 또는 세척함서 세재 묻힌채로 요래조래 1층에 두개를 넣고 2층엔 큰접시나 냄비 정도를 넣어요, 3층은 조리도구 넣으라시던데 갠적으로는 너무 낮아서 과도나 주걱 정도는 모를까..눕혀도 눕혀도 걸립니다, 저희집 뒤집개조차 안되더라고요ㅋ 만든사람은 살림 안해보셨나... 생각도 잠시 했구만요ㅋ 세재 묻힌때는 나름 급속으로 해도 표준이랑 10분밖에 차이가 안나요, 덩치가 있어 그런가 금방은 끝낼수없나보다 했는데 헹굼만 따로 없는게 너무너무너무 아쉽네요.  세정력 부분은 얼마간 써보니 카운터탑 보다는 좋다는 결론예요 무엇보다 문짝에 물자국이 안생겨요 다되고 나면 문이 빼꼼 열리거든요, 먼지도 안들가겠다싶게ㅋ 열어서 선반 다 빼면서 혹시라도 고인물 뒤집어빼면 문짝에 물튀고 바로 못닦는날은 금방 자국되고 그랬는데(카운터탑때) 이건 잘닦이네요, 그게 안닦이고 그래서 뭐지 했는데 같은세재 쓰는데 얘는 깔끔하게 처리됩니다요ㅎㅎ  이틀에 한번 돌리다시피 해서 좀 버겁지만 적응해감서 잘쓰고있는 중입니다!^^

Comments (English): <Additional review after a few weeks of use> Previously, we were using a bespoke countertop. We are a family of 4, 1 cat, for a total of 5 people. We don't eat much and don't eat side dishes at all. We only use chopsticks when necessary. We also don't eat much, so it's a bit ambiguous. The size of the countertop was just right for our dishwasher, but when we moved this time, we bought it to match the size that was already there. It was too expensive for my standards, so I was going to buy an LG, but when we moved and reduced the square footage from 33 to 25, I was scared because of the different brands of washing machines and dryers. Since the dryer is Samsung, it went up in a row, and at that time, I was impressed by the hard work of the Sam Song Man and shouted, "Sam Song is the best!" and bought a Samsung. Two days after purchasing it? The interior designer made an appointment to check the installation location and situation and checked it thoroughly. It was the weekend, but they came to install it on Monday. Two people came, and one of them did most of the work and the other one seemed to be a young person learning. They told me about various things about my sink that I didn't know about, took measures, and installed it thoroughly. It's so big that I was surprised. The interior is very spacious. Pots and frying pans come out with every meal, and it's convenient to put them in, but I don't know about the cleaning power because I usually wipe it with a basic dishwashing sponge. However, there are a few inconvenient points! First of all, the LCD screen is not visible. It's so inconvenient. You can't see what it's doing. I didn't see it closely, but it's hard to believe-_-;; I want to use it without the drying function, because it eats up all the electricity. But you can't set it separately. Power drying! You can cancel it. Even if you cancel it at the end, you have to see what step it is. Of course, if you just open it, it's written above, but only the sign that it's open appears in the middle, so when you close it, it turns on its own again, and that's not a secret. I use Coupang's powdered dishwashing detergent because it has the best cleaning power, so I don't use liquid or tablets, but if I don't put in rinse, the water just puddles up, so I have no choice but to use rinse, but it's annoying. I have to pour a lot of detergent -_-;; I saw this tip from a housekeeper on YouTube, but when we do the first wash and put the dishwasher in, water + detergent, etc. run down for a moment, right? I'm one of those people who can't stand that, but drying dishes in the sink? He told me to put the entire stainless steel net in, I always threw it away because it was in the way, but oh, it just arrived with Coupang's early morning delivery. I took out the bottom one and put it next to me, and it wasn't bad, but it's too big, so it's heavy and uncomfortable. It's too big for my family, so it's an inconvenient size that I can't turn it even once a day, and the invisible course is really not good, but it's much~~~ quieter than a countertop. It's nice because there's almost no noise. In my 33 pyeong house, when I turned the countertop, it made a buzzing sound throughout the house. Anyway, I hope you think carefully about the installation depending on your household situation and then buy it. It's expensive by my standards^^; // As everyone says, when it comes to appliances, you should definitely get the biggest one! Yes. The biggest one you can afford! That's right, that's right! Bespoke countertops seem to damage coated pots and pans a little, but this one doesn't. I don't know if it's because the water current is stronger or what~ I bought two small nets and put them on the sink, and after the first wash or while washing, I put two on the first floor with detergent on them and put large plates or pots on the second floor. The third floor is supposed to be for cooking utensils, but personally, it's so low that I don't know about a spatula or a fork. It gets caught even when I lay it down. Even my spatula didn't work. Did the person who made it never do housework? I thought about it for a moment. When detergent is on, it only takes 10 minutes compared to the standard time even if I speed it up. I thought it wouldn't be able to finish it quickly because it's big, but it's so, so, so disappointing that there's no separate rinsing function. As for the cleaning power, after using it for a while, I concluded that it is better than the countertop. Above all, there are no water marks on the door. When it's done, the door opens wide. I open it so that no dust will get in, and when I take out all the shelves, if I spill water, water will splash on the door, and if I don't wipe it right away, marks will form right away (when using the countertop). This one cleans well. I wondered why it didn't clean, but this one cleans cleanly when I use the same detergent. It's a bit difficult to use it once every two days, but I'm getting used to it and using it well! ^^

저도 그거 못견디는 1인인데, 싱크대안 그릇건조? 하는 그 스텐망을 통째로 넣어보라 하시더라구요, 전 그거 걸리적거려서 늘 갖다버렸는데 앗 하고는 쿠팡 새벽배송으로 방금 도착했어욤ㅎㅎ 맨밑에 1단을 빼서 옆에 두고 해보니 그것도 나쁘진 않으나 너무커서 무겁고 불편하네요ㅋ  저희 식구들에겐 넘 빅사이즈라 하루 한번도 못돌리는 곤란한 사이즈에 보이지 않는 코스는 정말 별로인데 카운터탑보다 훨~~~씬 조용해요ㅎㅎㅎ 소음은 거의 없어서 좋네요, 33평에선 카운터탑 돌려두면 온집에 윙윙 했거든요,  여튼 집안 상황따라 설치를 신중히 고민하시고 구매하시길 바랍니다요 ㅎㅎ 제기준엔 비싼 가격이라^^;  // 다들 말하잖아요, 가전은 무조건 최고로 큰놈으로다가!!! 예... 형편껏 젤큰놈! 맞네요, 그랬어요 맞는말씀들!ㅋ 비스포크 카운터탑은 코팅 냄비-팬은 약간 상하는것 같던데 이건 그렇지않아요, 물살이 더 쎄서 그런지 우짠지~  작은 망 2개를 사서 씽크대에 두고 1차세척 후에 또는 세척함서 세재 묻힌채로 요래조래 1층에 두개를 넣고 2층엔 큰접시나 냄비 정도를 넣어요, 3층은 조리도구 넣으라시던데 갠적으로는 너무 낮아서 과도나 주걱 정도는 모를까..눕혀도 눕혀도 걸립니다, 저희집 뒤집개조차 안되더라고요ㅋ 만든사람은 살림 안해보셨나... 생각도 잠시 했구만요ㅋ 세재 묻힌때는 나름 급속으로 해도 표준이랑 10분밖에 차이가 안나요, 덩치가 있어 그런가 금방은 끝낼수없나보다 했는데 헹굼만 따로 없는게 너무너무너무 아쉽네요.  세정력 부분은 얼마간 써보니 카운터탑 보다는 좋다는 결론예요 무엇보다 문짝에 물자국이 안생겨요 다되고 나면 문이 빼꼼 열리거든요, 먼지도 안들가겠다싶게ㅋ 열어서 선반 다 빼면서 혹시라도 고인물 뒤집어빼면 문짝에 물튀고 바로 못닦는날은 금방 자국되고 그랬는데(카운터탑때) 이건 잘닦이네요, 그게 안닦이고 그래서 뭐지 했는데 같은세재 쓰는데 얘는 깔끔하게 처리됩니다요ㅎㅎ  이틀에 한번 돌리다시피 해서 좀 버겁지만 적응해감서 잘쓰고있는 중입니다!^^

Comments (English): <Additional review after a few weeks of use> Previously, we were using a bespoke countertop. We are a family of 4, 1 cat, for a total of 5 people. We don't eat much and don't eat side dishes at all. We only use chopsticks when necessary. We also don't eat much, so it's a bit ambiguous. The size of the countertop was just right for our dishwasher, but when we moved this time, we bought it to match the size that was already there. It was too expensive for my standards, so I was going to buy an LG, but when we moved and reduced the square footage from 33 to 25, I was scared because of the different brands of washing machines and dryers. Since the dryer is Samsung, it went up in a row, and at that time, I was impressed by the hard work of the Sam Song Man and shouted, "Sam Song is the best!" and bought a Samsung. Two days after purchasing it? The interior designer made an appointment to check the installation location and situation and checked it thoroughly. It was the weekend, but they came to install it on Monday. Two people came, and one of them did most of the work and the other one seemed to be a young person learning. They told me about various things about my sink that I didn't know about, took measures, and installed it thoroughly. It's so big that I was surprised. The interior is very spacious. Pots and frying pans come out with every meal, and it's convenient to put them in, but I don't know about the cleaning power because I usually wipe it with a basic dishwashing sponge. However, there are a few inconvenient points! First of all, the LCD screen is not visible. It's so inconvenient. You can't see what it's doing. I didn't see it closely, but it's hard to believe-_-;; I want to use it without the drying function, because it eats up all the electricity. But you can't set it separately. Power drying! You can cancel it. Even if you cancel it at the end, you have to see what step it is. Of course, if you just open it, it's written above, but only the sign that it's open appears in the middle, so when you close it, it turns on its own again, and that's not a secret. I use Coupang's powdered dishwashing detergent because it has the best cleaning power, so I don't use liquid or tablets, but if I don't put in rinse, the water just puddles up, so I have no choice but to use rinse, but it's annoying. I have to pour a lot of detergent -_-;; I saw this tip from a housekeeper on YouTube, but when we do the first wash and put the dishwasher in, water + detergent, etc. run down for a moment, right? I'm one of those people who can't stand that, but drying dishes in the sink? He told me to put the entire stainless steel net in, I always threw it away because it was in the way, but oh, it just arrived with Coupang's early morning delivery. I took out the bottom one and put it next to me, and it wasn't bad, but it's too big, so it's heavy and uncomfortable. It's too big for my family, so it's an inconvenient size that I can't turn it even once a day, and the invisible course is really not good, but it's much~~~ quieter than a countertop. It's nice because there's almost no noise. In my 33 pyeong house, when I turned the countertop, it made a buzzing sound throughout the house. Anyway, I hope you think carefully about the installation depending on your household situation and then buy it. It's expensive by my standards^^; // As everyone says, when it comes to appliances, you should definitely get the biggest one! Yes. The biggest one you can afford! That's right, that's right! Bespoke countertops seem to damage coated pots and pans a little, but this one doesn't. I don't know if it's because the water current is stronger or what~ I bought two small nets and put them on the sink, and after the first wash or while washing, I put two on the first floor with detergent on them and put large plates or pots on the second floor. The third floor is supposed to be for cooking utensils, but personally, it's so low that I don't know about a spatula or a fork. It gets caught even when I lay it down. Even my spatula didn't work. Did the person who made it never do housework? I thought about it for a moment. When detergent is on, it only takes 10 minutes compared to the standard time even if I speed it up. I thought it wouldn't be able to finish it quickly because it's big, but it's so, so, so disappointing that there's no separate rinsing function. As for the cleaning power, after using it for a while, I concluded that it is better than the countertop. Above all, there are no water marks on the door. When it's done, the door opens wide. I open it so that no dust will get in, and when I take out all the shelves, if I spill water, water will splash on the door, and if I don't wipe it right away, marks will form right away (when using the countertop). This one cleans well. I wondered why it didn't clean, but this one cleans cleanly when I use the same detergent. It's a bit difficult to use it once every two days, but I'm getting used to it and using it well! ^^

저도 그거 못견디는 1인인데, 싱크대안 그릇건조? 하는 그 스텐망을 통째로 넣어보라 하시더라구요, 전 그거 걸리적거려서 늘 갖다버렸는데 앗 하고는 쿠팡 새벽배송으로 방금 도착했어욤ㅎㅎ 맨밑에 1단을 빼서 옆에 두고 해보니 그것도 나쁘진 않으나 너무커서 무겁고 불편하네요ㅋ  저희 식구들에겐 넘 빅사이즈라 하루 한번도 못돌리는 곤란한 사이즈에 보이지 않는 코스는 정말 별로인데 카운터탑보다 훨~~~씬 조용해요ㅎㅎㅎ 소음은 거의 없어서 좋네요, 33평에선 카운터탑 돌려두면 온집에 윙윙 했거든요,  여튼 집안 상황따라 설치를 신중히 고민하시고 구매하시길 바랍니다요 ㅎㅎ 제기준엔 비싼 가격이라^^;  // 다들 말하잖아요, 가전은 무조건 최고로 큰놈으로다가!!! 예... 형편껏 젤큰놈! 맞네요, 그랬어요 맞는말씀들!ㅋ 비스포크 카운터탑은 코팅 냄비-팬은 약간 상하는것 같던데 이건 그렇지않아요, 물살이 더 쎄서 그런지 우짠지~  작은 망 2개를 사서 씽크대에 두고 1차세척 후에 또는 세척함서 세재 묻힌채로 요래조래 1층에 두개를 넣고 2층엔 큰접시나 냄비 정도를 넣어요, 3층은 조리도구 넣으라시던데 갠적으로는 너무 낮아서 과도나 주걱 정도는 모를까..눕혀도 눕혀도 걸립니다, 저희집 뒤집개조차 안되더라고요ㅋ 만든사람은 살림 안해보셨나... 생각도 잠시 했구만요ㅋ 세재 묻힌때는 나름 급속으로 해도 표준이랑 10분밖에 차이가 안나요, 덩치가 있어 그런가 금방은 끝낼수없나보다 했는데 헹굼만 따로 없는게 너무너무너무 아쉽네요.  세정력 부분은 얼마간 써보니 카운터탑 보다는 좋다는 결론예요 무엇보다 문짝에 물자국이 안생겨요 다되고 나면 문이 빼꼼 열리거든요, 먼지도 안들가겠다싶게ㅋ 열어서 선반 다 빼면서 혹시라도 고인물 뒤집어빼면 문짝에 물튀고 바로 못닦는날은 금방 자국되고 그랬는데(카운터탑때) 이건 잘닦이네요, 그게 안닦이고 그래서 뭐지 했는데 같은세재 쓰는데 얘는 깔끔하게 처리됩니다요ㅎㅎ  이틀에 한번 돌리다시피 해서 좀 버겁지만 적응해감서 잘쓰고있는 중입니다!^^

Comments (English): <Additional review after a few weeks of use> Previously, we were using a bespoke countertop. We are a family of 4, 1 cat, for a total of 5 people. We don't eat much and don't eat side dishes at all. We only use chopsticks when necessary. We also don't eat much, so it's a bit ambiguous. The size of the countertop was just right for our dishwasher, but when we moved this time, we bought it to match the size that was already there. It was too expensive for my standards, so I was going to buy an LG, but when we moved and reduced the square footage from 33 to 25, I was scared because of the different brands of washing machines and dryers. Since the dryer is Samsung, it went up in a row, and at that time, I was impressed by the hard work of the Sam Song Man and shouted, "Sam Song is the best!" and bought a Samsung. Two days after purchasing it? The interior designer made an appointment to check the installation location and situation and checked it thoroughly. It was the weekend, but they came to install it on Monday. Two people came, and one of them did most of the work and the other one seemed to be a young person learning. They told me about various things about my sink that I didn't know about, took measures, and installed it thoroughly. It's so big that I was surprised. The interior is very spacious. Pots and frying pans come out with every meal, and it's convenient to put them in, but I don't know about the cleaning power because I usually wipe it with a basic dishwashing sponge. However, there are a few inconvenient points! First of all, the LCD screen is not visible. It's so inconvenient. You can't see what it's doing. I didn't see it closely, but it's hard to believe-_-;; I want to use it without the drying function, because it eats up all the electricity. But you can't set it separately. Power drying! You can cancel it. Even if you cancel it at the end, you have to see what step it is. Of course, if you just open it, it's written above, but only the sign that it's open appears in the middle, so when you close it, it turns on its own again, and that's not a secret. I use Coupang's powdered dishwashing detergent because it has the best cleaning power, so I don't use liquid or tablets, but if I don't put in rinse, the water just puddles up, so I have no choice but to use rinse, but it's annoying. I have to pour a lot of detergent -_-;; I saw this tip from a housekeeper on YouTube, but when we do the first wash and put the dishwasher in, water + detergent, etc. run down for a moment, right? I'm one of those people who can't stand that, but drying dishes in the sink? He told me to put the entire stainless steel net in, I always threw it away because it was in the way, but oh, it just arrived with Coupang's early morning delivery. I took out the bottom one and put it next to me, and it wasn't bad, but it's too big, so it's heavy and uncomfortable. It's too big for my family, so it's an inconvenient size that I can't turn it even once a day, and the invisible course is really not good, but it's much~~~ quieter than a countertop. It's nice because there's almost no noise. In my 33 pyeong house, when I turned the countertop, it made a buzzing sound throughout the house. Anyway, I hope you think carefully about the installation depending on your household situation and then buy it. It's expensive by my standards^^; // As everyone says, when it comes to appliances, you should definitely get the biggest one! Yes. The biggest one you can afford! That's right, that's right! Bespoke countertops seem to damage coated pots and pans a little, but this one doesn't. I don't know if it's because the water current is stronger or what~ I bought two small nets and put them on the sink, and after the first wash or while washing, I put two on the first floor with detergent on them and put large plates or pots on the second floor. The third floor is supposed to be for cooking utensils, but personally, it's so low that I don't know about a spatula or a fork. It gets caught even when I lay it down. Even my spatula didn't work. Did the person who made it never do housework? I thought about it for a moment. When detergent is on, it only takes 10 minutes compared to the standard time even if I speed it up. I thought it wouldn't be able to finish it quickly because it's big, but it's so, so, so disappointing that there's no separate rinsing function. As for the cleaning power, after using it for a while, I concluded that it is better than the countertop. Above all, there are no water marks on the door. When it's done, the door opens wide. I open it so that no dust will get in, and when I take out all the shelves, if I spill water, water will splash on the door, and if I don't wipe it right away, marks will form right away (when using the countertop). This one cleans well. I wondered why it didn't clean, but this one cleans cleanly when I use the same detergent. It's a bit difficult to use it once every two days, but I'm getting used to it and using it well! ^^

저도 그거 못견디는 1인인데, 싱크대안 그릇건조? 하는 그 스텐망을 통째로 넣어보라 하시더라구요, 전 그거 걸리적거려서 늘 갖다버렸는데 앗 하고는 쿠팡 새벽배송으로 방금 도착했어욤ㅎㅎ 맨밑에 1단을 빼서 옆에 두고 해보니 그것도 나쁘진 않으나 너무커서 무겁고 불편하네요ㅋ  저희 식구들에겐 넘 빅사이즈라 하루 한번도 못돌리는 곤란한 사이즈에 보이지 않는 코스는 정말 별로인데 카운터탑보다 훨~~~씬 조용해요ㅎㅎㅎ 소음은 거의 없어서 좋네요, 33평에선 카운터탑 돌려두면 온집에 윙윙 했거든요,  여튼 집안 상황따라 설치를 신중히 고민하시고 구매하시길 바랍니다요 ㅎㅎ 제기준엔 비싼 가격이라^^;  // 다들 말하잖아요, 가전은 무조건 최고로 큰놈으로다가!!! 예... 형편껏 젤큰놈! 맞네요, 그랬어요 맞는말씀들!ㅋ 비스포크 카운터탑은 코팅 냄비-팬은 약간 상하는것 같던데 이건 그렇지않아요, 물살이 더 쎄서 그런지 우짠지~  작은 망 2개를 사서 씽크대에 두고 1차세척 후에 또는 세척함서 세재 묻힌채로 요래조래 1층에 두개를 넣고 2층엔 큰접시나 냄비 정도를 넣어요, 3층은 조리도구 넣으라시던데 갠적으로는 너무 낮아서 과도나 주걱 정도는 모를까..눕혀도 눕혀도 걸립니다, 저희집 뒤집개조차 안되더라고요ㅋ 만든사람은 살림 안해보셨나... 생각도 잠시 했구만요ㅋ 세재 묻힌때는 나름 급속으로 해도 표준이랑 10분밖에 차이가 안나요, 덩치가 있어 그런가 금방은 끝낼수없나보다 했는데 헹굼만 따로 없는게 너무너무너무 아쉽네요.  세정력 부분은 얼마간 써보니 카운터탑 보다는 좋다는 결론예요 무엇보다 문짝에 물자국이 안생겨요 다되고 나면 문이 빼꼼 열리거든요, 먼지도 안들가겠다싶게ㅋ 열어서 선반 다 빼면서 혹시라도 고인물 뒤집어빼면 문짝에 물튀고 바로 못닦는날은 금방 자국되고 그랬는데(카운터탑때) 이건 잘닦이네요, 그게 안닦이고 그래서 뭐지 했는데 같은세재 쓰는데 얘는 깔끔하게 처리됩니다요ㅎㅎ  이틀에 한번 돌리다시피 해서 좀 버겁지만 적응해감서 잘쓰고있는 중입니다!^^

The size of the countertop was just right for our dishwasher, but when we moved this time, we bought it to match the size that was already there. It was too expensive for my standards, so I was going to buy an LG, but when we moved and reduced the square footage from 33 to 25, I was scared because of the different brands of washing machines and dryers. Since the dryer is Samsung, it went up in a row, and at that time, I was impressed by the hard work of the Sam Song Man and shouted, "Sam Song is the best!" and bought a Samsung. Two days after purchasing it? The interior designer made an appointment to check the installation location and situation and checked it thoroughly. It was the weekend, but they came to install it on Monday. Two people came, and one of them did most of the work and the other one seemed to be a young person learning. They told me about various things about my sink that I didn't know about, took measures, and installed it thoroughly. It's so big that I was surprised. The interior is very spacious. Pots and frying pans come out with every meal, and it's convenient to put them in, but I don't know about the cleaning power because I usually wipe it with a basic dishwashing sponge. However, there are a few inconvenient points! First of all, the LCD screen is not visible. It's so inconvenient. You can't see what it's doing. I didn't see it closely, but it's hard to believe-_-;; I want to use it without the drying function, because it eats up all the electricity. But you can't set it separately. Power drying! You can cancel it. Even if you cancel it at the end, you have to see what step it is. Of course, if you just open it, it's written above, but only the sign that it's open appears in the middle, so when you close it, it turns on its own again, and that's not a secret. I use Coupang's powdered dishwashing detergent because it has the best cleaning power, so I don't use liquid or tablets, but if I don't put in rinse, the water just puddles up, so I have no choice but to use rinse, but it's annoying. I have to pour a lot of detergent -_-;; I saw this tip from a housekeeper on YouTube, but when we do the first wash and put the dishwasher in, water + detergent, etc. run down for a moment, right? I'm one of those people who can't stand that, but drying dishes in the sink? He told me to put the entire stainless steel net in, I always threw it away because it was in the way, but oh, it just arrived with Coupang's early morning delivery. I took out the bottom one and put it next to me, and it wasn't bad, but it's too big, so it's heavy and uncomfortable. It's too big for my family, so it's an inconvenient size that I can't turn it even once a day, and the invisible course is really not good, but it's much~~~ quieter than a countertop. It's nice because there's almost no noise. In my 33 pyeong house, when I turned the countertop, it made a buzzing sound throughout the house. Anyway, I hope you think carefully about the installation depending on your household situation and then buy it. It's expensive by my standards^^; // As everyone says, when it comes to appliances, you should definitely get the biggest one! Yes. The biggest one you can afford! That's right, that's right! Bespoke countertops seem to damage coated pots and pans a little, but this one doesn't. I don't know if it's because the water current is stronger or what~ I bought two small nets and put them on the sink, and after the first wash or while washing, I put two on the first floor with detergent on them and put large plates or pots on the second floor. The third floor is supposed to be for cooking utensils, but personally, it's so low that I don't know about a spatula or a fork. It gets caught even when I lay it down. Even my spatula didn't work. Did the person who made it never do housework? I thought about it for a moment. When detergent is on, it only takes 10 minutes compared to the standard time even if I speed it up. I thought it wouldn't be able to finish it quickly because it's big, but it's so, so, so disappointing that there's no separate rinsing function. As for the cleaning power, after using it for a while, I concluded that it is better than the countertop. Above all, there are no water marks on the door. When it's done, the door opens wide. I open it so that no dust will get in, and when I take out all the shelves, if I spill water, water will splash on the door, and if I don't wipe it right away, marks will form right away (when using the countertop). This one cleans well. I wondered why it didn't clean, but this one cleans cleanly when I use the same detergent. It's a bit difficult to use it once every two days, but I'm getting used to it and using it well! ^^

저도 그거 못견디는 1인인데, 싱크대안 그릇건조? 하는 그 스텐망을 통째로 넣어보라 하시더라구요, 전 그거 걸리적거려서 늘 갖다버렸는데 앗 하고는 쿠팡 새벽배송으로 방금 도착했어욤ㅎㅎ 맨밑에 1단을 빼서 옆에 두고 해보니 그것도 나쁘진 않으나 너무커서 무겁고 불편하네요ㅋ  저희 식구들에겐 넘 빅사이즈라 하루 한번도 못돌리는 곤란한 사이즈에 보이지 않는 코스는 정말 별로인데 카운터탑보다 훨~~~씬 조용해요ㅎㅎㅎ 소음은 거의 없어서 좋네요, 33평에선 카운터탑 돌려두면 온집에 윙윙 했거든요,  여튼 집안 상황따라 설치를 신중히 고민하시고 구매하시길 바랍니다요 ㅎㅎ 제기준엔 비싼 가격이라^^;  // 다들 말하잖아요, 가전은 무조건 최고로 큰놈으로다가!!! 예... 형편껏 젤큰놈! 맞네요, 그랬어요 맞는말씀들!ㅋ 비스포크 카운터탑은 코팅 냄비-팬은 약간 상하는것 같던데 이건 그렇지않아요, 물살이 더 쎄서 그런지 우짠지~  작은 망 2개를 사서 씽크대에 두고 1차세척 후에 또는 세척함서 세재 묻힌채로 요래조래 1층에 두개를 넣고 2층엔 큰접시나 냄비 정도를 넣어요, 3층은 조리도구 넣으라시던데 갠적으로는 너무 낮아서 과도나 주걱 정도는 모를까..눕혀도 눕혀도 걸립니다, 저희집 뒤집개조차 안되더라고요ㅋ 만든사람은 살림 안해보셨나... 생각도 잠시 했구만요ㅋ 세재 묻힌때는 나름 급속으로 해도 표준이랑 10분밖에 차이가 안나요, 덩치가 있어 그런가 금방은 끝낼수없나보다 했는데 헹굼만 따로 없는게 너무너무너무 아쉽네요.  세정력 부분은 얼마간 써보니 카운터탑 보다는 좋다는 결론예요 무엇보다 문짝에 물자국이 안생겨요 다되고 나면 문이 빼꼼 열리거든요, 먼지도 안들가겠다싶게ㅋ 열어서 선반 다 빼면서 혹시라도 고인물 뒤집어빼면 문짝에 물튀고 바로 못닦는날은 금방 자국되고 그랬는데(카운터탑때) 이건 잘닦이네요, 그게 안닦이고 그래서 뭐지 했는데 같은세재 쓰는데 얘는 깔끔하게 처리됩니다요ㅎㅎ  이틀에 한번 돌리다시피 해서 좀 버겁지만 적응해감서 잘쓰고있는 중입니다!^^

It was the weekend, but they came to install it on Monday. Two people came, and one of them did most of the work and the other one seemed to be a young person learning. They told me about various things about my sink that I didn't know about, took measures, and installed it thoroughly. It's so big that I was surprised. The interior is very spacious. However, there are a few inconvenient points! First of all, the LCD screen is not visible. It's so inconvenient. You can't see what it's doing. I didn't see it closely, but it's hard to believe-_-;; I want to use it without the drying function, because it eats up all the electricity. But you can't set it separately. Power drying! You can cancel it. Even if you cancel it at the end, you have to see what step it is. Of course, if you just open it, it's written above, but only the sign that it's open appears in the middle, so when you close it, it turns on its own again, and that's not a secret. I use Coupang's powdered dishwashing detergent because it has the best cleaning power, so I don't use liquid or tablets, but if I don't put in rinse, the water just puddles up, so I have no choice but to use rinse, but it's annoying. I have to pour a lot of detergent -_-;; I saw this tip from a housekeeper on YouTube, but when we do the first wash and put the dishwasher in, water + detergent, etc. run down for a moment, right? I'm one of those people who can't stand that, but drying dishes in the sink? He told me to put the entire stainless steel net in, I always threw it away because it was in the way, but oh, it just arrived with Coupang's early morning delivery. I took out the bottom one and put it next to me, and it wasn't bad, but it's too big, so it's heavy and uncomfortable. It's too big for my family, so it's an inconvenient size that I can't turn it even once a day, and the invisible course is really not good, but it's much~~~ quieter than a countertop. It's nice because there's almost no noise. In my 33 pyeong house, when I turned the countertop, it made a buzzing sound throughout the house. Anyway, I hope you think carefully about the installation depending on your household situation and then buy it. It's expensive by my standards^^; // As everyone says, when it comes to appliances, you should definitely get the biggest one! Yes. The biggest one you can afford! That's right, that's right! Bespoke countertops seem to damage coated pots and pans a little, but this one doesn't. I don't know if it's because the water current is stronger or what~ I bought two small nets and put them on the sink, and after the first wash or while washing, I put two on the first floor with detergent on them and put large plates or pots on the second floor. The third floor is supposed to be for cooking utensils, but personally, it's so low that I don't know about a spatula or a fork. It gets caught even when I lay it down. Even my spatula didn't work. Did the person who made it never do housework? I thought about it for a moment. When detergent is on, it only takes 10 minutes compared to the standard time even if I speed it up. I thought it wouldn't be able to finish it quickly because it's big, but it's so, so, so disappointing that there's no separate rinsing function. As for the cleaning power, after using it for a while, I concluded that it is better than the countertop. Above all, there are no water marks on the door. When it's done, the door opens wide. I open it so that no dust will get in, and when I take out all the shelves, if I spill water, water will splash on the door, and if I don't wipe it right away, marks will form right away (when using the countertop). This one cleans well. I wondered why it didn't clean, but this one cleans cleanly when I use the same detergent. It's a bit difficult to use it once every two days, but I'm getting used to it and using it well! ^^

저도 그거 못견디는 1인인데, 싱크대안 그릇건조? 하는 그 스텐망을 통째로 넣어보라 하시더라구요, 전 그거 걸리적거려서 늘 갖다버렸는데 앗 하고는 쿠팡 새벽배송으로 방금 도착했어욤ㅎㅎ 맨밑에 1단을 빼서 옆에 두고 해보니 그것도 나쁘진 않으나 너무커서 무겁고 불편하네요ㅋ  저희 식구들에겐 넘 빅사이즈라 하루 한번도 못돌리는 곤란한 사이즈에 보이지 않는 코스는 정말 별로인데 카운터탑보다 훨~~~씬 조용해요ㅎㅎㅎ 소음은 거의 없어서 좋네요, 33평에선 카운터탑 돌려두면 온집에 윙윙 했거든요,  여튼 집안 상황따라 설치를 신중히 고민하시고 구매하시길 바랍니다요 ㅎㅎ 제기준엔 비싼 가격이라^^;  // 다들 말하잖아요, 가전은 무조건 최고로 큰놈으로다가!!! 예... 형편껏 젤큰놈! 맞네요, 그랬어요 맞는말씀들!ㅋ 비스포크 카운터탑은 코팅 냄비-팬은 약간 상하는것 같던데 이건 그렇지않아요, 물살이 더 쎄서 그런지 우짠지~  작은 망 2개를 사서 씽크대에 두고 1차세척 후에 또는 세척함서 세재 묻힌채로 요래조래 1층에 두개를 넣고 2층엔 큰접시나 냄비 정도를 넣어요, 3층은 조리도구 넣으라시던데 갠적으로는 너무 낮아서 과도나 주걱 정도는 모를까..눕혀도 눕혀도 걸립니다, 저희집 뒤집개조차 안되더라고요ㅋ 만든사람은 살림 안해보셨나... 생각도 잠시 했구만요ㅋ 세재 묻힌때는 나름 급속으로 해도 표준이랑 10분밖에 차이가 안나요, 덩치가 있어 그런가 금방은 끝낼수없나보다 했는데 헹굼만 따로 없는게 너무너무너무 아쉽네요.  세정력 부분은 얼마간 써보니 카운터탑 보다는 좋다는 결론예요 무엇보다 문짝에 물자국이 안생겨요 다되고 나면 문이 빼꼼 열리거든요, 먼지도 안들가겠다싶게ㅋ 열어서 선반 다 빼면서 혹시라도 고인물 뒤집어빼면 문짝에 물튀고 바로 못닦는날은 금방 자국되고 그랬는데(카운터탑때) 이건 잘닦이네요, 그게 안닦이고 그래서 뭐지 했는데 같은세재 쓰는데 얘는 깔끔하게 처리됩니다요ㅎㅎ  이틀에 한번 돌리다시피 해서 좀 버겁지만 적응해감서 잘쓰고있는 중입니다!^^

I have to pour a lot of detergent -_-;; I saw this tip from a housekeeper on YouTube, but when we do the first wash and put the dishwasher in, water + detergent, etc. run down for a moment, right? I'm one of those people who can't stand that, but drying dishes in the sink? He told me to put the entire stainless steel net in, I always threw it away because it was in the way, but oh, it just arrived with Coupang's early morning delivery. I took out the bottom one and put it next to me, and it wasn't bad, but it's too big, so it's heavy and uncomfortable. It's too big for my family, so it's an inconvenient size that I can't turn it even once a day, and the invisible course is really not good, but it's much~~~ quieter than a countertop. It's nice because there's almost no noise. In my 33 pyeong house, when I turned the countertop, it made a buzzing sound throughout the house. Anyway, I hope you think carefully about the installation depending on your household situation and then buy it. It's expensive by my standards^^; // As everyone says, when it comes to appliances, you should definitely get the biggest one! Yes. The biggest one you can afford! That's right, that's right! Bespoke countertops seem to damage coated pots and pans a little, but this one doesn't. I don't know if it's because the water current is stronger or what~ I bought two small nets and put them on the sink, and after the first wash or while washing, I put two on the first floor with detergent on them and put large plates or pots on the second floor. The third floor is supposed to be for cooking utensils, but personally, it's so low that I don't know about a spatula or a fork. It gets caught even when I lay it down. Even my spatula didn't work. Did the person who made it never do housework? I thought about it for a moment. When detergent is on, it only takes 10 minutes compared to the standard time even if I speed it up. I thought it wouldn't be able to finish it quickly because it's big, but it's so, so, so disappointing that there's no separate rinsing function. As for the cleaning power, after using it for a while, I concluded that it is better than the countertop. Above all, there are no water marks on the door. When it's done, the door opens wide. I open it so that no dust will get in, and when I take out all the shelves, if I spill water, water will splash on the door, and if I don't wipe it right away, marks will form right away (when using the countertop). This one cleans well. I wondered why it didn't clean, but this one cleans cleanly when I use the same detergent. It's a bit difficult to use it once every two days, but I'm getting used to it and using it well! ^^

I have to pour a lot of detergent -_-;; I saw this tip from a housekeeper on YouTube, but when we do the first wash and put the dishwasher in, water + detergent, etc. run down for a moment, right? I'm one of those people who can't stand that, but drying dishes in the sink? He told me to put the entire stainless steel net in, I always threw it away because it was in the way, but oh, it just arrived with Coupang's early morning delivery. I took out the bottom one and put it next to me, and it wasn't bad, but it's too big, so it's heavy and uncomfortable. It's too big for my family, so it's an inconvenient size that I can't turn it even once a day, and the invisible course is really not good, but it's much~~~ quieter than a countertop. Anyway, I hope you think carefully about the installation depending on your household situation and then buy it. It's expensive by my standards^^; // As everyone says, when it comes to appliances, you should definitely get the biggest one! Yes. The biggest one you can afford! That's right, that's right! Bespoke countertops seem to damage coated pots and pans a little, but this one doesn't. I don't know if it's because the water current is stronger or what~ I bought two small nets and put them on the sink, and after the first wash or while washing, I put two on the first floor with detergent on them and put large plates or pots on the second floor. Did the person who made it never do housework? I thought about it for a moment. When detergent is on, it only takes 10 minutes compared to the standard time even if I speed it up. I thought it wouldn't be able to finish it quickly because it's big, but it's so, so, so disappointing that there's no separate rinsing function. As for the cleaning power, after using it for a while, I concluded that it is better than the countertop. Above all, there are no water marks on the door. When it's done, the door opens wide. I open it so that no dust will get in, and when I take out all the shelves, if I spill water, water will splash on the door, and if I don't wipe it right away, marks will form right away (when using the countertop). This one cleans well. I wondered why it didn't clean, but this one cleans cleanly when I use the same detergent. It's a bit difficult to use it once every two days, but I'm getting used to it and using it well! ^^

저도 그거 못견디는 1인인데, 싱크대안 그릇건조? 하는 그 스텐망을 통째로 넣어보라 하시더라구요, 전 그거 걸리적거려서 늘 갖다버렸는데 앗 하고는 쿠팡 새벽배송으로 방금 도착했어욤ㅎㅎ 맨밑에 1단을 빼서 옆에 두고 해보니 그것도 나쁘진 않으나 너무커서 무겁고 불편하네요ㅋ  저희 식구들에겐 넘 빅사이즈라 하루 한번도 못돌리는 곤란한 사이즈에 보이지 않는 코스는 정말 별로인데 카운터탑보다 훨~~~씬 조용해요ㅎㅎㅎ 소음은 거의 없어서 좋네요, 33평에선 카운터탑 돌려두면 온집에 윙윙 했거든요,  여튼 집안 상황따라 설치를 신중히 고민하시고 구매하시길 바랍니다요 ㅎㅎ 제기준엔 비싼 가격이라^^;  // 다들 말하잖아요, 가전은 무조건 최고로 큰놈으로다가!!! 예... 형편껏 젤큰놈! 맞네요, 그랬어요 맞는말씀들!ㅋ 비스포크 카운터탑은 코팅 냄비-팬은 약간 상하는것 같던데 이건 그렇지않아요, 물살이 더 쎄서 그런지 우짠지~  작은 망 2개를 사서 씽크대에 두고 1차세척 후에 또는 세척함서 세재 묻힌채로 요래조래 1층에 두개를 넣고 2층엔 큰접시나 냄비 정도를 넣어요, 3층은 조리도구 넣으라시던데 갠적으로는 너무 낮아서 과도나 주걱 정도는 모를까..눕혀도 눕혀도 걸립니다, 저희집 뒤집개조차 안되더라고요ㅋ 만든사람은 살림 안해보셨나... 생각도 잠시 했구만요ㅋ 세재 묻힌때는 나름 급속으로 해도 표준이랑 10분밖에 차이가 안나요, 덩치가 있어 그런가 금방은 끝낼수없나보다 했는데 헹굼만 따로 없는게 너무너무너무 아쉽네요.  세정력 부분은 얼마간 써보니 카운터탑 보다는 좋다는 결론예요 무엇보다 문짝에 물자국이 안생겨요 다되고 나면 문이 빼꼼 열리거든요, 먼지도 안들가겠다싶게ㅋ 열어서 선반 다 빼면서 혹시라도 고인물 뒤집어빼면 문짝에 물튀고 바로 못닦는날은 금방 자국되고 그랬는데(카운터탑때) 이건 잘닦이네요, 그게 안닦이고 그래서 뭐지 했는데 같은세재 쓰는데 얘는 깔끔하게 처리됩니다요ㅎㅎ  이틀에 한번 돌리다시피 해서 좀 버겁지만 적응해감서 잘쓰고있는 중입니다!^^
