Comments (English): <Additional review after a few weeks of use> Previously, we were using a bespoke countertop. We are a family of 4, 1 cat, for a total of 5 people. We don't eat much and don't eat side dishes at all. We only use chopsticks when necessary. We also don't eat much, so it's a bit ambiguous. The size of the countertop was just right for our dishwasher, but when we moved this time, we bought it to match the size that was already there. It was too expensive for my standards, so I was going to buy an LG, but when we moved and reduced the square footage from 33 to 25, I was scared because of the different brands of washing machines and dryers. Since the dryer is Samsung, it went up in a row, and at that time, I was impressed by the hard work of the Sam Song Man and shouted, "Sam Song is the best!" and bought a Samsung. Two days after purchasing it? The interior designer made an appointment to check the installation location and situation and checked it thoroughly. It was the weekend, but they came to install it on Monday. Two people came, and one of them did most of the work and the other one seemed to be a young person learning. They told me about various things about my sink that I didn't know about, took measures, and installed it thoroughly. It's so big that I was surprised. The interior is very spacious. Pots and frying pans come out with every meal, and it's convenient to put them in, but I don't know about the cleaning power because I usually wipe it with a basic dishwashing sponge. However, there are a few inconvenient points! First of all, the LCD screen is not visible. It's so inconvenient. You can't see what it's doing. I didn't see it closely, but it's hard to believe-_-;; I want to use it without the drying function, because it eats up all the electricity. But you can't set it separately. Power drying! You can cancel it. Even if you cancel it at the end, you have to see what step it is. Of course, if you just open it, it's written above, but only the sign that it's open appears in the middle, so when you close it, it turns on its own again, and that's not a secret. I use Coupang's powdered dishwashing detergent because it has the best cleaning power, so I don't use liquid or tablets, but if I don't put in rinse, the water just puddles up, so I have no choice but to use rinse, but it's annoying. I have to pour a lot of detergent -_-;; I saw this tip from a housekeeper on YouTube, but when we do the first wash and put the dishwasher in, water + detergent, etc. run down for a moment, right? I'm one of those people who can't stand that, but drying dishes in the sink? He told me to put the entire stainless steel net in, I always threw it away because it was in the way, but oh, it just arrived with Coupang's early morning delivery. I took out the bottom one and put it next to me, and it wasn't bad, but it's too big, so it's heavy and uncomfortable. It's too big for my family, so it's an inconvenient size that I can't turn it even once a day, and the invisible course is really not good, but it's much~~~ quieter than a countertop. It's nice because there's almost no noise. In my 33 pyeong house, when I turned the countertop, it made a buzzing sound throughout the house. Anyway, I hope you think carefully about the installation depending on your household situation and then buy it. It's expensive by my standards^^; // As everyone says, when it comes to appliances, you should definitely get the biggest one! Yes. The biggest one you can afford! That's right, that's right! Bespoke countertops seem to damage coated pots and pans a little, but this one doesn't. I don't know if it's because the water current is stronger or what~ I bought two small nets and put them on the sink, and after the first wash or while washing, I put two on the first floor with detergent on them and put large plates or pots on the second floor. The third floor is supposed to be for cooking utensils, but personally, it's so low that I don't know about a spatula or a fork. It gets caught even when I lay it down. Even my spatula didn't work. Did the person who made it never do housework? I thought about it for a moment. When detergent is on, it only takes 10 minutes compared to the standard time even if I speed it up. I thought it wouldn't be able to finish it quickly because it's big, but it's so, so, so disappointing that there's no separate rinsing function. As for the cleaning power, after using it for a while, I concluded that it is better than the countertop. Above all, there are no water marks on the door. When it's done, the door opens wide. I open it so that no dust will get in, and when I take out all the shelves, if I spill water, water will splash on the door, and if I don't wipe it right away, marks will form right away (when using the countertop). This one cleans well. I wondered why it didn't clean, but this one cleans cleanly when I use the same detergent. It's a bit difficult to use it once every two days, but I'm getting used to it and using it well! ^^

저도 그거 못견디는 1인인데, 싱크대안 그릇건조? 하는 그 스텐망을 통째로 넣어보라 하시더라구요, 전 그거 걸리적거려서 늘 갖다버렸는데 앗 하고는 쿠팡 새벽배송으로 방금 도착했어욤ㅎㅎ 맨밑에 1단을 빼서 옆에 두고 해보니 그것도 나쁘진 않으나 너무커서 무겁고 불편하네요ㅋ  저희 식구들에겐 넘 빅사이즈라 하루 한번도 못돌리는 곤란한 사이즈에 보이지 않는 코스는 정말 별로인데 카운터탑보다 훨~~~씬 조용해요ㅎㅎㅎ 소음은 거의 없어서 좋네요, 33평에선 카운터탑 돌려두면 온집에 윙윙 했거든요,  여튼 집안 상황따라 설치를 신중히 고민하시고 구매하시길 바랍니다요 ㅎㅎ 제기준엔 비싼 가격이라^^;  // 다들 말하잖아요, 가전은 무조건 최고로 큰놈으로다가!!! 예... 형편껏 젤큰놈! 맞네요, 그랬어요 맞는말씀들!ㅋ 비스포크 카운터탑은 코팅 냄비-팬은 약간 상하는것 같던데 이건 그렇지않아요, 물살이 더 쎄서 그런지 우짠지~  작은 망 2개를 사서 씽크대에 두고 1차세척 후에 또는 세척함서 세재 묻힌채로 요래조래 1층에 두개를 넣고 2층엔 큰접시나 냄비 정도를 넣어요, 3층은 조리도구 넣으라시던데 갠적으로는 너무 낮아서 과도나 주걱 정도는 모를까..눕혀도 눕혀도 걸립니다, 저희집 뒤집개조차 안되더라고요ㅋ 만든사람은 살림 안해보셨나... 생각도 잠시 했구만요ㅋ 세재 묻힌때는 나름 급속으로 해도 표준이랑 10분밖에 차이가 안나요, 덩치가 있어 그런가 금방은 끝낼수없나보다 했는데 헹굼만 따로 없는게 너무너무너무 아쉽네요.  세정력 부분은 얼마간 써보니 카운터탑 보다는 좋다는 결론예요 무엇보다 문짝에 물자국이 안생겨요 다되고 나면 문이 빼꼼 열리거든요, 먼지도 안들가겠다싶게ㅋ 열어서 선반 다 빼면서 혹시라도 고인물 뒤집어빼면 문짝에 물튀고 바로 못닦는날은 금방 자국되고 그랬는데(카운터탑때) 이건 잘닦이네요, 그게 안닦이고 그래서 뭐지 했는데 같은세재 쓰는데 얘는 깔끔하게 처리됩니다요ㅎㅎ  이틀에 한번 돌리다시피 해서 좀 버겁지만 적응해감서 잘쓰고있는 중입니다!^^

Comments (English): <Additional review after a few weeks of use> Previously, we were using a bespoke countertop. We are a family of 4, 1 cat, for a total of 5 people. We don't eat much and don't eat side dishes at all. We only use chopsticks when necessary. We also don't eat much, so it's a bit ambiguous. The size of the countertop was just right for our dishwasher, but when we moved this time, we bought it to match the size that was already there. It was too expensive for my standards, so I was going to buy an LG, but when we moved and reduced the square footage from 33 to 25, I was scared because of the different brands of washing machines and dryers. Since the dryer is Samsung, it went up in a row, and at that time, I was impressed by the hard work of the Sam Song Man and shouted, "Sam Song is the best!" and bought a Samsung. Two days after purchasing it? The interior designer made an appointment to check the installation location and situation and checked it thoroughly. It was the weekend, but they came to install it on Monday. Two people came, and one of them did most of the work and the other one seemed to be a young person learning. They told me about various things about my sink that I didn't know about, took measures, and installed it thoroughly. It's so big that I was surprised. The interior is very spacious. Pots and frying pans come out with every meal, and it's convenient to put them in, but I don't know about the cleaning power because I usually wipe it with a basic dishwashing sponge. However, there are a few inconvenient points! First of all, the LCD screen is not visible. It's so inconvenient. You can't see what it's doing. I didn't see it closely, but it's hard to believe-_-;; I want to use it without the drying function, because it eats up all the electricity. But you can't set it separately. Power drying! You can cancel it. Even if you cancel it at the end, you have to see what step it is. Of course, if you just open it, it's written above, but only the sign that it's open appears in the middle, so when you close it, it turns on its own again, and that's not a secret. I use Coupang's powdered dishwashing detergent because it has the best cleaning power, so I don't use liquid or tablets, but if I don't put in rinse, the water just puddles up, so I have no choice but to use rinse, but it's annoying. I have to pour a lot of detergent -_-;; I saw this tip from a housekeeper on YouTube, but when we do the first wash and put the dishwasher in, water + detergent, etc. run down for a moment, right? I'm one of those people who can't stand that, but drying dishes in the sink? He told me to put the entire stainless steel net in, I always threw it away because it was in the way, but oh, it just arrived with Coupang's early morning delivery. I took out the bottom one and put it next to me, and it wasn't bad, but it's too big, so it's heavy and uncomfortable. It's too big for my family, so it's an inconvenient size that I can't turn it even once a day, and the invisible course is really not good, but it's much~~~ quieter than a countertop. It's nice because there's almost no noise. In my 33 pyeong house, when I turned the countertop, it made a buzzing sound throughout the house. Anyway, I hope you think carefully about the installation depending on your household situation and then buy it. It's expensive by my standards^^; // As everyone says, when it comes to appliances, you should definitely get the biggest one! Yes. The biggest one you can afford! That's right, that's right! Bespoke countertops seem to damage coated pots and pans a little, but this one doesn't. I don't know if it's because the water current is stronger or what~ I bought two small nets and put them on the sink, and after the first wash or while washing, I put two on the first floor with detergent on them and put large plates or pots on the second floor. The third floor is supposed to be for cooking utensils, but personally, it's so low that I don't know about a spatula or a fork. It gets caught even when I lay it down. Even my spatula didn't work. Did the person who made it never do housework? I thought about it for a moment. When detergent is on, it only takes 10 minutes compared to the standard time even if I speed it up. I thought it wouldn't be able to finish it quickly because it's big, but it's so, so, so disappointing that there's no separate rinsing function. As for the cleaning power, after using it for a while, I concluded that it is better than the countertop. Above all, there are no water marks on the door. When it's done, the door opens wide. I open it so that no dust will get in, and when I take out all the shelves, if I spill water, water will splash on the door, and if I don't wipe it right away, marks will form right away (when using the countertop). This one cleans well. I wondered why it didn't clean, but this one cleans cleanly when I use the same detergent. It's a bit difficult to use it once every two days, but I'm getting used to it and using it well! ^^

저도 그거 못견디는 1인인데, 싱크대안 그릇건조? 하는 그 스텐망을 통째로 넣어보라 하시더라구요, 전 그거 걸리적거려서 늘 갖다버렸는데 앗 하고는 쿠팡 새벽배송으로 방금 도착했어욤ㅎㅎ 맨밑에 1단을 빼서 옆에 두고 해보니 그것도 나쁘진 않으나 너무커서 무겁고 불편하네요ㅋ  저희 식구들에겐 넘 빅사이즈라 하루 한번도 못돌리는 곤란한 사이즈에 보이지 않는 코스는 정말 별로인데 카운터탑보다 훨~~~씬 조용해요ㅎㅎㅎ 소음은 거의 없어서 좋네요, 33평에선 카운터탑 돌려두면 온집에 윙윙 했거든요,  여튼 집안 상황따라 설치를 신중히 고민하시고 구매하시길 바랍니다요 ㅎㅎ 제기준엔 비싼 가격이라^^;  // 다들 말하잖아요, 가전은 무조건 최고로 큰놈으로다가!!! 예... 형편껏 젤큰놈! 맞네요, 그랬어요 맞는말씀들!ㅋ 비스포크 카운터탑은 코팅 냄비-팬은 약간 상하는것 같던데 이건 그렇지않아요, 물살이 더 쎄서 그런지 우짠지~  작은 망 2개를 사서 씽크대에 두고 1차세척 후에 또는 세척함서 세재 묻힌채로 요래조래 1층에 두개를 넣고 2층엔 큰접시나 냄비 정도를 넣어요, 3층은 조리도구 넣으라시던데 갠적으로는 너무 낮아서 과도나 주걱 정도는 모를까..눕혀도 눕혀도 걸립니다, 저희집 뒤집개조차 안되더라고요ㅋ 만든사람은 살림 안해보셨나... 생각도 잠시 했구만요ㅋ 세재 묻힌때는 나름 급속으로 해도 표준이랑 10분밖에 차이가 안나요, 덩치가 있어 그런가 금방은 끝낼수없나보다 했는데 헹굼만 따로 없는게 너무너무너무 아쉽네요.  세정력 부분은 얼마간 써보니 카운터탑 보다는 좋다는 결론예요 무엇보다 문짝에 물자국이 안생겨요 다되고 나면 문이 빼꼼 열리거든요, 먼지도 안들가겠다싶게ㅋ 열어서 선반 다 빼면서 혹시라도 고인물 뒤집어빼면 문짝에 물튀고 바로 못닦는날은 금방 자국되고 그랬는데(카운터탑때) 이건 잘닦이네요, 그게 안닦이고 그래서 뭐지 했는데 같은세재 쓰는데 얘는 깔끔하게 처리됩니다요ㅎㅎ  이틀에 한번 돌리다시피 해서 좀 버겁지만 적응해감서 잘쓰고있는 중입니다!^^

Comments (English): <Additional review after a few weeks of use> Previously, we were using a bespoke countertop. We are a family of 4, 1 cat, for a total of 5 people. We don't eat much and don't eat side dishes at all. We only use chopsticks when necessary. We also don't eat much, so it's a bit ambiguous. The size of the countertop was just right for our dishwasher, but when we moved this time, we bought it to match the size that was already there. It was too expensive for my standards, so I was going to buy an LG, but when we moved and reduced the square footage from 33 to 25, I was scared because of the different brands of washing machines and dryers. Since the dryer is Samsung, it went up in a row, and at that time, I was impressed by the hard work of the Sam Song Man and shouted, "Sam Song is the best!" and bought a Samsung. Two days after purchasing it? The interior designer made an appointment to check the installation location and situation and checked it thoroughly. It was the weekend, but they came to install it on Monday. Two people came, and one of them did most of the work and the other one seemed to be a young person learning. They told me about various things about my sink that I didn't know about, took measures, and installed it thoroughly. It's so big that I was surprised. The interior is very spacious. Pots and frying pans come out with every meal, and it's convenient to put them in, but I don't know about the cleaning power because I usually wipe it with a basic dishwashing sponge. However, there are a few inconvenient points! First of all, the LCD screen is not visible. It's so inconvenient. You can't see what it's doing. I didn't see it closely, but it's hard to believe-_-;; I want to use it without the drying function, because it eats up all the electricity. But you can't set it separately. Power drying! You can cancel it. Even if you cancel it at the end, you have to see what step it is. Of course, if you just open it, it's written above, but only the sign that it's open appears in the middle, so when you close it, it turns on its own again, and that's not a secret. I use Coupang's powdered dishwashing detergent because it has the best cleaning power, so I don't use liquid or tablets, but if I don't put in rinse, the water just puddles up, so I have no choice but to use rinse, but it's annoying. I have to pour a lot of detergent -_-;; I saw this tip from a housekeeper on YouTube, but when we do the first wash and put the dishwasher in, water + detergent, etc. run down for a moment, right? I'm one of those people who can't stand that, but drying dishes in the sink? He told me to put the entire stainless steel net in, I always threw it away because it was in the way, but oh, it just arrived with Coupang's early morning delivery. I took out the bottom one and put it next to me, and it wasn't bad, but it's too big, so it's heavy and uncomfortable. It's too big for my family, so it's an inconvenient size that I can't turn it even once a day, and the invisible course is really not good, but it's much~~~ quieter than a countertop. It's nice because there's almost no noise. In my 33 pyeong house, when I turned the countertop, it made a buzzing sound throughout the house. Anyway, I hope you think carefully about the installation depending on your household situation and then buy it. It's expensive by my standards^^; // As everyone says, when it comes to appliances, you should definitely get the biggest one! Yes. The biggest one you can afford! That's right, that's right! Bespoke countertops seem to damage coated pots and pans a little, but this one doesn't. I don't know if it's because the water current is stronger or what~ I bought two small nets and put them on the sink, and after the first wash or while washing, I put two on the first floor with detergent on them and put large plates or pots on the second floor. The third floor is supposed to be for cooking utensils, but personally, it's so low that I don't know about a spatula or a fork. It gets caught even when I lay it down. Even my spatula didn't work. Did the person who made it never do housework? I thought about it for a moment. When detergent is on, it only takes 10 minutes compared to the standard time even if I speed it up. I thought it wouldn't be able to finish it quickly because it's big, but it's so, so, so disappointing that there's no separate rinsing function. As for the cleaning power, after using it for a while, I concluded that it is better than the countertop. Above all, there are no water marks on the door. When it's done, the door opens wide. I open it so that no dust will get in, and when I take out all the shelves, if I spill water, water will splash on the door, and if I don't wipe it right away, marks will form right away (when using the countertop). This one cleans well. I wondered why it didn't clean, but this one cleans cleanly when I use the same detergent. It's a bit difficult to use it once every two days, but I'm getting used to it and using it well! ^^

저도 그거 못견디는 1인인데, 싱크대안 그릇건조? 하는 그 스텐망을 통째로 넣어보라 하시더라구요, 전 그거 걸리적거려서 늘 갖다버렸는데 앗 하고는 쿠팡 새벽배송으로 방금 도착했어욤ㅎㅎ 맨밑에 1단을 빼서 옆에 두고 해보니 그것도 나쁘진 않으나 너무커서 무겁고 불편하네요ㅋ  저희 식구들에겐 넘 빅사이즈라 하루 한번도 못돌리는 곤란한 사이즈에 보이지 않는 코스는 정말 별로인데 카운터탑보다 훨~~~씬 조용해요ㅎㅎㅎ 소음은 거의 없어서 좋네요, 33평에선 카운터탑 돌려두면 온집에 윙윙 했거든요,  여튼 집안 상황따라 설치를 신중히 고민하시고 구매하시길 바랍니다요 ㅎㅎ 제기준엔 비싼 가격이라^^;  // 다들 말하잖아요, 가전은 무조건 최고로 큰놈으로다가!!! 예... 형편껏 젤큰놈! 맞네요, 그랬어요 맞는말씀들!ㅋ 비스포크 카운터탑은 코팅 냄비-팬은 약간 상하는것 같던데 이건 그렇지않아요, 물살이 더 쎄서 그런지 우짠지~  작은 망 2개를 사서 씽크대에 두고 1차세척 후에 또는 세척함서 세재 묻힌채로 요래조래 1층에 두개를 넣고 2층엔 큰접시나 냄비 정도를 넣어요, 3층은 조리도구 넣으라시던데 갠적으로는 너무 낮아서 과도나 주걱 정도는 모를까..눕혀도 눕혀도 걸립니다, 저희집 뒤집개조차 안되더라고요ㅋ 만든사람은 살림 안해보셨나... 생각도 잠시 했구만요ㅋ 세재 묻힌때는 나름 급속으로 해도 표준이랑 10분밖에 차이가 안나요, 덩치가 있어 그런가 금방은 끝낼수없나보다 했는데 헹굼만 따로 없는게 너무너무너무 아쉽네요.  세정력 부분은 얼마간 써보니 카운터탑 보다는 좋다는 결론예요 무엇보다 문짝에 물자국이 안생겨요 다되고 나면 문이 빼꼼 열리거든요, 먼지도 안들가겠다싶게ㅋ 열어서 선반 다 빼면서 혹시라도 고인물 뒤집어빼면 문짝에 물튀고 바로 못닦는날은 금방 자국되고 그랬는데(카운터탑때) 이건 잘닦이네요, 그게 안닦이고 그래서 뭐지 했는데 같은세재 쓰는데 얘는 깔끔하게 처리됩니다요ㅎㅎ  이틀에 한번 돌리다시피 해서 좀 버겁지만 적응해감서 잘쓰고있는 중입니다!^^

저도 그거 못견디는 1인인데, 싱크대안 그릇건조? 하는 그 스텐망을 통째로 넣어보라 하시더라구요, 전 그거 걸리적거려서 늘 갖다버렸는데 앗 하고는 쿠팡 새벽배송으로 방금 도착했어욤ㅎㅎ 맨밑에 1단을 빼서 옆에 두고 해보니 그것도 나쁘진 않으나 너무커서 무겁고 불편하네요ㅋ  저희 식구들에겐 넘 빅사이즈라 하루 한번도 못돌리는 곤란한 사이즈에 보이지 않는 코스는 정말 별로인데 카운터탑보다 훨~~~씬 조용해요ㅎㅎㅎ 소음은 거의 없어서 좋네요, 33평에선 카운터탑 돌려두면 온집에 윙윙 했거든요,  여튼 집안 상황따라 설치를 신중히 고민하시고 구매하시길 바랍니다요 ㅎㅎ 제기준엔 비싼 가격이라^^;  // 다들 말하잖아요, 가전은 무조건 최고로 큰놈으로다가!!! 예... 형편껏 젤큰놈! 맞네요, 그랬어요 맞는말씀들!ㅋ 비스포크 카운터탑은 코팅 냄비-팬은 약간 상하는것 같던데 이건 그렇지않아요, 물살이 더 쎄서 그런지 우짠지~  작은 망 2개를 사서 씽크대에 두고 1차세척 후에 또는 세척함서 세재 묻힌채로 요래조래 1층에 두개를 넣고 2층엔 큰접시나 냄비 정도를 넣어요, 3층은 조리도구 넣으라시던데 갠적으로는 너무 낮아서 과도나 주걱 정도는 모를까..눕혀도 눕혀도 걸립니다, 저희집 뒤집개조차 안되더라고요ㅋ 만든사람은 살림 안해보셨나... 생각도 잠시 했구만요ㅋ 세재 묻힌때는 나름 급속으로 해도 표준이랑 10분밖에 차이가 안나요, 덩치가 있어 그런가 금방은 끝낼수없나보다 했는데 헹굼만 따로 없는게 너무너무너무 아쉽네요.  세정력 부분은 얼마간 써보니 카운터탑 보다는 좋다는 결론예요 무엇보다 문짝에 물자국이 안생겨요 다되고 나면 문이 빼꼼 열리거든요, 먼지도 안들가겠다싶게ㅋ 열어서 선반 다 빼면서 혹시라도 고인물 뒤집어빼면 문짝에 물튀고 바로 못닦는날은 금방 자국되고 그랬는데(카운터탑때) 이건 잘닦이네요, 그게 안닦이고 그래서 뭐지 했는데 같은세재 쓰는데 얘는 깔끔하게 처리됩니다요ㅎㅎ  이틀에 한번 돌리다시피 해서 좀 버겁지만 적응해감서 잘쓰고있는 중입니다!^^

It was the weekend, but they came to install it on Monday. Two people came, and one of them did most of the work and the other one seemed to be a young person learning. I didn't see it closely, but it's hard to believe-_-;; I want to use it without the drying function, because it eats up all the electricity. But you can't set it separately. Power drying! You can cancel it. Even if you cancel it at the end, you have to see what step it is. Of course, if you just open it, it's written above, but only the sign that it's open appears in the middle, so when you close it, it turns on its own again, and that's not a secret. I use Coupang's powdered dishwashing detergent because it has the best cleaning power, so I don't use liquid or tablets, but if I don't put in rinse, the water just puddles up, so I have no choice but to use rinse, but it's annoying. I have to pour a lot of detergent -_-;; I saw this tip from a housekeeper on YouTube, but when we do the first wash and put the dishwasher in, water + detergent, etc. run down for a moment, right? I'm one of those people who can't stand that, but drying dishes in the sink? He told me to put the entire stainless steel net in, I always threw it away because it was in the way, but oh, it just arrived with Coupang's early morning delivery. I took out the bottom one and put it next to me, and it wasn't bad, but it's too big, so it's heavy and uncomfortable. It's too big for my family, so it's an inconvenient size that I can't turn it even once a day, and the invisible course is really not good, but it's much~~~ quieter than a countertop. It's nice because there's almost no noise. In my 33 pyeong house, when I turned the countertop, it made a buzzing sound throughout the house. Anyway, I hope you think carefully about the installation depending on your household situation and then buy it. It's expensive by my standards^^; // As everyone says, when it comes to appliances, you should definitely get the biggest one! Yes. The biggest one you can afford! That's right, that's right! Bespoke countertops seem to damage coated pots and pans a little, but this one doesn't. I don't know if it's because the water current is stronger or what~ I bought two small nets and put them on the sink, and after the first wash or while washing, I put two on the first floor with detergent on them and put large plates or pots on the second floor. The third floor is supposed to be for cooking utensils, but personally, it's so low that I don't know about a spatula or a fork. It gets caught even when I lay it down. Even my spatula didn't work. Did the person who made it never do housework? I thought about it for a moment. When detergent is on, it only takes 10 minutes compared to the standard time even if I speed it up. I thought it wouldn't be able to finish it quickly because it's big, but it's so, so, so disappointing that there's no separate rinsing function. As for the cleaning power, after using it for a while, I concluded that it is better than the countertop. Above all, there are no water marks on the door. When it's done, the door opens wide. I open it so that no dust will get in, and when I take out all the shelves, if I spill water, water will splash on the door, and if I don't wipe it right away, marks will form right away (when using the countertop). This one cleans well. I wondered why it didn't clean, but this one cleans cleanly when I use the same detergent. It's a bit difficult to use it once every two days, but I'm getting used to it and using it well! ^^

저도 그거 못견디는 1인인데, 싱크대안 그릇건조? 하는 그 스텐망을 통째로 넣어보라 하시더라구요, 전 그거 걸리적거려서 늘 갖다버렸는데 앗 하고는 쿠팡 새벽배송으로 방금 도착했어욤ㅎㅎ 맨밑에 1단을 빼서 옆에 두고 해보니 그것도 나쁘진 않으나 너무커서 무겁고 불편하네요ㅋ  저희 식구들에겐 넘 빅사이즈라 하루 한번도 못돌리는 곤란한 사이즈에 보이지 않는 코스는 정말 별로인데 카운터탑보다 훨~~~씬 조용해요ㅎㅎㅎ 소음은 거의 없어서 좋네요, 33평에선 카운터탑 돌려두면 온집에 윙윙 했거든요,  여튼 집안 상황따라 설치를 신중히 고민하시고 구매하시길 바랍니다요 ㅎㅎ 제기준엔 비싼 가격이라^^;  // 다들 말하잖아요, 가전은 무조건 최고로 큰놈으로다가!!! 예... 형편껏 젤큰놈! 맞네요, 그랬어요 맞는말씀들!ㅋ 비스포크 카운터탑은 코팅 냄비-팬은 약간 상하는것 같던데 이건 그렇지않아요, 물살이 더 쎄서 그런지 우짠지~  작은 망 2개를 사서 씽크대에 두고 1차세척 후에 또는 세척함서 세재 묻힌채로 요래조래 1층에 두개를 넣고 2층엔 큰접시나 냄비 정도를 넣어요, 3층은 조리도구 넣으라시던데 갠적으로는 너무 낮아서 과도나 주걱 정도는 모를까..눕혀도 눕혀도 걸립니다, 저희집 뒤집개조차 안되더라고요ㅋ 만든사람은 살림 안해보셨나... 생각도 잠시 했구만요ㅋ 세재 묻힌때는 나름 급속으로 해도 표준이랑 10분밖에 차이가 안나요, 덩치가 있어 그런가 금방은 끝낼수없나보다 했는데 헹굼만 따로 없는게 너무너무너무 아쉽네요.  세정력 부분은 얼마간 써보니 카운터탑 보다는 좋다는 결론예요 무엇보다 문짝에 물자국이 안생겨요 다되고 나면 문이 빼꼼 열리거든요, 먼지도 안들가겠다싶게ㅋ 열어서 선반 다 빼면서 혹시라도 고인물 뒤집어빼면 문짝에 물튀고 바로 못닦는날은 금방 자국되고 그랬는데(카운터탑때) 이건 잘닦이네요, 그게 안닦이고 그래서 뭐지 했는데 같은세재 쓰는데 얘는 깔끔하게 처리됩니다요ㅎㅎ  이틀에 한번 돌리다시피 해서 좀 버겁지만 적응해감서 잘쓰고있는 중입니다!^^

Comments (English): <Additional review after a few weeks of use> Previously, we were using a bespoke countertop. We are a family of 4, 1 cat, for a total of 5 people. We don't eat much and don't eat side dishes at all. We only use chopsticks when necessary. We also don't eat much, so it's a bit ambiguous. The size of the countertop was just right for our dishwasher, but when we moved this time, we bought it to match the size that was already there. It was too expensive for my standards, so I was going to buy an LG, but when we moved and reduced the square footage from 33 to 25, I was scared because of the different brands of washing machines and dryers. Since the dryer is Samsung, it went up in a row, and at that time, I was impressed by the hard work of the Sam Song Man and shouted, "Sam Song is the best!" and bought a Samsung. Two days after purchasing it? The interior designer made an appointment to check the installation location and situation and checked it thoroughly. It was the weekend, but they came to install it on Monday. Two people came, and one of them did most of the work and the other one seemed to be a young person learning. They told me about various things about my sink that I didn't know about, took measures, and installed it thoroughly. It's so big that I was surprised. The interior is very spacious. Pots and frying pans come out with every meal, and it's convenient to put them in, but I don't know about the cleaning power because I usually wipe it with a basic dishwashing sponge. However, there are a few inconvenient points! First of all, the LCD screen is not visible. It's so inconvenient. You can't see what it's doing. I didn't see it closely, but it's hard to believe-_-;; I want to use it without the drying function, because it eats up all the electricity. But you can't set it separately. Power drying! You can cancel it. Even if you cancel it at the end, you have to see what step it is. Of course, if you just open it, it's written above, but only the sign that it's open appears in the middle, so when you close it, it turns on its own again, and that's not a secret. I use Coupang's powdered dishwashing detergent because it has the best cleaning power, so I don't use liquid or tablets, but if I don't put in rinse, the water just puddles up, so I have no choice but to use rinse, but it's annoying. I have to pour a lot of detergent -_-;; I saw this tip from a housekeeper on YouTube, but when we do the first wash and put the dishwasher in, water + detergent, etc. run down for a moment, right? I'm one of those people who can't stand that, but drying dishes in the sink? He told me to put the entire stainless steel net in, I always threw it away because it was in the way, but oh, it just arrived with Coupang's early morning delivery. I took out the bottom one and put it next to me, and it wasn't bad, but it's too big, so it's heavy and uncomfortable. It's too big for my family, so it's an inconvenient size that I can't turn it even once a day, and the invisible course is really not good, but it's much~~~ quieter than a countertop. It's nice because there's almost no noise. In my 33 pyeong house, when I turned the countertop, it made a buzzing sound throughout the house. Anyway, I hope you think carefully about the installation depending on your household situation and then buy it. It's expensive by my standards^^; // As everyone says, when it comes to appliances, you should definitely get the biggest one! Yes. The biggest one you can afford! That's right, that's right! Bespoke countertops seem to damage coated pots and pans a little, but this one doesn't. I don't know if it's because the water current is stronger or what~ I bought two small nets and put them on the sink, and after the first wash or while washing, I put two on the first floor with detergent on them and put large plates or pots on the second floor. The third floor is supposed to be for cooking utensils, but personally, it's so low that I don't know about a spatula or a fork. It gets caught even when I lay it down. Even my spatula didn't work. Did the person who made it never do housework? I thought about it for a moment. When detergent is on, it only takes 10 minutes compared to the standard time even if I speed it up. I thought it wouldn't be able to finish it quickly because it's big, but it's so, so, so disappointing that there's no separate rinsing function. As for the cleaning power, after using it for a while, I concluded that it is better than the countertop. Above all, there are no water marks on the door. When it's done, the door opens wide. I open it so that no dust will get in, and when I take out all the shelves, if I spill water, water will splash on the door, and if I don't wipe it right away, marks will form right away (when using the countertop). This one cleans well. I wondered why it didn't clean, but this one cleans cleanly when I use the same detergent. It's a bit difficult to use it once every two days, but I'm getting used to it and using it well! ^^

저도 그거 못견디는 1인인데, 싱크대안 그릇건조? 하는 그 스텐망을 통째로 넣어보라 하시더라구요, 전 그거 걸리적거려서 늘 갖다버렸는데 앗 하고는 쿠팡 새벽배송으로 방금 도착했어욤ㅎㅎ 맨밑에 1단을 빼서 옆에 두고 해보니 그것도 나쁘진 않으나 너무커서 무겁고 불편하네요ㅋ  저희 식구들에겐 넘 빅사이즈라 하루 한번도 못돌리는 곤란한 사이즈에 보이지 않는 코스는 정말 별로인데 카운터탑보다 훨~~~씬 조용해요ㅎㅎㅎ 소음은 거의 없어서 좋네요, 33평에선 카운터탑 돌려두면 온집에 윙윙 했거든요,  여튼 집안 상황따라 설치를 신중히 고민하시고 구매하시길 바랍니다요 ㅎㅎ 제기준엔 비싼 가격이라^^;  // 다들 말하잖아요, 가전은 무조건 최고로 큰놈으로다가!!! 예... 형편껏 젤큰놈! 맞네요, 그랬어요 맞는말씀들!ㅋ 비스포크 카운터탑은 코팅 냄비-팬은 약간 상하는것 같던데 이건 그렇지않아요, 물살이 더 쎄서 그런지 우짠지~  작은 망 2개를 사서 씽크대에 두고 1차세척 후에 또는 세척함서 세재 묻힌채로 요래조래 1층에 두개를 넣고 2층엔 큰접시나 냄비 정도를 넣어요, 3층은 조리도구 넣으라시던데 갠적으로는 너무 낮아서 과도나 주걱 정도는 모를까..눕혀도 눕혀도 걸립니다, 저희집 뒤집개조차 안되더라고요ㅋ 만든사람은 살림 안해보셨나... 생각도 잠시 했구만요ㅋ 세재 묻힌때는 나름 급속으로 해도 표준이랑 10분밖에 차이가 안나요, 덩치가 있어 그런가 금방은 끝낼수없나보다 했는데 헹굼만 따로 없는게 너무너무너무 아쉽네요.  세정력 부분은 얼마간 써보니 카운터탑 보다는 좋다는 결론예요 무엇보다 문짝에 물자국이 안생겨요 다되고 나면 문이 빼꼼 열리거든요, 먼지도 안들가겠다싶게ㅋ 열어서 선반 다 빼면서 혹시라도 고인물 뒤집어빼면 문짝에 물튀고 바로 못닦는날은 금방 자국되고 그랬는데(카운터탑때) 이건 잘닦이네요, 그게 안닦이고 그래서 뭐지 했는데 같은세재 쓰는데 얘는 깔끔하게 처리됩니다요ㅎㅎ  이틀에 한번 돌리다시피 해서 좀 버겁지만 적응해감서 잘쓰고있는 중입니다!^^

Comments (English): <Additional review after a few weeks of use> Previously, we were using a bespoke countertop. We are a family of 4, 1 cat, for a total of 5 people. We don't eat much and don't eat side dishes at all. We only use chopsticks when necessary. We also don't eat much, so it's a bit ambiguous. The size of the countertop was just right for our dishwasher, but when we moved this time, we bought it to match the size that was already there. It was too expensive for my standards, so I was going to buy an LG, but when we moved and reduced the square footage from 33 to 25, I was scared because of the different brands of washing machines and dryers. Since the dryer is Samsung, it went up in a row, and at that time, I was impressed by the hard work of the Sam Song Man and shouted, "Sam Song is the best!" and bought a Samsung. Two days after purchasing it? The interior designer made an appointment to check the installation location and situation and checked it thoroughly. It was the weekend, but they came to install it on Monday. Two people came, and one of them did most of the work and the other one seemed to be a young person learning. They told me about various things about my sink that I didn't know about, took measures, and installed it thoroughly. It's so big that I was surprised. The interior is very spacious. Pots and frying pans come out with every meal, and it's convenient to put them in, but I don't know about the cleaning power because I usually wipe it with a basic dishwashing sponge. However, there are a few inconvenient points! First of all, the LCD screen is not visible. It's so inconvenient. You can't see what it's doing. I didn't see it closely, but it's hard to believe-_-;; I want to use it without the drying function, because it eats up all the electricity. But you can't set it separately. Power drying! You can cancel it. Even if you cancel it at the end, you have to see what step it is. Of course, if you just open it, it's written above, but only the sign that it's open appears in the middle, so when you close it, it turns on its own again, and that's not a secret. I use Coupang's powdered dishwashing detergent because it has the best cleaning power, so I don't use liquid or tablets, but if I don't put in rinse, the water just puddles up, so I have no choice but to use rinse, but it's annoying. I have to pour a lot of detergent -_-;; I saw this tip from a housekeeper on YouTube, but when we do the first wash and put the dishwasher in, water + detergent, etc. run down for a moment, right? I'm one of those people who can't stand that, but drying dishes in the sink? He told me to put the entire stainless steel net in, I always threw it away because it was in the way, but oh, it just arrived with Coupang's early morning delivery. I took out the bottom one and put it next to me, and it wasn't bad, but it's too big, so it's heavy and uncomfortable. It's too big for my family, so it's an inconvenient size that I can't turn it even once a day, and the invisible course is really not good, but it's much~~~ quieter than a countertop. It's nice because there's almost no noise. In my 33 pyeong house, when I turned the countertop, it made a buzzing sound throughout the house. Anyway, I hope you think carefully about the installation depending on your household situation and then buy it. It's expensive by my standards^^; // As everyone says, when it comes to appliances, you should definitely get the biggest one! Yes. The biggest one you can afford! That's right, that's right! Bespoke countertops seem to damage coated pots and pans a little, but this one doesn't. I don't know if it's because the water current is stronger or what~ I bought two small nets and put them on the sink, and after the first wash or while washing, I put two on the first floor with detergent on them and put large plates or pots on the second floor. The third floor is supposed to be for cooking utensils, but personally, it's so low that I don't know about a spatula or a fork. It gets caught even when I lay it down. Even my spatula didn't work. Did the person who made it never do housework? I thought about it for a moment. When detergent is on, it only takes 10 minutes compared to the standard time even if I speed it up. I thought it wouldn't be able to finish it quickly because it's big, but it's so, so, so disappointing that there's no separate rinsing function. As for the cleaning power, after using it for a while, I concluded that it is better than the countertop. Above all, there are no water marks on the door. When it's done, the door opens wide. I open it so that no dust will get in, and when I take out all the shelves, if I spill water, water will splash on the door, and if I don't wipe it right away, marks will form right away (when using the countertop). This one cleans well. I wondered why it didn't clean, but this one cleans cleanly when I use the same detergent. It's a bit difficult to use it once every two days, but I'm getting used to it and using it well! ^^

Comments (English): <Additional review after a few weeks of use> Previously, we were using a bespoke countertop. We are a family of 4, 1 cat, for a total of 5 people. We don't eat much and don't eat side dishes at all. We only use chopsticks when necessary. We also don't eat much, so it's a bit ambiguous. The size of the countertop was just right for our dishwasher, but when we moved this time, we bought it to match the size that was already there. It was too expensive for my standards, so I was going to buy an LG, but when we moved and reduced the square footage from 33 to 25, I was scared because of the different brands of washing machines and dryers. Since the dryer is Samsung, it went up in a row, and at that time, I was impressed by the hard work of the Sam Song Man and shouted, "Sam Song is the best!" and bought a Samsung. Two days after purchasing it? The interior designer made an appointment to check the installation location and situation and checked it thoroughly. It was the weekend, but they came to install it on Monday. Two people came, and one of them did most of the work and the other one seemed to be a young person learning. They told me about various things about my sink that I didn't know about, took measures, and installed it thoroughly. It's so big that I was surprised. The interior is very spacious. Pots and frying pans come out with every meal, and it's convenient to put them in, but I don't know about the cleaning power because I usually wipe it with a basic dishwashing sponge. However, there are a few inconvenient points! First of all, the LCD screen is not visible. It's so inconvenient. You can't see what it's doing. I didn't see it closely, but it's hard to believe-_-;; I want to use it without the drying function, because it eats up all the electricity. But you can't set it separately. Power drying! You can cancel it. Even if you cancel it at the end, you have to see what step it is. Of course, if you just open it, it's written above, but only the sign that it's open appears in the middle, so when you close it, it turns on its own again, and that's not a secret. I use Coupang's powdered dishwashing detergent because it has the best cleaning power, so I don't use liquid or tablets, but if I don't put in rinse, the water just puddles up, so I have no choice but to use rinse, but it's annoying. I have to pour a lot of detergent -_-;; I saw this tip from a housekeeper on YouTube, but when we do the first wash and put the dishwasher in, water + detergent, etc. run down for a moment, right? I'm one of those people who can't stand that, but drying dishes in the sink? He told me to put the entire stainless steel net in, I always threw it away because it was in the way, but oh, it just arrived with Coupang's early morning delivery. I took out the bottom one and put it next to me, and it wasn't bad, but it's too big, so it's heavy and uncomfortable. It's too big for my family, so it's an inconvenient size that I can't turn it even once a day, and the invisible course is really not good, but it's much~~~ quieter than a countertop. It's nice because there's almost no noise. In my 33 pyeong house, when I turned the countertop, it made a buzzing sound throughout the house. Anyway, I hope you think carefully about the installation depending on your household situation and then buy it. It's expensive by my standards^^; // As everyone says, when it comes to appliances, you should definitely get the biggest one! Yes. The biggest one you can afford! That's right, that's right! Bespoke countertops seem to damage coated pots and pans a little, but this one doesn't. I don't know if it's because the water current is stronger or what~ I bought two small nets and put them on the sink, and after the first wash or while washing, I put two on the first floor with detergent on them and put large plates or pots on the second floor. The third floor is supposed to be for cooking utensils, but personally, it's so low that I don't know about a spatula or a fork. It gets caught even when I lay it down. Even my spatula didn't work. Did the person who made it never do housework? I thought about it for a moment. When detergent is on, it only takes 10 minutes compared to the standard time even if I speed it up. I thought it wouldn't be able to finish it quickly because it's big, but it's so, so, so disappointing that there's no separate rinsing function. As for the cleaning power, after using it for a while, I concluded that it is better than the countertop. Above all, there are no water marks on the door. When it's done, the door opens wide. I open it so that no dust will get in, and when I take out all the shelves, if I spill water, water will splash on the door, and if I don't wipe it right away, marks will form right away (when using the countertop). This one cleans well. I wondered why it didn't clean, but this one cleans cleanly when I use the same detergent. It's a bit difficult to use it once every two days, but I'm getting used to it and using it well! ^^

저도 그거 못견디는 1인인데, 싱크대안 그릇건조? 하는 그 스텐망을 통째로 넣어보라 하시더라구요, 전 그거 걸리적거려서 늘 갖다버렸는데 앗 하고는 쿠팡 새벽배송으로 방금 도착했어욤ㅎㅎ 맨밑에 1단을 빼서 옆에 두고 해보니 그것도 나쁘진 않으나 너무커서 무겁고 불편하네요ㅋ  저희 식구들에겐 넘 빅사이즈라 하루 한번도 못돌리는 곤란한 사이즈에 보이지 않는 코스는 정말 별로인데 카운터탑보다 훨~~~씬 조용해요ㅎㅎㅎ 소음은 거의 없어서 좋네요, 33평에선 카운터탑 돌려두면 온집에 윙윙 했거든요,  여튼 집안 상황따라 설치를 신중히 고민하시고 구매하시길 바랍니다요 ㅎㅎ 제기준엔 비싼 가격이라^^;  // 다들 말하잖아요, 가전은 무조건 최고로 큰놈으로다가!!! 예... 형편껏 젤큰놈! 맞네요, 그랬어요 맞는말씀들!ㅋ 비스포크 카운터탑은 코팅 냄비-팬은 약간 상하는것 같던데 이건 그렇지않아요, 물살이 더 쎄서 그런지 우짠지~  작은 망 2개를 사서 씽크대에 두고 1차세척 후에 또는 세척함서 세재 묻힌채로 요래조래 1층에 두개를 넣고 2층엔 큰접시나 냄비 정도를 넣어요, 3층은 조리도구 넣으라시던데 갠적으로는 너무 낮아서 과도나 주걱 정도는 모를까..눕혀도 눕혀도 걸립니다, 저희집 뒤집개조차 안되더라고요ㅋ 만든사람은 살림 안해보셨나... 생각도 잠시 했구만요ㅋ 세재 묻힌때는 나름 급속으로 해도 표준이랑 10분밖에 차이가 안나요, 덩치가 있어 그런가 금방은 끝낼수없나보다 했는데 헹굼만 따로 없는게 너무너무너무 아쉽네요.  세정력 부분은 얼마간 써보니 카운터탑 보다는 좋다는 결론예요 무엇보다 문짝에 물자국이 안생겨요 다되고 나면 문이 빼꼼 열리거든요, 먼지도 안들가겠다싶게ㅋ 열어서 선반 다 빼면서 혹시라도 고인물 뒤집어빼면 문짝에 물튀고 바로 못닦는날은 금방 자국되고 그랬는데(카운터탑때) 이건 잘닦이네요, 그게 안닦이고 그래서 뭐지 했는데 같은세재 쓰는데 얘는 깔끔하게 처리됩니다요ㅎㅎ  이틀에 한번 돌리다시피 해서 좀 버겁지만 적응해감서 잘쓰고있는 중입니다!^^

The size of the countertop was just right for our dishwasher, but when we moved this time, we bought it to match the size that was already there. It was too expensive for my standards, so I was going to buy an LG, but when we moved and reduced the square footage from 33 to 25, I was scared because of the different brands of washing machines and dryers. Since the dryer is Samsung, it went up in a row, and at that time, I was impressed by the hard work of the Sam Song Man and shouted, "Sam Song is the best!" and bought a Samsung. Two days after purchasing it? The interior designer made an appointment to check the installation location and situation and checked it thoroughly. It was the weekend, but they came to install it on Monday. Two people came, and one of them did most of the work and the other one seemed to be a young person learning. They told me about various things about my sink that I didn't know about, took measures, and installed it thoroughly. It's so big that I was surprised. The interior is very spacious. Pots and frying pans come out with every meal, and it's convenient to put them in, but I don't know about the cleaning power because I usually wipe it with a basic dishwashing sponge. However, there are a few inconvenient points! First of all, the LCD screen is not visible. It's so inconvenient. You can't see what it's doing. I didn't see it closely, but it's hard to believe-_-;; I want to use it without the drying function, because it eats up all the electricity. But you can't set it separately. Power drying! You can cancel it. Even if you cancel it at the end, you have to see what step it is. Of course, if you just open it, it's written above, but only the sign that it's open appears in the middle, so when you close it, it turns on its own again, and that's not a secret. I use Coupang's powdered dishwashing detergent because it has the best cleaning power, so I don't use liquid or tablets, but if I don't put in rinse, the water just puddles up, so I have no choice but to use rinse, but it's annoying. I have to pour a lot of detergent -_-;; I saw this tip from a housekeeper on YouTube, but when we do the first wash and put the dishwasher in, water + detergent, etc. run down for a moment, right? I'm one of those people who can't stand that, but drying dishes in the sink? He told me to put the entire stainless steel net in, I always threw it away because it was in the way, but oh, it just arrived with Coupang's early morning delivery. I took out the bottom one and put it next to me, and it wasn't bad, but it's too big, so it's heavy and uncomfortable. It's too big for my family, so it's an inconvenient size that I can't turn it even once a day, and the invisible course is really not good, but it's much~~~ quieter than a countertop. It's nice because there's almost no noise. In my 33 pyeong house, when I turned the countertop, it made a buzzing sound throughout the house. Anyway, I hope you think carefully about the installation depending on your household situation and then buy it. It's expensive by my standards^^; // As everyone says, when it comes to appliances, you should definitely get the biggest one! Yes. The biggest one you can afford! That's right, that's right! Bespoke countertops seem to damage coated pots and pans a little, but this one doesn't. I don't know if it's because the water current is stronger or what~ I bought two small nets and put them on the sink, and after the first wash or while washing, I put two on the first floor with detergent on them and put large plates or pots on the second floor. The third floor is supposed to be for cooking utensils, but personally, it's so low that I don't know about a spatula or a fork. It gets caught even when I lay it down. Even my spatula didn't work. Did the person who made it never do housework? I thought about it for a moment. When detergent is on, it only takes 10 minutes compared to the standard time even if I speed it up. I thought it wouldn't be able to finish it quickly because it's big, but it's so, so, so disappointing that there's no separate rinsing function. As for the cleaning power, after using it for a while, I concluded that it is better than the countertop. Above all, there are no water marks on the door. When it's done, the door opens wide. I open it so that no dust will get in, and when I take out all the shelves, if I spill water, water will splash on the door, and if I don't wipe it right away, marks will form right away (when using the countertop). This one cleans well. I wondered why it didn't clean, but this one cleans cleanly when I use the same detergent. It's a bit difficult to use it once every two days, but I'm getting used to it and using it well! ^^

저도 그거 못견디는 1인인데, 싱크대안 그릇건조? 하는 그 스텐망을 통째로 넣어보라 하시더라구요, 전 그거 걸리적거려서 늘 갖다버렸는데 앗 하고는 쿠팡 새벽배송으로 방금 도착했어욤ㅎㅎ 맨밑에 1단을 빼서 옆에 두고 해보니 그것도 나쁘진 않으나 너무커서 무겁고 불편하네요ㅋ  저희 식구들에겐 넘 빅사이즈라 하루 한번도 못돌리는 곤란한 사이즈에 보이지 않는 코스는 정말 별로인데 카운터탑보다 훨~~~씬 조용해요ㅎㅎㅎ 소음은 거의 없어서 좋네요, 33평에선 카운터탑 돌려두면 온집에 윙윙 했거든요,  여튼 집안 상황따라 설치를 신중히 고민하시고 구매하시길 바랍니다요 ㅎㅎ 제기준엔 비싼 가격이라^^;  // 다들 말하잖아요, 가전은 무조건 최고로 큰놈으로다가!!! 예... 형편껏 젤큰놈! 맞네요, 그랬어요 맞는말씀들!ㅋ 비스포크 카운터탑은 코팅 냄비-팬은 약간 상하는것 같던데 이건 그렇지않아요, 물살이 더 쎄서 그런지 우짠지~  작은 망 2개를 사서 씽크대에 두고 1차세척 후에 또는 세척함서 세재 묻힌채로 요래조래 1층에 두개를 넣고 2층엔 큰접시나 냄비 정도를 넣어요, 3층은 조리도구 넣으라시던데 갠적으로는 너무 낮아서 과도나 주걱 정도는 모를까..눕혀도 눕혀도 걸립니다, 저희집 뒤집개조차 안되더라고요ㅋ 만든사람은 살림 안해보셨나... 생각도 잠시 했구만요ㅋ 세재 묻힌때는 나름 급속으로 해도 표준이랑 10분밖에 차이가 안나요, 덩치가 있어 그런가 금방은 끝낼수없나보다 했는데 헹굼만 따로 없는게 너무너무너무 아쉽네요.  세정력 부분은 얼마간 써보니 카운터탑 보다는 좋다는 결론예요 무엇보다 문짝에 물자국이 안생겨요 다되고 나면 문이 빼꼼 열리거든요, 먼지도 안들가겠다싶게ㅋ 열어서 선반 다 빼면서 혹시라도 고인물 뒤집어빼면 문짝에 물튀고 바로 못닦는날은 금방 자국되고 그랬는데(카운터탑때) 이건 잘닦이네요, 그게 안닦이고 그래서 뭐지 했는데 같은세재 쓰는데 얘는 깔끔하게 처리됩니다요ㅎㅎ  이틀에 한번 돌리다시피 해서 좀 버겁지만 적응해감서 잘쓰고있는 중입니다!^^

Comments (English): <Additional review after a few weeks of use> Previously, we were using a bespoke countertop. We are a family of 4, 1 cat, for a total of 5 people. We don't eat much and don't eat side dishes at all. We only use chopsticks when necessary. We also don't eat much, so it's a bit ambiguous. The size of the countertop was just right for our dishwasher, but when we moved this time, we bought it to match the size that was already there. It was too expensive for my standards, so I was going to buy an LG, but when we moved and reduced the square footage from 33 to 25, I was scared because of the different brands of washing machines and dryers. Since the dryer is Samsung, it went up in a row, and at that time, I was impressed by the hard work of the Sam Song Man and shouted, "Sam Song is the best!" and bought a Samsung. Two days after purchasing it? The interior designer made an appointment to check the installation location and situation and checked it thoroughly. It was the weekend, but they came to install it on Monday. Two people came, and one of them did most of the work and the other one seemed to be a young person learning. They told me about various things about my sink that I didn't know about, took measures, and installed it thoroughly. It's so big that I was surprised. The interior is very spacious. Pots and frying pans come out with every meal, and it's convenient to put them in, but I don't know about the cleaning power because I usually wipe it with a basic dishwashing sponge. However, there are a few inconvenient points! First of all, the LCD screen is not visible. It's so inconvenient. You can't see what it's doing. I didn't see it closely, but it's hard to believe-_-;; I want to use it without the drying function, because it eats up all the electricity. But you can't set it separately. Power drying! You can cancel it. Even if you cancel it at the end, you have to see what step it is. Of course, if you just open it, it's written above, but only the sign that it's open appears in the middle, so when you close it, it turns on its own again, and that's not a secret. I use Coupang's powdered dishwashing detergent because it has the best cleaning power, so I don't use liquid or tablets, but if I don't put in rinse, the water just puddles up, so I have no choice but to use rinse, but it's annoying. I have to pour a lot of detergent -_-;; I saw this tip from a housekeeper on YouTube, but when we do the first wash and put the dishwasher in, water + detergent, etc. run down for a moment, right? I'm one of those people who can't stand that, but drying dishes in the sink? He told me to put the entire stainless steel net in, I always threw it away because it was in the way, but oh, it just arrived with Coupang's early morning delivery. I took out the bottom one and put it next to me, and it wasn't bad, but it's too big, so it's heavy and uncomfortable. It's too big for my family, so it's an inconvenient size that I can't turn it even once a day, and the invisible course is really not good, but it's much~~~ quieter than a countertop. It's nice because there's almost no noise. In my 33 pyeong house, when I turned the countertop, it made a buzzing sound throughout the house. Anyway, I hope you think carefully about the installation depending on your household situation and then buy it. It's expensive by my standards^^; // As everyone says, when it comes to appliances, you should definitely get the biggest one! Yes. The biggest one you can afford! That's right, that's right! Bespoke countertops seem to damage coated pots and pans a little, but this one doesn't. I don't know if it's because the water current is stronger or what~ I bought two small nets and put them on the sink, and after the first wash or while washing, I put two on the first floor with detergent on them and put large plates or pots on the second floor. The third floor is supposed to be for cooking utensils, but personally, it's so low that I don't know about a spatula or a fork. It gets caught even when I lay it down. Even my spatula didn't work. Did the person who made it never do housework? I thought about it for a moment. When detergent is on, it only takes 10 minutes compared to the standard time even if I speed it up. I thought it wouldn't be able to finish it quickly because it's big, but it's so, so, so disappointing that there's no separate rinsing function. As for the cleaning power, after using it for a while, I concluded that it is better than the countertop. Above all, there are no water marks on the door. When it's done, the door opens wide. I open it so that no dust will get in, and when I take out all the shelves, if I spill water, water will splash on the door, and if I don't wipe it right away, marks will form right away (when using the countertop). This one cleans well. I wondered why it didn't clean, but this one cleans cleanly when I use the same detergent. It's a bit difficult to use it once every two days, but I'm getting used to it and using it well! ^^

Comments (English): This is my first time using a dishwasher. ~ All the appliances in my house are Samsung, so I ordered Samsung. The color is Koda Charcoal. Our sink is a matte gray tone, and it fits perfectly. The delivery man said that if you do Glam, it might look different because it's shiny, but when you order Koda, it's matte. They said it looks similar, so I made a good order. He complimented me. ^^ I live in a rural area, and he diagnosed that the place I wanted to install it under the sink is because there is a boiler line, and it can only be installed under the induction. On the scheduled delivery date, Furniture Reform came and diagnosed it, and the next day, the dishwasher. Installation width is 68cm. But 8cm was unusable, so they remodeled the furniture nicely (remodeling cost 90,000 won). They said that there should be a 2cm gap between the induction and the dishwasher, so I installed a 2cm induction frame (induction frame 100,000 won). The induction was flush with the sink, but it's 2cm in the air. Anyway, on the scheduled delivery date, they renovated and delivered the appliances the next day. They asked me to roll up a tissue to see if there was a leak and occasionally touch the tissue to tell them if there was a leak. They said that they only recommend tablet detergent and powder detergent. They said that they do not recommend liquid detergent because it runs down. The Samsung technician gave me a coupon, so I ordered Ecover tablet detergent cheaply and also ordered powder detergent. I plan to use the tablet when there is a lot of oil and without cutting it. I ordered powder detergent to use for internal cleaning or when washing small amounts. (They say citric acid or vinegar is good for internal cleaning.) You can also adjust the amount. I ordered two types, and they seem good. Samsung does not give detergent when you order a dishwasher. If you order a dishwasher and then order detergent right away, you can use it right away. It is a little noisy, but I ate dinner and turned on the dishwasher. I can't hear it when I'm lying down in my room. It doesn't wash with hot water from the boiler, but with hot water from electricity. Electricity costs about 100 to 100 won per cycle. It says it's going out. If you turn it once a day, it's 3,000 won a month. Isn't this how you use people cheaply, aunt? I understand why aunt 3 is like that. I've been using it for a few days and I'm writing a review. It's so convenient^^ I just remove the rice paste and turn it on. It's the cleanest it's ever been. Clothes dryer, dishwasher, robot vacuum cleaner. Aunt 3, the dishwasher is the last thing I bought. I should've bought it sooner. You won't regret it. I ordered it for 600,000 won, and the reform frame for about 190,000 won. Gray tone. If it's the lower part of the sink, if it's glossy, you can order glam charcoal, and if it's not glossy, you can order Koda. If my review was helpful, please click 'Helpful' ^ . ^ I recommend ^~^

Our sink is a matte gray tone, and it fits perfectly. The delivery man said that if you do Glam, it might look different because it's shiny, but when you order Koda, it's matte. They said it looks similar, so I made a good order. He complimented me. ^^ I live in a rural area, and he diagnosed that the place I wanted to install it under the sink is because there is a boiler line, and it can only be installed under the induction. On the scheduled delivery date, Furniture Reform came and diagnosed it, and the next day, the dishwasher. Installation width is 68cm. But 8cm was unusable, so they remodeled the furniture nicely (remodeling cost 90,000 won). They said that there should be a 2cm gap between the induction and the dishwasher, so I installed a 2cm induction frame (induction frame 100,000 won). The induction was flush with the sink, but it's 2cm in the air. Anyway, on the scheduled delivery date, they renovated and delivered the appliances the next day. They asked me to roll up a tissue to see if there was a leak and occasionally touch the tissue to tell them if there was a leak. They said that they only recommend tablet detergent and powder detergent. They said that they do not recommend liquid detergent because it runs down. The Samsung technician gave me a coupon, so I ordered Ecover tablet detergent cheaply and also ordered powder detergent. I plan to use the tablet when there is a lot of oil and without cutting it. I ordered powder detergent to use for internal cleaning or when washing small amounts. (They say citric acid or vinegar is good for internal cleaning.) You can also adjust the amount. I ordered two types, and they seem good. Samsung does not give detergent when you order a dishwasher. If you order a dishwasher and then order detergent right away, you can use it right away. It is a little noisy, but I ate dinner and turned on the dishwasher. I can't hear it when I'm lying down in my room. It doesn't wash with hot water from the boiler, but with hot water from electricity. Electricity costs about 100 to 100 won per cycle. It says it's going out. If you turn it once a day, it's 3,000 won a month. Isn't this how you use people cheaply, aunt? I understand why aunt 3 is like that. I've been using it for a few days and I'm writing a review. It's so convenient^^ I just remove the rice paste and turn it on. It's the cleanest it's ever been. Clothes dryer, dishwasher, robot vacuum cleaner. Aunt 3, the dishwasher is the last thing I bought. I should've bought it sooner. You won't regret it. I ordered it for 600,000 won, and the reform frame for about 190,000 won. Gray tone. If it's the lower part of the sink, if it's glossy, you can order glam charcoal, and if it's not glossy, you can order Koda. If my review was helpful, please click 'Helpful' ^ . ^ I recommend ^~^

Our sink is a matte gray tone, and it fits perfectly. The delivery man said that if you do Glam, it might look different because it's shiny, but when you order Koda, it's matte. They said it looks similar, so I made a good order. He complimented me. ^^ I live in a rural area, and he diagnosed that the place I wanted to install it under the sink is because there is a boiler line, and it can only be installed under the induction. On the scheduled delivery date, Furniture Reform came and diagnosed it, and the next day, the dishwasher. Installation width is 68cm. But 8cm was unusable, so they remodeled the furniture nicely (remodeling cost 90,000 won). They said that there should be a 2cm gap between the induction and the dishwasher, so I installed a 2cm induction frame (induction frame 100,000 won). The induction was flush with the sink, but it's 2cm in the air. Anyway, on the scheduled delivery date, they renovated and delivered the appliances the next day. They asked me to roll up a tissue to see if there was a leak and occasionally touch the tissue to tell them if there was a leak. They said that they only recommend tablet detergent and powder detergent. They said that they do not recommend liquid detergent because it runs down. The Samsung technician gave me a coupon, so I ordered Ecover tablet detergent cheaply and also ordered powder detergent. I plan to use the tablet when there is a lot of oil and without cutting it. I ordered powder detergent to use for internal cleaning or when washing small amounts. (They say citric acid or vinegar is good for internal cleaning.) You can also adjust the amount. I ordered two types, and they seem good. Samsung does not give detergent when you order a dishwasher. If you order a dishwasher and then order detergent right away, you can use it right away. It is a little noisy, but I ate dinner and turned on the dishwasher. I can't hear it when I'm lying down in my room. It doesn't wash with hot water from the boiler, but with hot water from electricity. Electricity costs about 100 to 100 won per cycle. It says it's going out. If you turn it once a day, it's 3,000 won a month. Isn't this how you use people cheaply, aunt? I understand why aunt 3 is like that. I've been using it for a few days and I'm writing a review. It's so convenient^^ I just remove the rice paste and turn it on. It's the cleanest it's ever been. Clothes dryer, dishwasher, robot vacuum cleaner. Aunt 3, the dishwasher is the last thing I bought. I should've bought it sooner. You won't regret it. I ordered it for 600,000 won, and the reform frame for about 190,000 won. Gray tone. If it's the lower part of the sink, if it's glossy, you can order glam charcoal, and if it's not glossy, you can order Koda. If my review was helpful, please click 'Helpful' ^ . ^ I recommend ^~^
Comments (Original): 식기세척기는 처음사용하는데요 ~ 집에 가전이 죄다 삼성꺼여서 삼성으로 주문함.  색상은 코다차콜인데요. 저희. 씽크대 하부장이 진 그레이 톤 매트한 제질인데 찰떡임돠.  배송온 기사도 글램으로 하면 광이나서 달라보일수 있는데 코다로 주문하니 매트한 제질이라. 비슷해보여 잘 주문했다고. 칭찬하더라구요^^  여기는 지방인데요 씽크대 밑에 설치하고 싶은 곳은 보일러 선이 있고 인덕션 밑 부분에만 설치 할 수 있다고 진단 내려 주셨어요 배송 예정일에 가구리폼 오셔서 진단해주시고 바로 다음날 식세기. 설치 가로68 센치. 인데 8센치는 못쓰는곳 으로 가구 이쁘게 리폼 해 주시고  (리폼비 구만원 )  인덕션과 식기세척기 간격이 2cm 공간이 있어야 한다고 하여 인덕션2cm. 프레임 설치 했어요  (인덕션 프레임 십만원) 인덕션이 씽크대와 일치형 이였는데 공중으로 2센치 떳네요.  여튼 배송 예정일에 리폼, 다음날 가전 배송 해주셨어요 물이 새는지 휴지로 말아 놓고 간간히 휴지를 만져보고 새는지 말해달라고 하네요  타블렛세제, 가루형 세제만 권장 한다고 하네요 액상형 세제는 흘러 내림때문에 권장안한다고 합니다.  저는삼성 기사님이 쿠폰 주셔서  에코버 타블렛 세제 저렴히 주문 했고 가루형 세제도 주문했어요  타블렛을 양많고 기름기 많을때, 자르지 않고 쓸려고요  가루세제는. 내부세척 하거나, 적은양 세척 할때 쓸려고 가루세제 주문 (내부세척시 구연산 또는 식초 좋다고합니다.) 양 조절도 가능. 두가지 타입으로 주문했는데  좋은거 같아요  삼성에서는 식기세척기 주문하면 세제를 안줌니다. 세척기 주문 하시고, 세제를 바로 주문 하시면 바로 사용 할 수 있습니다.  소음은 조금 있는데요  저녁먹고 식세기 돌리고. 방에 누워있는데 안들려요ㅋ  보일러 온수로 세척이 되는게 아니라 전기로 온수나와서 세척이 되어요. 한번돌릴때 마다 백원에서 백 몇십원 정도 전기료. 나간다 합니다 하루 한번돌리믄 한달에 삼천원' 꼴 ㅋ 이정도 이모님 이믄 저렴히 사람 쓰는거 아닌가요?  3대 이모님 왜 그런지 알겠어요 한 몇일 사용 하다 후기 올리는데 너무 편해요^^ 적당히 밥풀정도 제거 하고 돌리는데 뽀득하니 여태껏. 깨끗히 씻겼어요  의류건조기,  식기세척기, 로봇청소기  3대이모님 식세기가 젤 마지막으로 샀네요 진작살껄요  후회안하십니다 저는 육십만원대로 주문, 리폼프레임 십구만원 정도로 주문했어요  그레이톤.씽크대 하부장 이믄  광이 있다면 글램차콜, 광이 없다면 코다쪽으로 주문하시면 될꺼에요  제 리뷰가 도움이 된다면 ㅡ  '도움이 돼요 '  눌러쥬세요 ^  .  ^  추천합니다 ^~^

Our sink is a matte gray tone, and it fits perfectly. The delivery man said that if you do Glam, it might look different because it's shiny, but when you order Koda, it's matte. They said it looks similar, so I made a good order. He complimented me. ^^ I live in a rural area, and he diagnosed that the place I wanted to install it under the sink is because there is a boiler line, and it can only be installed under the induction. On the scheduled delivery date, Furniture Reform came and diagnosed it, and the next day, the dishwasher. Installation width is 68cm. But 8cm was unusable, so they remodeled the furniture nicely (remodeling cost 90,000 won). They said that there should be a 2cm gap between the induction and the dishwasher, so I installed a 2cm induction frame (induction frame 100,000 won). The induction was flush with the sink, but it's 2cm in the air. Anyway, on the scheduled delivery date, they renovated and delivered the appliances the next day. They asked me to roll up a tissue to see if there was a leak and occasionally touch the tissue to tell them if there was a leak. They said that they only recommend tablet detergent and powder detergent. They said that they do not recommend liquid detergent because it runs down. The Samsung technician gave me a coupon, so I ordered Ecover tablet detergent cheaply and also ordered powder detergent. I plan to use the tablet when there is a lot of oil and without cutting it. I ordered powder detergent to use for internal cleaning or when washing small amounts. (They say citric acid or vinegar is good for internal cleaning.) You can also adjust the amount. I ordered two types, and they seem good. Samsung does not give detergent when you order a dishwasher. If you order a dishwasher and then order detergent right away, you can use it right away. It is a little noisy, but I ate dinner and turned on the dishwasher. I can't hear it when I'm lying down in my room. It doesn't wash with hot water from the boiler, but with hot water from electricity. Electricity costs about 100 to 100 won per cycle. It says it's going out. If you turn it once a day, it's 3,000 won a month. Isn't this how you use people cheaply, aunt? I understand why aunt 3 is like that. I've been using it for a few days and I'm writing a review. It's so convenient^^ I just remove the rice paste and turn it on. It's the cleanest it's ever been. Clothes dryer, dishwasher, robot vacuum cleaner. Aunt 3, the dishwasher is the last thing I bought. I should've bought it sooner. You won't regret it. I ordered it for 600,000 won, and the reform frame for about 190,000 won. Gray tone. If it's the lower part of the sink, if it's glossy, you can order glam charcoal, and if it's not glossy, you can order Koda. If my review was helpful, please click 'Helpful' ^ . ^ I recommend ^~^
Comments (Original): 식기세척기는 처음사용하는데요 ~ 집에 가전이 죄다 삼성꺼여서 삼성으로 주문함.  색상은 코다차콜인데요. 저희. 씽크대 하부장이 진 그레이 톤 매트한 제질인데 찰떡임돠.  배송온 기사도 글램으로 하면 광이나서 달라보일수 있는데 코다로 주문하니 매트한 제질이라. 비슷해보여 잘 주문했다고. 칭찬하더라구요^^  여기는 지방인데요 씽크대 밑에 설치하고 싶은 곳은 보일러 선이 있고 인덕션 밑 부분에만 설치 할 수 있다고 진단 내려 주셨어요 배송 예정일에 가구리폼 오셔서 진단해주시고 바로 다음날 식세기. 설치 가로68 센치. 인데 8센치는 못쓰는곳 으로 가구 이쁘게 리폼 해 주시고  (리폼비 구만원 )  인덕션과 식기세척기 간격이 2cm 공간이 있어야 한다고 하여 인덕션2cm. 프레임 설치 했어요  (인덕션 프레임 십만원) 인덕션이 씽크대와 일치형 이였는데 공중으로 2센치 떳네요.  여튼 배송 예정일에 리폼, 다음날 가전 배송 해주셨어요 물이 새는지 휴지로 말아 놓고 간간히 휴지를 만져보고 새는지 말해달라고 하네요  타블렛세제, 가루형 세제만 권장 한다고 하네요 액상형 세제는 흘러 내림때문에 권장안한다고 합니다.  저는삼성 기사님이 쿠폰 주셔서  에코버 타블렛 세제 저렴히 주문 했고 가루형 세제도 주문했어요  타블렛을 양많고 기름기 많을때, 자르지 않고 쓸려고요  가루세제는. 내부세척 하거나, 적은양 세척 할때 쓸려고 가루세제 주문 (내부세척시 구연산 또는 식초 좋다고합니다.) 양 조절도 가능. 두가지 타입으로 주문했는데  좋은거 같아요  삼성에서는 식기세척기 주문하면 세제를 안줌니다. 세척기 주문 하시고, 세제를 바로 주문 하시면 바로 사용 할 수 있습니다.  소음은 조금 있는데요  저녁먹고 식세기 돌리고. 방에 누워있는데 안들려요ㅋ  보일러 온수로 세척이 되는게 아니라 전기로 온수나와서 세척이 되어요. 한번돌릴때 마다 백원에서 백 몇십원 정도 전기료. 나간다 합니다 하루 한번돌리믄 한달에 삼천원' 꼴 ㅋ 이정도 이모님 이믄 저렴히 사람 쓰는거 아닌가요?  3대 이모님 왜 그런지 알겠어요 한 몇일 사용 하다 후기 올리는데 너무 편해요^^ 적당히 밥풀정도 제거 하고 돌리는데 뽀득하니 여태껏. 깨끗히 씻겼어요  의류건조기,  식기세척기, 로봇청소기  3대이모님 식세기가 젤 마지막으로 샀네요 진작살껄요  후회안하십니다 저는 육십만원대로 주문, 리폼프레임 십구만원 정도로 주문했어요  그레이톤.씽크대 하부장 이믄  광이 있다면 글램차콜, 광이 없다면 코다쪽으로 주문하시면 될꺼에요  제 리뷰가 도움이 된다면 ㅡ  '도움이 돼요 '  눌러쥬세요 ^  .  ^  추천합니다 ^~^

Sentence (English): I used to use a 6-person non-installation product, but I changed it to a 12-person product when I moved.
Comments (English): [ I like the dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I used to use a 6-person non-installation product, but I changed it to a 12-person product when I moved. When I asked the technician what a built-in product meant, he said that a built-in refers to a dishwasher being placed in the lower cabinet. In other words, some dishwashers can be installed alone, but built-in products cannot. We tried to put it in the lower cabinet anyway, but the size didn't fit, so they came twice to remodel. Thanks to that, it took about a week after moving to install the dishwasher, which was a bit disappointing. It took a few more days from remodeling to installing the dishwasher. This product has three levels, and the top level can hold things like spoons and thin spatulas, and there is a separate spoon holder in the bottom level. The lower spoon holder is detachable, so you can take it out when you're not using it, but it hasn't been that full yet, so I just put it in and run it. It's not an automatic drying product. But I think it can be naturally dried to some extent with hot steam and sterilized. When the dishwasher is ready to clean the inside, the button lights up. The installer who explained it to us seemed to think we had never used a dishwasher before, so he gave us a very basic explanation and attitude, so we were able to resolve our questions by asking questions. I bought it knowing that it doesn't work with the app, but I haven't really felt the need for it yet. I used to use it for 6 people, but now that I use it for 12 people, the space seems too big, so it's a bit of a waste, but I don't have to play Tetris, so it's really great. I don't run the dishwasher once a day, but I run it once in the morning and afternoon, and once after dinner. This product has a disadvantage in that you can't run only the top or the bottom. It's fast, but he said that it's not for small-scale washing, but because of the difference in water temperature, it can actually wash less. When the amount is small, it's a bit of a waste, but I just run it. I think I bought a decent product at a reasonable price. If my review was helpful, please click the "helpful" button.
Comments (Original): [ 식기세척기 좋아요 ] || ---------------- || 6인용 무설치제품 사용하다 이사하면서 12인용으로 바꿨어요. 기사님께 빌트인제품의 뜻이 뭐냐고 여쭤보니 식기세척기를 하부장 안에 넣는 것을 빌트인이라고 한다네요. 즉 어떤 식기세척기는 기기 단독으로 거치가 되지만 빌트인 제품은 그건 안된대요. 어차피 저희는 하부장에 넣으려고 했고 다만 사이즈가 안맞아서 리폼하러 2번이나 오셨어요. 덕분에 이사하고도 약 일주일정도 지나서야 식기세척기를 설치할 수 있어서 조금은 아쉬웠어요. 리폼하고 식기세척기 설치까지 또 며칠이 지났거든요.  이 제품은 3단으로 제일 윗칸은 수저나 얇은 주걱 뭐 그런 것들을 올려놓을 수 있는데 제일 밑칸에 또 수저통이 따로 있긴해요. 아래 수저통은 탈부착이 가능해서 안쓸때에는 빼면 되긴하는데 아직까지 그렇게 꽉 찬 적이 없어서 그냥 넣고 돌리고 있어요. 자동건조제품은 아니고요. 그래도 뜨거운 증기로 어느정도 자연건조도 되고 살균은 가능할 것 같아요. 식기세척기가 내부세척할 때가 되면 해당 버튼에 불이 켜진다고 하네요.  설명해주시던 설치기사님께서 저희가 식기세척기를 사용해본 적이 없다고 생각하셨는지 너무 기초적인 설명과 태도로 대해주셔서 정작 궁금한 것은 질문으로 해결했고요.  앱연동 안되는 점은 알고 구매하긴 했는데 뭐 딱히 연동의 필요성은 아직 못느끼고 있어요. 6인용 쓰다가 12인용 쓰니 공간이 너무 넓은 것 같아서 좀 아깝긴 한데 테트리스 안해도 되고 너무 좋네요. 하루 한번 식세기 작동하진 않고 오전 오후 합쳐서 한번 저녁먹고 한번 이정도 돌리고 있고요.  이 제품은 상단만 혹은 하단만 작동을 시킬 수 없다는 단점이 있긴 하네요. 쾌속이 있긴한데 소량세척의 의미가 아니라 물의 온도의 차이이기 때문에 오히려 세척이 덜 될 수가 있다고 하셨고요. 양이 적을 때에는 좀 아깝긴 하지만 그냥 돌리고 있어요.  적당한 가격에 무난한 제품 구매한 것 같아요.  제 리뷰가 도움이 되었다면 도움이 돼요 꾸욱 눌러주세요.

Product name: Samsung Electronics BESPOKE Countertop Dishwasher 6-person, White, DW30CB300CW0 (White) Purchase date: 2024.11.10 Installation date: 2024.11.12 Delivery and packaging status - Delivery/on-site installation 2 days after ordering via rocket delivery - Good delivery condition - The product is packed in a box with no tears or damage. Reason for purchase I had knee surgery in an accident and had difficulty sitting and standing, so I bought a robot vacuum cleaner for the first time and used it, and I ended up taking care of each of my three aunts. After the robot vacuum cleaner, I compared the prices of clothes dryers and finally dishwashers for about 3 weeks and ended up buying it on Coupang. I feel so good because I bought it cheaply ^^ Product description (Source: Coupang) Automatic door opening drying that reduces worries about water stains and water spots The finish of clean dishes is a clean dry! When all washing processes are finished, the door automatically opens to allow internal and external air to circulate, leaving a fluffy finish. High-temperature direct water safely washes even baby bottles High-temperature direct water and long, powerful lower blades and double water streams from the upper wings cleanly wash the dishes, and you can wash them satisfactorily by adding detergent and rinse at the exact time. BESPOKE design for a kitchen interior that suits me The BESPOKE dishwasher countertop in white and beige goes well with various kitchens, creating a neat kitchen interior. Various customized courses, options You can combine the desired courses and options according to your taste, and the course memory function conveniently saves you the need to reselect the most recently used course. You can also select various washing courses depending on the degree of contamination of the dishes. Purchase reviews and overall ratings Advantages Convenience is both first and second place~ It's the most convenient in the world. How much is the electricity and water bill? I'm just going to spin it around like crazy. ^^ It was washed more thoroughly than I thought. The button operation was much easier than a drum washing machine. The function to stop it during operation and add more was also convenient. The hardened mozzarella cheese on the plate wasn't washed well, but the rest was washed really well. Water bill savings I run it twice, once in the morning before work and once in the evening before going to bed, and it seems like less water is used than I thought. I use a lot of water when I wash dishes by hand, so I think the water bill will be greatly reduced. Design & color It's a neat square with a glass coating. However, the color is not a bright white, but a white with light gray. This part was disappointing. The installer was also kind. I'm 200% satisfied with the installation. After making an installation date reservation, they sent me text messages to carefully inform me of the installation date, time, and precautions before installation. They said they would remove the water purifier and move it again after installation, so they left the hose long enough. When I moved, they gave me a rubber thing to block the hole they made when installing. They also gave me a cute mini washing machine detergent ^^ It took about 30 minutes to install (it was the same time I was told). After installation, they kindly told me not only how to use it, but also what I was curious about. Disadvantages Automatic door opening drying that reduces worries about water stains and water spots The finishing touch to clean dishes is a clean dry! After all the washing processes are finished, the door automatically opens to circulate the air inside and outside, and it is a little lacking that it is finished fluffy. It is true that the door opens automatically after washing, but the moisture remains. Since the moisture dries over time, I am an office worker, so when I leave for work, it is completely dry, but if I use it right after washing, I have to wipe the moisture separately. Other than that, I had no disadvantages. Willing to repurchase) It is the best. If I buy a new one after using it for a long time, I will buy Samsung again! Thank you for reading the long article. Product name: Samsung Electronics BESPOKE Countertop Dishwasher 6-person, White, DW30CB300CW0 (White) Purchase date: 2024.11.10 Installation date: 2024.11.12 Delivery and packaging status - Delivery/on-site installation 2 days after ordering via rocket delivery - Good delivery condition - The product is packed in a box with no tears or damage. Reason for purchase I had knee surgery in an accident and had difficulty sitting and standing, so I bought a robot vacuum cleaner for the first time and used it, and I ended up taking care of each of my three aunts. After the robot vacuum cleaner, I compared the prices of clothes dryers and finally dishwashers for about 3 weeks and ended up buying it on Coupang. I feel so good because I bought it cheaply ^^ Product description (Source: Coupang) Automatic door opening drying that reduces worries about water stains and water spots The finish of clean dishes is a clean dry! When all washing processes are finished, the door automatically opens to allow internal and external air to circulate, leaving a fluffy finish. High-temperature direct water safely washes even baby bottles High-temperature direct water and long, powerful lower blades and double water streams from the upper wings cleanly wash the dishes, and you can wash them satisfactorily by adding detergent and rinse at the exact time. BESPOKE design for a kitchen interior that suits me The BESPOKE dishwasher countertop in white and beige goes well with various kitchens, creating a neat kitchen interior. Various customized courses, options You can combine the desired courses and options according to your taste, and the course memory function conveniently saves you the need to reselect the most recently used course. You can also select various washing courses depending on the degree of contamination of the dishes. Purchase reviews and overall ratings Advantages Convenience is both first and second place~ It's the most convenient in the world. How much is the electricity and water bill? I'm just going to spin it around like crazy. ^^ It was washed more thoroughly than I thought. The button operation was much easier than a drum washing machine. The function to stop it during operation and add more was also convenient. The hardened mozzarella cheese on the plate wasn't washed well, but the rest was washed really well. Water bill savings I run it twice, once in the morning before work and once in the evening before going to bed, and it seems like less water is used than I thought. I use a lot of water when I wash dishes by hand, so I think the water bill will be greatly reduced. Design & color It's a neat square with a glass coating. However, the color is not a bright white, but a white with light gray. This part was disappointing. The installer was also kind. I'm 200% satisfied with the installation. After making an installation date reservation, they sent me text messages to carefully inform me of the installation date, time, and precautions before installation. They said they would remove the water purifier and move it again after installation, so they left the hose long enough. When I moved, they gave me a rubber thing to block the hole they made when installing. They also gave me a cute mini washing machine detergent ^^ It took about 30 minutes to install (it was the same time I was told). After installation, they kindly told me not only how to use it, but also what I was curious about. Disadvantages Automatic door opening drying that reduces worries about water stains and water spots The finishing touch to clean dishes is a clean dry! After all the washing processes are finished, the door automatically opens to circulate the air inside and outside, and it is a little lacking that it is finished fluffy. It is true that the door opens automatically after washing, but the moisture remains. Since the moisture dries over time, I am an office worker, so when I leave for work, it is completely dry, but if I use it right after washing, I have to wipe the moisture separately. Other than that, I had no disadvantages. Willing to repurchase) It is the best. If I buy a new one after using it for a long time, I will buy Samsung again! Thank you for reading the long article.
