Reason for purchase I had knee surgery in an accident and had difficulty sitting and standing, so I bought a robot vacuum cleaner for the first time and used it, and I ended up taking care of each of my three aunts. After the robot vacuum cleaner, I compared the prices of clothes dryers and finally dishwashers for about 3 weeks and ended up buying it on Coupang. I feel so good because I bought it cheaply ^^ Product description (Source: Coupang) Automatic door opening drying that reduces worries about water stains and water spots The finish of clean dishes is a clean dry! When all washing processes are finished, the door automatically opens to allow internal and external air to circulate, leaving a fluffy finish. High-temperature direct water safely washes even baby bottles High-temperature direct water and long, powerful lower blades and double water streams from the upper wings cleanly wash the dishes, and you can wash them satisfactorily by adding detergent and rinse at the exact time. BESPOKE design for a kitchen interior that suits me The BESPOKE dishwasher countertop in white and beige goes well with various kitchens, creating a neat kitchen interior. Various customized courses, options You can combine the desired courses and options according to your taste, and the course memory function conveniently saves you the need to reselect the most recently used course. You can also select various washing courses depending on the degree of contamination of the dishes. Purchase reviews and overall ratings Advantages Convenience is both first and second place~ It's the most convenient in the world. How much is the electricity and water bill? I'm just going to spin it around like crazy. ^^ It was washed more thoroughly than I thought. The button operation was much easier than a drum washing machine. The function to stop it during operation and add more was also convenient. The hardened mozzarella cheese on the plate wasn't washed well, but the rest was washed really well. Water bill savings I run it twice, once in the morning before work and once in the evening before going to bed, and it seems like less water is used than I thought. I use a lot of water when I wash dishes by hand, so I think the water bill will be greatly reduced. Design & color It's a neat square with a glass coating. However, the color is not a bright white, but a white with light gray. This part was disappointing. The installer was also kind. I'm 200% satisfied with the installation. After making an installation date reservation, they sent me text messages to carefully inform me of the installation date, time, and precautions before installation. They said they would remove the water purifier and move it again after installation, so they left the hose long enough. When I moved, they gave me a rubber thing to block the hole they made when installing. They also gave me a cute mini washing machine detergent ^^ It took about 30 minutes to install (it was the same time I was told). After installation, they kindly told me not only how to use it, but also what I was curious about. Disadvantages Automatic door opening drying that reduces worries about water stains and water spots The finishing touch to clean dishes is a clean dry! After all the washing processes are finished, the door automatically opens to circulate the air inside and outside, and it is a little lacking that it is finished fluffy. It is true that the door opens automatically after washing, but the moisture remains. Since the moisture dries over time, I am an office worker, so when I leave for work, it is completely dry, but if I use it right after washing, I have to wipe the moisture separately. Other than that, I had no disadvantages. Willing to repurchase) It is the best. If I buy a new one after using it for a long time, I will buy Samsung again! Thank you for reading the long article. Reason for purchase I had knee surgery in an accident and had difficulty sitting and standing, so I bought a robot vacuum cleaner for the first time and used it, and I ended up taking care of each of my three aunts. After the robot vacuum cleaner, I compared the prices of clothes dryers and finally dishwashers for about 3 weeks and ended up buying it on Coupang. I feel so good because I bought it cheaply ^^ Product description (Source: Coupang) Automatic door opening drying that reduces worries about water stains and water spots The finish of clean dishes is a clean dry! When all washing processes are finished, the door automatically opens to allow internal and external air to circulate, leaving a fluffy finish. High-temperature direct water safely washes even baby bottles High-temperature direct water and long, powerful lower blades and double water streams from the upper wings cleanly wash the dishes, and you can wash them satisfactorily by adding detergent and rinse at the exact time. BESPOKE design for a kitchen interior that suits me The BESPOKE dishwasher countertop in white and beige goes well with various kitchens, creating a neat kitchen interior. Various customized courses, options You can combine the desired courses and options according to your taste, and the course memory function conveniently saves you the need to reselect the most recently used course. You can also select various washing courses depending on the degree of contamination of the dishes. Purchase reviews and overall ratings Advantages Convenience is both first and second place~ It's the most convenient in the world. How much is the electricity and water bill? I'm just going to spin it around like crazy. ^^ It was washed more thoroughly than I thought. The button operation was much easier than a drum washing machine. The function to stop it during operation and add more was also convenient. The hardened mozzarella cheese on the plate wasn't washed well, but the rest was washed really well. Water bill savings I run it twice, once in the morning before work and once in the evening before going to bed, and it seems like less water is used than I thought. I use a lot of water when I wash dishes by hand, so I think the water bill will be greatly reduced. Design & color It's a neat square with a glass coating. However, the color is not a bright white, but a white with light gray. This part was disappointing. The installer was also kind. I'm 200% satisfied with the installation. After making an installation date reservation, they sent me text messages to carefully inform me of the installation date, time, and precautions before installation. They said they would remove the water purifier and move it again after installation, so they left the hose long enough. When I moved, they gave me a rubber thing to block the hole they made when installing. They also gave me a cute mini washing machine detergent ^^ It took about 30 minutes to install (it was the same time I was told). After installation, they kindly told me not only how to use it, but also what I was curious about. Disadvantages Automatic door opening drying that reduces worries about water stains and water spots The finishing touch to clean dishes is a clean dry! After all the washing processes are finished, the door automatically opens to circulate the air inside and outside, and it is a little lacking that it is finished fluffy. It is true that the door opens automatically after washing, but the moisture remains. Since the moisture dries over time, I am an office worker, so when I leave for work, it is completely dry, but if I use it right after washing, I have to wipe the moisture separately. Other than that, I had no disadvantages. Willing to repurchase) It is the best. If I buy a new one after using it for a long time, I will buy Samsung again! Thank you for reading the long article. Reason for purchase I had knee surgery in an accident and had difficulty sitting and standing, so I bought a robot vacuum cleaner for the first time and used it, and I ended up taking care of each of my three aunts. After the robot vacuum cleaner, I compared the prices of clothes dryers and finally dishwashers for about 3 weeks and ended up buying it on Coupang. I feel so good because I bought it cheaply ^^ Product description (Source: Coupang) Automatic door opening drying that reduces worries about water stains and water spots The finish of clean dishes is a clean dry! When all washing processes are finished, the door automatically opens to allow internal and external air to circulate, leaving a fluffy finish. High-temperature direct water safely washes even baby bottles High-temperature direct water and long, powerful lower blades and double water streams from the upper wings cleanly wash the dishes, and you can wash them satisfactorily by adding detergent and rinse at the exact time. BESPOKE design for a kitchen interior that suits me The BESPOKE dishwasher countertop in white and beige goes well with various kitchens, creating a neat kitchen interior. Various customized courses, options You can combine the desired courses and options according to your taste, and the course memory function conveniently saves you the need to reselect the most recently used course. You can also select various washing courses depending on the degree of contamination of the dishes. Purchase reviews and overall ratings Advantages Convenience is both first and second place~ It's the most convenient in the world. How much is the electricity and water bill? I'm just going to spin it around like crazy. ^^ It was washed more thoroughly than I thought. The button operation was much easier than a drum washing machine. The function to stop it during operation and add more was also convenient. The hardened mozzarella cheese on the plate wasn't washed well, but the rest was washed really well. Water bill savings I run it twice, once in the morning before work and once in the evening before going to bed, and it seems like less water is used than I thought. I use a lot of water when I wash dishes by hand, so I think the water bill will be greatly reduced. Design & color It's a neat square with a glass coating. However, the color is not a bright white, but a white with light gray. This part was disappointing. The installer was also kind. I'm 200% satisfied with the installation. After making an installation date reservation, they sent me text messages to carefully inform me of the installation date, time, and precautions before installation. They said they would remove the water purifier and move it again after installation, so they left the hose long enough. When I moved, they gave me a rubber thing to block the hole they made when installing. They also gave me a cute mini washing machine detergent ^^ It took about 30 minutes to install (it was the same time I was told). After installation, they kindly told me not only how to use it, but also what I was curious about. Disadvantages Automatic door opening drying that reduces worries about water stains and water spots The finishing touch to clean dishes is a clean dry! After all the washing processes are finished, the door automatically opens to circulate the air inside and outside, and it is a little lacking that it is finished fluffy. It is true that the door opens automatically after washing, but the moisture remains. Since the moisture dries over time, I am an office worker, so when I leave for work, it is completely dry, but if I use it right after washing, I have to wipe the moisture separately. Other than that, I had no disadvantages. Willing to repurchase) It is the best. If I buy a new one after using it for a long time, I will buy Samsung again! Thank you for reading the long article. Product name: Samsung Electronics BESPOKE Countertop Dishwasher 6-person, White, DW30CB300CW0 (White) Purchase date: 2024.11.10 Installation date: 2024.11.12 Delivery and packaging status - Delivery/on-site installation 2 days after ordering via rocket delivery - Good delivery condition - The product is packed in a box with no tears or damage. Reason for purchase I had knee surgery in an accident and had difficulty sitting and standing, so I bought a robot vacuum cleaner for the first time and used it, and I ended up taking care of each of my three aunts. After the robot vacuum cleaner, I compared the prices of clothes dryers and finally dishwashers for about 3 weeks and ended up buying it on Coupang. I feel so good because I bought it cheaply ^^ Product description (Source: Coupang) Automatic door opening drying that reduces worries about water stains and water spots The finish of clean dishes is a clean dry! When all washing processes are finished, the door automatically opens to allow internal and external air to circulate, leaving a fluffy finish. High-temperature direct water safely washes even baby bottles High-temperature direct water and long, powerful lower blades and double water streams from the upper wings cleanly wash the dishes, and you can wash them satisfactorily by adding detergent and rinse at the exact time. BESPOKE design for a kitchen interior that suits me The BESPOKE dishwasher countertop in white and beige goes well with various kitchens, creating a neat kitchen interior. Various customized courses, options You can combine the desired courses and options according to your taste, and the course memory function conveniently saves you the need to reselect the most recently used course. You can also select various washing courses depending on the degree of contamination of the dishes. Purchase reviews and overall ratings Advantages Convenience is both first and second place~ It's the most convenient in the world. How much is the electricity and water bill? I'm just going to spin it around like crazy. ^^ It was washed more thoroughly than I thought. The button operation was much easier than a drum washing machine. The function to stop it during operation and add more was also convenient. The hardened mozzarella cheese on the plate wasn't washed well, but the rest was washed really well. Water bill savings I run it twice, once in the morning before work and once in the evening before going to bed, and it seems like less water is used than I thought. I use a lot of water when I wash dishes by hand, so I think the water bill will be greatly reduced. Design & color It's a neat square with a glass coating. However, the color is not a bright white, but a white with light gray. This part was disappointing. The installer was also kind. I'm 200% satisfied with the installation. After making an installation date reservation, they sent me text messages to carefully inform me of the installation date, time, and precautions before installation. They said they would remove the water purifier and move it again after installation, so they left the hose long enough. When I moved, they gave me a rubber thing to block the hole they made when installing. They also gave me a cute mini washing machine detergent ^^ It took about 30 minutes to install (it was the same time I was told). After installation, they kindly told me not only how to use it, but also what I was curious about. Disadvantages Automatic door opening drying that reduces worries about water stains and water spots The finishing touch to clean dishes is a clean dry! After all the washing processes are finished, the door automatically opens to circulate the air inside and outside, and it is a little lacking that it is finished fluffy. It is true that the door opens automatically after washing, but the moisture remains. Since the moisture dries over time, I am an office worker, so when I leave for work, it is completely dry, but if I use it right after washing, I have to wipe the moisture separately. Other than that, I had no disadvantages. Willing to repurchase) It is the best. If I buy a new one after using it for a long time, I will buy Samsung again! Thank you for reading the long article. Reason for purchase I had knee surgery in an accident and had difficulty sitting and standing, so I bought a robot vacuum cleaner for the first time and used it, and I ended up taking care of each of my three aunts. After the robot vacuum cleaner, I compared the prices of clothes dryers and finally dishwashers for about 3 weeks and ended up buying it on Coupang. I feel so good because I bought it cheaply ^^ Product description (Source: Coupang) Automatic door opening drying that reduces worries about water stains and water spots The finish of clean dishes is a clean dry! When all washing processes are finished, the door automatically opens to allow internal and external air to circulate, leaving a fluffy finish. High-temperature direct water safely washes even baby bottles High-temperature direct water and long, powerful lower blades and double water streams from the upper wings cleanly wash the dishes, and you can wash them satisfactorily by adding detergent and rinse at the exact time. BESPOKE design for a kitchen interior that suits me The BESPOKE dishwasher countertop in white and beige goes well with various kitchens, creating a neat kitchen interior. Various customized courses, options You can combine the desired courses and options according to your taste, and the course memory function conveniently saves you the need to reselect the most recently used course. You can also select various washing courses depending on the degree of contamination of the dishes. Purchase reviews and overall ratings Advantages Convenience is both first and second place~ It's the most convenient in the world. How much is the electricity and water bill? I'm just going to spin it around like crazy. ^^ It was washed more thoroughly than I thought. The button operation was much easier than a drum washing machine. The function to stop it during operation and add more was also convenient. The hardened mozzarella cheese on the plate wasn't washed well, but the rest was washed really well. Water bill savings I run it twice, once in the morning before work and once in the evening before going to bed, and it seems like less water is used than I thought. I use a lot of water when I wash dishes by hand, so I think the water bill will be greatly reduced. Design & color It's a neat square with a glass coating. However, the color is not a bright white, but a white with light gray. This part was disappointing. The installer was also kind. I'm 200% satisfied with the installation. After making an installation date reservation, they sent me text messages to carefully inform me of the installation date, time, and precautions before installation. They said they would remove the water purifier and move it again after installation, so they left the hose long enough. When I moved, they gave me a rubber thing to block the hole they made when installing. They also gave me a cute mini washing machine detergent ^^ It took about 30 minutes to install (it was the same time I was told). After installation, they kindly told me not only how to use it, but also what I was curious about. Disadvantages Automatic door opening drying that reduces worries about water stains and water spots The finishing touch to clean dishes is a clean dry! After all the washing processes are finished, the door automatically opens to circulate the air inside and outside, and it is a little lacking that it is finished fluffy. It is true that the door opens automatically after washing, but the moisture remains. Since the moisture dries over time, I am an office worker, so when I leave for work, it is completely dry, but if I use it right after washing, I have to wipe the moisture separately. Other than that, I had no disadvantages. Willing to repurchase) It is the best. If I buy a new one after using it for a long time, I will buy Samsung again! Thank you for reading the long article. Reason for purchase I had knee surgery in an accident and had difficulty sitting and standing, so I bought a robot vacuum cleaner for the first time and used it, and I ended up taking care of each of my three aunts. When all washing processes are finished, the door automatically opens to allow internal and external air to circulate, leaving a fluffy finish. High-temperature direct water safely washes even baby bottles High-temperature direct water and long, powerful lower blades and double water streams from the upper wings cleanly wash the dishes, and you can wash them satisfactorily by adding detergent and rinse at the exact time. BESPOKE design for a kitchen interior that suits me The BESPOKE dishwasher countertop in white and beige goes well with various kitchens, creating a neat kitchen interior. Various customized courses, options You can combine the desired courses and options according to your taste, and the course memory function conveniently saves you the need to reselect the most recently used course. You can also select various washing courses depending on the degree of contamination of the dishes. Purchase reviews and overall ratings Advantages Convenience is both first and second place~ It's the most convenient in the world. How much is the electricity and water bill? I'm just going to spin it around like crazy. ^^ It was washed more thoroughly than I thought. The button operation was much easier than a drum washing machine. The function to stop it during operation and add more was also convenient. The hardened mozzarella cheese on the plate wasn't washed well, but the rest was washed really well. Water bill savings I run it twice, once in the morning before work and once in the evening before going to bed, and it seems like less water is used than I thought. I use a lot of water when I wash dishes by hand, so I think the water bill will be greatly reduced. Design & color It's a neat square with a glass coating. However, the color is not a bright white, but a white with light gray. This part was disappointing. The installer was also kind. I'm 200% satisfied with the installation. After making an installation date reservation, they sent me text messages to carefully inform me of the installation date, time, and precautions before installation. They said they would remove the water purifier and move it again after installation, so they left the hose long enough. When I moved, they gave me a rubber thing to block the hole they made when installing. They also gave me a cute mini washing machine detergent ^^ It took about 30 minutes to install (it was the same time I was told). After installation, they kindly told me not only how to use it, but also what I was curious about. Disadvantages Automatic door opening drying that reduces worries about water stains and water spots The finishing touch to clean dishes is a clean dry! After all the washing processes are finished, the door automatically opens to circulate the air inside and outside, and it is a little lacking that it is finished fluffy. It is true that the door opens automatically after washing, but the moisture remains. Since the moisture dries over time, I am an office worker, so when I leave for work, it is completely dry, but if I use it right after washing, I have to wipe the moisture separately. Other than that, I had no disadvantages. Willing to repurchase) It is the best. If I buy a new one after using it for a long time, I will buy Samsung again! Thank you for reading the long article. Reason for purchase I had knee surgery in an accident and had difficulty sitting and standing, so I bought a robot vacuum cleaner for the first time and used it, and I ended up taking care of each of my three aunts. After the robot vacuum cleaner, I compared the prices of clothes dryers and finally dishwashers for about 3 weeks and ended up buying it on Coupang. I feel so good because I bought it cheaply ^^ Product description (Source: Coupang) Automatic door opening drying that reduces worries about water stains and water spots The finish of clean dishes is a clean dry! When all washing processes are finished, the door automatically opens to allow internal and external air to circulate, leaving a fluffy finish. High-temperature direct water safely washes even baby bottles High-temperature direct water and long, powerful lower blades and double water streams from the upper wings cleanly wash the dishes, and you can wash them satisfactorily by adding detergent and rinse at the exact time. BESPOKE design for a kitchen interior that suits me The BESPOKE dishwasher countertop in white and beige goes well with various kitchens, creating a neat kitchen interior. Various customized courses, options You can combine the desired courses and options according to your taste, and the course memory function conveniently saves you the need to reselect the most recently used course. You can also select various washing courses depending on the degree of contamination of the dishes. Purchase reviews and overall ratings Advantages Convenience is both first and second place~ It's the most convenient in the world. How much is the electricity and water bill? I'm just going to spin it around like crazy. ^^ It was washed more thoroughly than I thought. The button operation was much easier than a drum washing machine. The function to stop it during operation and add more was also convenient. The hardened mozzarella cheese on the plate wasn't washed well, but the rest was washed really well. Water bill savings I run it twice, once in the morning before work and once in the evening before going to bed, and it seems like less water is used than I thought. I use a lot of water when I wash dishes by hand, so I think the water bill will be greatly reduced. Design & color It's a neat square with a glass coating. However, the color is not a bright white, but a white with light gray. This part was disappointing. The installer was also kind. I'm 200% satisfied with the installation. After making an installation date reservation, they sent me text messages to carefully inform me of the installation date, time, and precautions before installation. They said they would remove the water purifier and move it again after installation, so they left the hose long enough. When I moved, they gave me a rubber thing to block the hole they made when installing. They also gave me a cute mini washing machine detergent ^^ It took about 30 minutes to install (it was the same time I was told). After installation, they kindly told me not only how to use it, but also what I was curious about. Disadvantages Automatic door opening drying that reduces worries about water stains and water spots The finishing touch to clean dishes is a clean dry! After all the washing processes are finished, the door automatically opens to circulate the air inside and outside, and it is a little lacking that it is finished fluffy. It is true that the door opens automatically after washing, but the moisture remains. Since the moisture dries over time, I am an office worker, so when I leave for work, it is completely dry, but if I use it right after washing, I have to wipe the moisture separately. Other than that, I had no disadvantages. Willing to repurchase) It is the best. If I buy a new one after using it for a long time, I will buy Samsung again! Thank you for reading the long article. Reason for purchase I had knee surgery in an accident and had difficulty sitting and standing, so I bought a robot vacuum cleaner for the first time and used it, and I ended up taking care of each of my three aunts. After the robot vacuum cleaner, I compared the prices of clothes dryers and finally dishwashers for about 3 weeks and ended up buying it on Coupang. I feel so good because I bought it cheaply ^^ Product description (Source: Coupang) Automatic door opening drying that reduces worries about water stains and water spots The finish of clean dishes is a clean dry! When all washing processes are finished, the door automatically opens to allow internal and external air to circulate, leaving a fluffy finish. High-temperature direct water safely washes even baby bottles High-temperature direct water and long, powerful lower blades and double water streams from the upper wings cleanly wash the dishes, and you can wash them satisfactorily by adding detergent and rinse at the exact time. BESPOKE design for a kitchen interior that suits me The BESPOKE dishwasher countertop in white and beige goes well with various kitchens, creating a neat kitchen interior. Various customized courses, options You can combine the desired courses and options according to your taste, and the course memory function conveniently saves you the need to reselect the most recently used course. You can also select various washing courses depending on the degree of contamination of the dishes. Purchase reviews and overall ratings Advantages Convenience is both first and second place~ It's the most convenient in the world. How much is the electricity and water bill? I'm just going to spin it around like crazy. ^^ It was washed more thoroughly than I thought. The button operation was much easier than a drum washing machine. The function to stop it during operation and add more was also convenient. The hardened mozzarella cheese on the plate wasn't washed well, but the rest was washed really well. Water bill savings I run it twice, once in the morning before work and once in the evening before going to bed, and it seems like less water is used than I thought. I use a lot of water when I wash dishes by hand, so I think the water bill will be greatly reduced. Design & color It's a neat square with a glass coating. However, the color is not a bright white, but a white with light gray. This part was disappointing. The installer was also kind. I'm 200% satisfied with the installation. After making an installation date reservation, they sent me text messages to carefully inform me of the installation date, time, and precautions before installation. They said they would remove the water purifier and move it again after installation, so they left the hose long enough. When I moved, they gave me a rubber thing to block the hole they made when installing. They also gave me a cute mini washing machine detergent ^^ It took about 30 minutes to install (it was the same time I was told). After installation, they kindly told me not only how to use it, but also what I was curious about. Disadvantages Automatic door opening drying that reduces worries about water stains and water spots The finishing touch to clean dishes is a clean dry! After all the washing processes are finished, the door automatically opens to circulate the air inside and outside, and it is a little lacking that it is finished fluffy. It is true that the door opens automatically after washing, but the moisture remains. Since the moisture dries over time, I am an office worker, so when I leave for work, it is completely dry, but if I use it right after washing, I have to wipe the moisture separately. Other than that, I had no disadvantages. Willing to repurchase) It is the best. If I buy a new one after using it for a long time, I will buy Samsung again! Thank you for reading the long article. Various customized courses, options You can combine the desired courses and options according to your taste, and the course memory function conveniently saves you the need to reselect the most recently used course. You can also select various washing courses depending on the degree of contamination of the dishes. Purchase reviews and overall ratings Advantages Convenience is both first and second place~ It's the most convenient in the world. How much is the electricity and water bill? I'm just going to spin it around like crazy. ^^ It was washed more thoroughly than I thought. The button operation was much easier than a drum washing machine. The function to stop it during operation and add more was also convenient. The hardened mozzarella cheese on the plate wasn't washed well, but the rest was washed really well. Water bill savings I run it twice, once in the morning before work and once in the evening before going to bed, and it seems like less water is used than I thought. After making an installation date reservation, they sent me text messages to carefully inform me of the installation date, time, and precautions before installation. They said they would remove the water purifier and move it again after installation, so they left the hose long enough. When I moved, they gave me a rubber thing to block the hole they made when installing. They also gave me a cute mini washing machine detergent ^^ It took about 30 minutes to install (it was the same time I was told). After installation, they kindly told me not only how to use it, but also what I was curious about. Disadvantages Automatic door opening drying that reduces worries about water stains and water spots The finishing touch to clean dishes is a clean dry! After all the washing processes are finished, the door automatically opens to circulate the air inside and outside, and it is a little lacking that it is finished fluffy. It is true that the door opens automatically after washing, but the moisture remains. Since the moisture dries over time, I am an office worker, so when I leave for work, it is completely dry, but if I use it right after washing, I have to wipe the moisture separately. Other than that, I had no disadvantages. Willing to repurchase) It is the best. If I buy a new one after using it for a long time, I will buy Samsung again! Thank you for reading the long article. Product name: Samsung Electronics BESPOKE Countertop Dishwasher 6-person, White, DW30CB300CW0 (White) Purchase date: 2024.11.10 Installation date: 2024.11.12 Delivery and packaging status - Delivery/on-site installation 2 days after ordering via rocket delivery - Good delivery condition - The product is packed in a box with no tears or damage. Reason for purchase I had knee surgery in an accident and had difficulty sitting and standing, so I bought a robot vacuum cleaner for the first time and used it, and I ended up taking care of each of my three aunts. After the robot vacuum cleaner, I compared the prices of clothes dryers and finally dishwashers for about 3 weeks and ended up buying it on Coupang. I feel so good because I bought it cheaply ^^ Product description (Source: Coupang) Automatic door opening drying that reduces worries about water stains and water spots The finish of clean dishes is a clean dry! When all washing processes are finished, the door automatically opens to allow internal and external air to circulate, leaving a fluffy finish. High-temperature direct water safely washes even baby bottles High-temperature direct water and long, powerful lower blades and double water streams from the upper wings cleanly wash the dishes, and you can wash them satisfactorily by adding detergent and rinse at the exact time. BESPOKE design for a kitchen interior that suits me The BESPOKE dishwasher countertop in white and beige goes well with various kitchens, creating a neat kitchen interior. Various customized courses, options You can combine the desired courses and options according to your taste, and the course memory function conveniently saves you the need to reselect the most recently used course. You can also select various washing courses depending on the degree of contamination of the dishes. Purchase reviews and overall ratings Advantages Convenience is both first and second place~ It's the most convenient in the world. How much is the electricity and water bill? I'm just going to spin it around like crazy. ^^ It was washed more thoroughly than I thought. The button operation was much easier than a drum washing machine. The function to stop it during operation and add more was also convenient. The hardened mozzarella cheese on the plate wasn't washed well, but the rest was washed really well. Water bill savings I run it twice, once in the morning before work and once in the evening before going to bed, and it seems like less water is used than I thought. I use a lot of water when I wash dishes by hand, so I think the water bill will be greatly reduced. Design & color It's a neat square with a glass coating. However, the color is not a bright white, but a white with light gray. This part was disappointing. The installer was also kind. I'm 200% satisfied with the installation. After making an installation date reservation, they sent me text messages to carefully inform me of the installation date, time, and precautions before installation. They said they would remove the water purifier and move it again after installation, so they left the hose long enough. When I moved, they gave me a rubber thing to block the hole they made when installing. They also gave me a cute mini washing machine detergent ^^ It took about 30 minutes to install (it was the same time I was told). After installation, they kindly told me not only how to use it, but also what I was curious about. Disadvantages Automatic door opening drying that reduces worries about water stains and water spots The finishing touch to clean dishes is a clean dry! After all the washing processes are finished, the door automatically opens to circulate the air inside and outside, and it is a little lacking that it is finished fluffy. It is true that the door opens automatically after washing, but the moisture remains. Since the moisture dries over time, I am an office worker, so when I leave for work, it is completely dry, but if I use it right after washing, I have to wipe the moisture separately. Other than that, I had no disadvantages. Willing to repurchase) It is the best. If I buy a new one after using it for a long time, I will buy Samsung again! Thank you for reading the long article. Product name: Samsung Electronics BESPOKE Countertop Dishwasher 6-person, White, DW30CB300CW0 (White) Purchase date: 2024.11.10 Installation date: 2024.11.12 Delivery and packaging status - Delivery/on-site installation 2 days after ordering via rocket delivery - Good delivery condition - The product is packed in a box with no tears or damage. Reason for purchase I had knee surgery in an accident and had difficulty sitting and standing, so I bought a robot vacuum cleaner for the first time and used it, and I ended up taking care of each of my three aunts. After the robot vacuum cleaner, I compared the prices of clothes dryers and finally dishwashers for about 3 weeks and ended up buying it on Coupang. I feel so good because I bought it cheaply ^^ Product description (Source: Coupang) Automatic door opening drying that reduces worries about water stains and water spots The finish of clean dishes is a clean dry! When all washing processes are finished, the door automatically opens to allow internal and external air to circulate, leaving a fluffy finish. High-temperature direct water safely washes even baby bottles High-temperature direct water and long, powerful lower blades and double water streams from the upper wings cleanly wash the dishes, and you can wash them satisfactorily by adding detergent and rinse at the exact time. BESPOKE design for a kitchen interior that suits me The BESPOKE dishwasher countertop in white and beige goes well with various kitchens, creating a neat kitchen interior. Various customized courses, options You can combine the desired courses and options according to your taste, and the course memory function conveniently saves you the need to reselect the most recently used course. You can also select various washing courses depending on the degree of contamination of the dishes. Purchase reviews and overall ratings Advantages Convenience is both first and second place~ It's the most convenient in the world. How much is the electricity and water bill? I'm just going to spin it around like crazy. ^^ It was washed more thoroughly than I thought. The button operation was much easier than a drum washing machine. The function to stop it during operation and add more was also convenient. The hardened mozzarella cheese on the plate wasn't washed well, but the rest was washed really well. Water bill savings I run it twice, once in the morning before work and once in the evening before going to bed, and it seems like less water is used than I thought. I use a lot of water when I wash dishes by hand, so I think the water bill will be greatly reduced. Design & color It's a neat square with a glass coating. However, the color is not a bright white, but a white with light gray. This part was disappointing. The installer was also kind. I'm 200% satisfied with the installation. After making an installation date reservation, they sent me text messages to carefully inform me of the installation date, time, and precautions before installation. They said they would remove the water purifier and move it again after installation, so they left the hose long enough. When I moved, they gave me a rubber thing to block the hole they made when installing. They also gave me a cute mini washing machine detergent ^^ It took about 30 minutes to install (it was the same time I was told). After installation, they kindly told me not only how to use it, but also what I was curious about. Disadvantages Automatic door opening drying that reduces worries about water stains and water spots The finishing touch to clean dishes is a clean dry! After all the washing processes are finished, the door automatically opens to circulate the air inside and outside, and it is a little lacking that it is finished fluffy. It is true that the door opens automatically after washing, but the moisture remains. Since the moisture dries over time, I am an office worker, so when I leave for work, it is completely dry, but if I use it right after washing, I have to wipe the moisture separately. Other than that, I had no disadvantages. Willing to repurchase) It is the best. If I buy a new one after using it for a long time, I will buy Samsung again! Thank you for reading the long article. BESPOKE design for a kitchen interior that suits me The BESPOKE dishwasher countertop in white and beige goes well with various kitchens, creating a neat kitchen interior. Purchase reviews and overall ratings Advantages Convenience is both first and second place~ It's the most convenient in the world. How much is the electricity and water bill? I'm just going to spin it around like crazy. ^^ It was washed more thoroughly than I thought. The button operation was much easier than a drum washing machine. The function to stop it during operation and add more was also convenient. The hardened mozzarella cheese on the plate wasn't washed well, but the rest was washed really well. Water bill savings I run it twice, once in the morning before work and once in the evening before going to bed, and it seems like less water is used than I thought. Disadvantages Automatic door opening drying that reduces worries about water stains and water spots The finishing touch to clean dishes is a clean dry! Reason for purchase I had knee surgery in an accident and had difficulty sitting and standing, so I bought a robot vacuum cleaner for the first time and used it, and I ended up taking care of each of my three aunts. After the robot vacuum cleaner, I compared the prices of clothes dryers and finally dishwashers for about 3 weeks and ended up buying it on Coupang. I feel so good because I bought it cheaply ^^ Product description (Source: Coupang) Automatic door opening drying that reduces worries about water stains and water spots The finish of clean dishes is a clean dry! When all washing processes are finished, the door automatically opens to allow internal and external air to circulate, leaving a fluffy finish. High-temperature direct water safely washes even baby bottles High-temperature direct water and long, powerful lower blades and double water streams from the upper wings cleanly wash the dishes, and you can wash them satisfactorily by adding detergent and rinse at the exact time. BESPOKE design for a kitchen interior that suits me The BESPOKE dishwasher countertop in white and beige goes well with various kitchens, creating a neat kitchen interior. Various customized courses, options You can combine the desired courses and options according to your taste, and the course memory function conveniently saves you the need to reselect the most recently used course. You can also select various washing courses depending on the degree of contamination of the dishes. Purchase reviews and overall ratings Advantages Convenience is both first and second place~ It's the most convenient in the world. How much is the electricity and water bill? I'm just going to spin it around like crazy. ^^ It was washed more thoroughly than I thought. The button operation was much easier than a drum washing machine. The function to stop it during operation and add more was also convenient. The hardened mozzarella cheese on the plate wasn't washed well, but the rest was washed really well. Water bill savings I run it twice, once in the morning before work and once in the evening before going to bed, and it seems like less water is used than I thought. I use a lot of water when I wash dishes by hand, so I think the water bill will be greatly reduced. Design & color It's a neat square with a glass coating. However, the color is not a bright white, but a white with light gray. This part was disappointing. The installer was also kind. I'm 200% satisfied with the installation. After making an installation date reservation, they sent me text messages to carefully inform me of the installation date, time, and precautions before installation. They said they would remove the water purifier and move it again after installation, so they left the hose long enough. When I moved, they gave me a rubber thing to block the hole they made when installing. They also gave me a cute mini washing machine detergent ^^ It took about 30 minutes to install (it was the same time I was told). After installation, they kindly told me not only how to use it, but also what I was curious about. Disadvantages Automatic door opening drying that reduces worries about water stains and water spots The finishing touch to clean dishes is a clean dry! After all the washing processes are finished, the door automatically opens to circulate the air inside and outside, and it is a little lacking that it is finished fluffy. It is true that the door opens automatically after washing, but the moisture remains. Since the moisture dries over time, I am an office worker, so when I leave for work, it is completely dry, but if I use it right after washing, I have to wipe the moisture separately. Other than that, I had no disadvantages. Willing to repurchase) It is the best. If I buy a new one after using it for a long time, I will buy Samsung again! Thank you for reading the long article. BESPOKE design for a kitchen interior that suits me The BESPOKE dishwasher countertop in white and beige goes well with various kitchens, creating a neat kitchen interior. Various customized courses, options You can combine the desired courses and options according to your taste, and the course memory function conveniently saves you the need to reselect the most recently used course. You can also select various washing courses depending on the degree of contamination of the dishes. Purchase reviews and overall ratings Advantages Convenience is both first and second place~ It's the most convenient in the world. How much is the electricity and water bill? I'm just going to spin it around like crazy. ^^ It was washed more thoroughly than I thought. The button operation was much easier than a drum washing machine. The function to stop it during operation and add more was also convenient. The hardened mozzarella cheese on the plate wasn't washed well, but the rest was washed really well. Water bill savings I run it twice, once in the morning before work and once in the evening before going to bed, and it seems like less water is used than I thought. They also gave me a cute mini washing machine detergent ^^ It took about 30 minutes to install (it was the same time I was told). After installation, they kindly told me not only how to use it, but also what I was curious about. Disadvantages Automatic door opening drying that reduces worries about water stains and water spots The finishing touch to clean dishes is a clean dry! It is true that the door opens automatically after washing, but the moisture remains. Since the moisture dries over time, I am an office worker, so when I leave for work, it is completely dry, but if I use it right after washing, I have to wipe the moisture separately. Reason for purchase I had knee surgery in an accident and had difficulty sitting and standing, so I bought a robot vacuum cleaner for the first time and used it, and I ended up taking care of each of my three aunts. After the robot vacuum cleaner, I compared the prices of clothes dryers and finally dishwashers for about 3 weeks and ended up buying it on Coupang. I feel so good because I bought it cheaply ^^ Product description (Source: Coupang) Automatic door opening drying that reduces worries about water stains and water spots The finish of clean dishes is a clean dry! When all washing processes are finished, the door automatically opens to allow internal and external air to circulate, leaving a fluffy finish. High-temperature direct water safely washes even baby bottles High-temperature direct water and long, powerful lower blades and double water streams from the upper wings cleanly wash the dishes, and you can wash them satisfactorily by adding detergent and rinse at the exact time. BESPOKE design for a kitchen interior that suits me The BESPOKE dishwasher countertop in white and beige goes well with various kitchens, creating a neat kitchen interior. Various customized courses, options You can combine the desired courses and options according to your taste, and the course memory function conveniently saves you the need to reselect the most recently used course. You can also select various washing courses depending on the degree of contamination of the dishes. Purchase reviews and overall ratings Advantages Convenience is both first and second place~ It's the most convenient in the world. How much is the electricity and water bill? I'm just going to spin it around like crazy. ^^ It was washed more thoroughly than I thought. The button operation was much easier than a drum washing machine. The function to stop it during operation and add more was also convenient. The hardened mozzarella cheese on the plate wasn't washed well, but the rest was washed really well. Water bill savings I run it twice, once in the morning before work and once in the evening before going to bed, and it seems like less water is used than I thought. I use a lot of water when I wash dishes by hand, so I think the water bill will be greatly reduced. Design & color It's a neat square with a glass coating. However, the color is not a bright white, but a white with light gray. This part was disappointing. The installer was also kind. I'm 200% satisfied with the installation. After making an installation date reservation, they sent me text messages to carefully inform me of the installation date, time, and precautions before installation. They said they would remove the water purifier and move it again after installation, so they left the hose long enough. When I moved, they gave me a rubber thing to block the hole they made when installing. They also gave me a cute mini washing machine detergent ^^ It took about 30 minutes to install (it was the same time I was told). After installation, they kindly told me not only how to use it, but also what I was curious about. Disadvantages Automatic door opening drying that reduces worries about water stains and water spots The finishing touch to clean dishes is a clean dry! After all the washing processes are finished, the door automatically opens to circulate the air inside and outside, and it is a little lacking that it is finished fluffy. It is true that the door opens automatically after washing, but the moisture remains. Since the moisture dries over time, I am an office worker, so when I leave for work, it is completely dry, but if I use it right after washing, I have to wipe the moisture separately. Other than that, I had no disadvantages. Willing to repurchase) It is the best. If I buy a new one after using it for a long time, I will buy Samsung again! Thank you for reading the long article. Reason for purchase I had knee surgery in an accident and had difficulty sitting and standing, so I bought a robot vacuum cleaner for the first time and used it, and I ended up taking care of each of my three aunts. After the robot vacuum cleaner, I compared the prices of clothes dryers and finally dishwashers for about 3 weeks and ended up buying it on Coupang. I feel so good because I bought it cheaply ^^ Product description (Source: Coupang) Automatic door opening drying that reduces worries about water stains and water spots The finish of clean dishes is a clean dry! When all washing processes are finished, the door automatically opens to allow internal and external air to circulate, leaving a fluffy finish. High-temperature direct water safely washes even baby bottles High-temperature direct water and long, powerful lower blades and double water streams from the upper wings cleanly wash the dishes, and you can wash them satisfactorily by adding detergent and rinse at the exact time. BESPOKE design for a kitchen interior that suits me The BESPOKE dishwasher countertop in white and beige goes well with various kitchens, creating a neat kitchen interior. Various customized courses, options You can combine the desired courses and options according to your taste, and the course memory function conveniently saves you the need to reselect the most recently used course. You can also select various washing courses depending on the degree of contamination of the dishes. Purchase reviews and overall ratings Advantages Convenience is both first and second place~ It's the most convenient in the world. How much is the electricity and water bill? I'm just going to spin it around like crazy. ^^ It was washed more thoroughly than I thought. The button operation was much easier than a drum washing machine. The function to stop it during operation and add more was also convenient. The hardened mozzarella cheese on the plate wasn't washed well, but the rest was washed really well. Water bill savings I run it twice, once in the morning before work and once in the evening before going to bed, and it seems like less water is used than I thought. I use a lot of water when I wash dishes by hand, so I think the water bill will be greatly reduced. Design & color It's a neat square with a glass coating. However, the color is not a bright white, but a white with light gray. This part was disappointing. The installer was also kind. I'm 200% satisfied with the installation. After making an installation date reservation, they sent me text messages to carefully inform me of the installation date, time, and precautions before installation. They said they would remove the water purifier and move it again after installation, so they left the hose long enough. When I moved, they gave me a rubber thing to block the hole they made when installing. They also gave me a cute mini washing machine detergent ^^ It took about 30 minutes to install (it was the same time I was told). After installation, they kindly told me not only how to use it, but also what I was curious about. Disadvantages Automatic door opening drying that reduces worries about water stains and water spots The finishing touch to clean dishes is a clean dry! After all the washing processes are finished, the door automatically opens to circulate the air inside and outside, and it is a little lacking that it is finished fluffy. It is true that the door opens automatically after washing, but the moisture remains. Since the moisture dries over time, I am an office worker, so when I leave for work, it is completely dry, but if I use it right after washing, I have to wipe the moisture separately. Other than that, I had no disadvantages. Willing to repurchase) It is the best. If I buy a new one after using it for a long time, I will buy Samsung again! Thank you for reading the long article. Product name: Samsung Electronics BESPOKE Countertop Dishwasher 6-person, White, DW30CB300CW0 (White) Purchase date: 2024.11.10 Installation date: 2024.11.12 Delivery and packaging status - Delivery/on-site installation 2 days after ordering via rocket delivery - Good delivery condition - The product is packed in a box with no tears or damage. Reason for purchase I had knee surgery in an accident and had difficulty sitting and standing, so I bought a robot vacuum cleaner for the first time and used it, and I ended up taking care of each of my three aunts. After the robot vacuum cleaner, I compared the prices of clothes dryers and finally dishwashers for about 3 weeks and ended up buying it on Coupang. I feel so good because I bought it cheaply ^^ Product description (Source: Coupang) Automatic door opening drying that reduces worries about water stains and water spots The finish of clean dishes is a clean dry! When all washing processes are finished, the door automatically opens to allow internal and external air to circulate, leaving a fluffy finish. High-temperature direct water safely washes even baby bottles High-temperature direct water and long, powerful lower blades and double water streams from the upper wings cleanly wash the dishes, and you can wash them satisfactorily by adding detergent and rinse at the exact time. BESPOKE design for a kitchen interior that suits me The BESPOKE dishwasher countertop in white and beige goes well with various kitchens, creating a neat kitchen interior. Various customized courses, options You can combine the desired courses and options according to your taste, and the course memory function conveniently saves you the need to reselect the most recently used course. You can also select various washing courses depending on the degree of contamination of the dishes. Purchase reviews and overall ratings Advantages Convenience is both first and second place~ It's the most convenient in the world. How much is the electricity and water bill? I'm just going to spin it around like crazy. ^^ It was washed more thoroughly than I thought. The button operation was much easier than a drum washing machine. The function to stop it during operation and add more was also convenient. The hardened mozzarella cheese on the plate wasn't washed well, but the rest was washed really well. Water bill savings I run it twice, once in the morning before work and once in the evening before going to bed, and it seems like less water is used than I thought. I use a lot of water when I wash dishes by hand, so I think the water bill will be greatly reduced. Design & color It's a neat square with a glass coating. However, the color is not a bright white, but a white with light gray. This part was disappointing. The installer was also kind. I'm 200% satisfied with the installation. After making an installation date reservation, they sent me text messages to carefully inform me of the installation date, time, and precautions before installation. They said they would remove the water purifier and move it again after installation, so they left the hose long enough. When I moved, they gave me a rubber thing to block the hole they made when installing. They also gave me a cute mini washing machine detergent ^^ It took about 30 minutes to install (it was the same time I was told). After installation, they kindly told me not only how to use it, but also what I was curious about. Disadvantages Automatic door opening drying that reduces worries about water stains and water spots The finishing touch to clean dishes is a clean dry! After all the washing processes are finished, the door automatically opens to circulate the air inside and outside, and it is a little lacking that it is finished fluffy. It is true that the door opens automatically after washing, but the moisture remains. Since the moisture dries over time, I am an office worker, so when I leave for work, it is completely dry, but if I use it right after washing, I have to wipe the moisture separately. Other than that, I had no disadvantages. Willing to repurchase) It is the best. If I buy a new one after using it for a long time, I will buy Samsung again! Thank you for reading the long article. Product name: Samsung Electronics BESPOKE Countertop Dishwasher 6-person, White, DW30CB300CW0 (White) Purchase date: 2024.11.10 Installation date: 2024.11.12 Delivery and packaging status - Delivery/on-site installation 2 days after ordering via rocket delivery - Good delivery condition - The product is packed in a box with no tears or damage. Reason for purchase I had knee surgery in an accident and had difficulty sitting and standing, so I bought a robot vacuum cleaner for the first time and used it, and I ended up taking care of each of my three aunts. After the robot vacuum cleaner, I compared the prices of clothes dryers and finally dishwashers for about 3 weeks and ended up buying it on Coupang. I feel so good because I bought it cheaply ^^ Product description (Source: Coupang) Automatic door opening drying that reduces worries about water stains and water spots The finish of clean dishes is a clean dry! When all washing processes are finished, the door automatically opens to allow internal and external air to circulate, leaving a fluffy finish. High-temperature direct water safely washes even baby bottles High-temperature direct water and long, powerful lower blades and double water streams from the upper wings cleanly wash the dishes, and you can wash them satisfactorily by adding detergent and rinse at the exact time. BESPOKE design for a kitchen interior that suits me The BESPOKE dishwasher countertop in white and beige goes well with various kitchens, creating a neat kitchen interior. Various customized courses, options You can combine the desired courses and options according to your taste, and the course memory function conveniently saves you the need to reselect the most recently used course. You can also select various washing courses depending on the degree of contamination of the dishes. Purchase reviews and overall ratings Advantages Convenience is both first and second place~ It's the most convenient in the world. How much is the electricity and water bill? I'm just going to spin it around like crazy. ^^ It was washed more thoroughly than I thought. The button operation was much easier than a drum washing machine. The function to stop it during operation and add more was also convenient. The hardened mozzarella cheese on the plate wasn't washed well, but the rest was washed really well. Water bill savings I run it twice, once in the morning before work and once in the evening before going to bed, and it seems like less water is used than I thought. I use a lot of water when I wash dishes by hand, so I think the water bill will be greatly reduced. Design & color It's a neat square with a glass coating. However, the color is not a bright white, but a white with light gray. This part was disappointing. The installer was also kind. I'm 200% satisfied with the installation. After making an installation date reservation, they sent me text messages to carefully inform me of the installation date, time, and precautions before installation. They said they would remove the water purifier and move it again after installation, so they left the hose long enough. When I moved, they gave me a rubber thing to block the hole they made when installing. They also gave me a cute mini washing machine detergent ^^ It took about 30 minutes to install (it was the same time I was told). After installation, they kindly told me not only how to use it, but also what I was curious about. Disadvantages Automatic door opening drying that reduces worries about water stains and water spots The finishing touch to clean dishes is a clean dry! After all the washing processes are finished, the door automatically opens to circulate the air inside and outside, and it is a little lacking that it is finished fluffy. It is true that the door opens automatically after washing, but the moisture remains. Since the moisture dries over time, I am an office worker, so when I leave for work, it is completely dry, but if I use it right after washing, I have to wipe the moisture separately. Other than that, I had no disadvantages. Willing to repurchase) It is the best. If I buy a new one after using it for a long time, I will buy Samsung again! Thank you for reading the long article. Product name: Samsung Electronics BESPOKE Countertop Dishwasher 6-person, White, DW30CB300CW0 (White) Purchase date: 2024.11.10 Installation date: 2024.11.12 Delivery and packaging status - Delivery/on-site installation 2 days after ordering via rocket delivery - Good delivery condition - The product is packed in a box with no tears or damage. Reason for purchase I had knee surgery in an accident and had difficulty sitting and standing, so I bought a robot vacuum cleaner for the first time and used it, and I ended up taking care of each of my three aunts. After the robot vacuum cleaner, I compared the prices of clothes dryers and finally dishwashers for about 3 weeks and ended up buying it on Coupang. I feel so good because I bought it cheaply ^^ Product description (Source: Coupang) Automatic door opening drying that reduces worries about water stains and water spots The finish of clean dishes is a clean dry! When all washing processes are finished, the door automatically opens to allow internal and external air to circulate, leaving a fluffy finish. High-temperature direct water safely washes even baby bottles High-temperature direct water and long, powerful lower blades and double water streams from the upper wings cleanly wash the dishes, and you can wash them satisfactorily by adding detergent and rinse at the exact time. BESPOKE design for a kitchen interior that suits me The BESPOKE dishwasher countertop in white and beige goes well with various kitchens, creating a neat kitchen interior. Various customized courses, options You can combine the desired courses and options according to your taste, and the course memory function conveniently saves you the need to reselect the most recently used course. You can also select various washing courses depending on the degree of contamination of the dishes. Purchase reviews and overall ratings Advantages Convenience is both first and second place~ It's the most convenient in the world. How much is the electricity and water bill? I'm just going to spin it around like crazy. ^^ It was washed more thoroughly than I thought. The button operation was much easier than a drum washing machine. The function to stop it during operation and add more was also convenient. The hardened mozzarella cheese on the plate wasn't washed well, but the rest was washed really well. Water bill savings I run it twice, once in the morning before work and once in the evening before going to bed, and it seems like less water is used than I thought. I use a lot of water when I wash dishes by hand, so I think the water bill will be greatly reduced. Design & color It's a neat square with a glass coating. However, the color is not a bright white, but a white with light gray. This part was disappointing. The installer was also kind. I'm 200% satisfied with the installation. After making an installation date reservation, they sent me text messages to carefully inform me of the installation date, time, and precautions before installation. They said they would remove the water purifier and move it again after installation, so they left the hose long enough. When I moved, they gave me a rubber thing to block the hole they made when installing. They also gave me a cute mini washing machine detergent ^^ It took about 30 minutes to install (it was the same time I was told). After installation, they kindly told me not only how to use it, but also what I was curious about. Disadvantages Automatic door opening drying that reduces worries about water stains and water spots The finishing touch to clean dishes is a clean dry! After all the washing processes are finished, the door automatically opens to circulate the air inside and outside, and it is a little lacking that it is finished fluffy. It is true that the door opens automatically after washing, but the moisture remains. Since the moisture dries over time, I am an office worker, so when I leave for work, it is completely dry, but if I use it right after washing, I have to wipe the moisture separately. Other than that, I had no disadvantages. Willing to repurchase) It is the best. If I buy a new one after using it for a long time, I will buy Samsung again! Thank you for reading the long article. It didn't have a LCD before, but now that it has a LCD, the pictures are visible and the text is clear, so it's easier and even adults can use it intuitively. Performance is good: I've used most dishwashers, but I've always felt that the performance of dishwashers is the same! I felt that. I tried various functions such as the hot air drying function and the salt function to reduce water stains, but the conclusion was similar. My Dear dishwasher is a company that produces many products in cooperation with other companies. If you look at the manufacturers of domestic dishwasher companies, you will see that My Dear is written on them. If you want something that is faithful to the basic functions, it would be good to just buy and use a My Dear dishwasher! The advantage of the Mydia dishwasher is that it's quiet. Some people wonder how loud a dishwasher can be, but models with less soundproofing tend to make a louder, swoosh-swoosh sound than you might expect. The Mydia is incredibly quiet, making it great for use at night. This dishwasher is freestanding. The difference from built-in models is that it has a cover on the bottom and top. Built-in models have empty bottoms and tops, allowing for a seamless fit with the sink. This model can be placed in the sink by removing the cover, but the sink holder needs to be fixed. Since built-in models aren't available at my house, I always choose freestanding models. I prefer freestanding models because I can place a coffee machine and water purifier on top of the dishwasher, and it's easy to move around. Oh, and I like that built-in models are fixed to the sink with screws, but freestanding models don't. It's spacious enough for 12 people. 12-person is the best. I started with the small one, but in conclusion, I definitely recommend getting the large one. App use: You don't need to use the app for general functions, but if you just need to do a simple pre-wash, you can do it with the app. Once you set it, you can use it continuously, so don't worry. Drying power: It's much improved over the previous drying function. It dries quickly and is good. Since the door is open and the remaining heat is used to dry it, it doesn't dry perfectly, but it becomes fluffy after a while, so I'm satisfied. Overall review: Dishwashers have really changed the quality of life. It saves a lot of water, but you have to clean it thoroughly. Comments (English): [ Disappointed with Cleaning and Drying Ability ] || ---------------- || After researching and reading all the comments, I decided to purchase this dishwasher to replace my Whirlpool dishwasher, which had served me well for 10 years without any problems. Since I was remodeling my kitchen, I opted for all new appliances. Unfortunately, I am really disappointed with this dishwasher. Three months in, and the dishes on the last rack are still not getting clean, which is frustrating. Water remains in the dishwasher even after using the Extra Heat function, making it feel unworthy of the investment. The only positive aspect is that it looks bulky compared to others and operates very quietly. However, I cannot recommend this dishwasher.I've tried various settings and different detergents, but it still does not clean thoroughly or dry properly, leaving water stains all over. The top rack is often filled with water as well. I suspect that many of the positive reviews are promotional and may not reflect the true performance of this appliance.

Comments (English): [ Finally a dishwasher that works ] || ---------------- || After a couple of months of steady use, we love it. The racks are great and easy to adapt to whatever you need to throw in, the cycles are VERY quiet, and it just works. spotless dishes every time. The feature that opens the door once the cycle is done is great. Living in UT, we don't have much humidity, so the dishes are usually very dry by the time we get to them, even shortly after the cycle is done. Plastics are usually wet just due to how the machine works. there's no heating element, the machine depends on the temp differences between the metal insides and the hot dishes to help evaporate and draw off the water at the end of the cycle. So expect to have to towel off plastics and you'll be fine. Dishes and utinsels and pots and pans are bone dry. For this price point we are very satisfied customers so far

I think I will be able to spend leisurely evenings without worrying about washing dishes from now on. I highly recommend the My Dear dishwasher!

Comments (English): [ My quality of life has really changed, I love it! ] || ---------------- || This review was written after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. Everyone says robot vacuums and dishwashers can transform your quality of life, but it's so good I'm wondering, "Why didn't I buy one sooner?" Coupang A/S is also free for 2 years! I trust and use it. One of my favorite things! Overall Review - Pros: Generous capacity, various cleaning cycles, powerful cleaning power, automatic drying function, reliable after-sales service. Sentence (English): Everyone says robot vacuum and dishwashers change the quality of life.
Comments (English): [ My quality of life has really changed, I love it! ] || ---------------- || This review was written after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. Everyone says robot vacuums and dishwashers change the quality of life. It's so good, I'm wondering why I bought it sooner. With just one dishwasher, I've forgotten the word "dishwashing stress." The generous 12-person size is impressive. I initially thought 12 people was too big, but even if I only eat three meals a day, I still have a lot of dishes to wash. It's spacious enough to fit cups, plates, and pots, and I can do everything at once, which is great. Especially on days when I have guests or cook a lot, it's roomy enough to hold everything, making it perfect! It has nine wash cycles. These days, I switch between them depending on the amount of dishes I wash and the level of dirt. After greasy dishes, I use the high-temperature, powerful wash cycle. After a quick breakfast, I use the eco mode! The auto-open feature is especially nice because it removes all the moisture from the inside after the wash, leaving my dishes fluffy and dry. The interior design is incredibly clever. No more worries about layout! At first, I struggled to figure out how to efficiently organize my dishes, but the internal layout is so logical. When you place the plates, bowls, pots, and spoons in their designated spots, everything fits perfectly. It's like playing Tetris. The two-stage spray nozzles on the top and bottom are powerful, thoroughly cleaning every nook and cranny of the dishes. It even clears old chili oil without a problem! Coupang offers a 2-year warranty! I trust it. One of my favorite things about this appliance! Usually, after-sales service is provided by the manufacturer, which is a hassle. But since this is directly managed by Coupang, Coupang handles the after-sales service. The 2-year warranty is a huge plus! You can apply directly through the Coupang app, and they also have a 24/7 call center. The installer was incredibly knowledgeable and friendly. At first, I was worried the dishwasher wouldn't fit, and I even considered cutting the marble in the sink. The friendly technician removed the lid, measured it with a ruler, and said it would fit, and it did, just like a built-in unit. He installed it perfectly! Thanks to him, the installation was so smooth and I'm completely satisfied! Overall Review: Pros: Generous capacity, various wash cycles, powerful cleaning power, automatic drying function, reliable after-sales service. Cons: Make sure you secure enough space for installation! Rating: (5/5)

The generous 12-person size is impressive. I initially thought 12 people was too big, but even if I only eat three meals a day, I still have a lot of dishes to wash. It's spacious enough to fit cups, plates, and pots, and I can do everything at once, which is great. Especially on days when I have guests or cook a lot, it's roomy enough to hold everything, making it perfect! It has nine wash cycles. Thanks to him, the installation was so smooth and I'm completely satisfied! Sentence (English): This review was written after receiving a free product as part of the Coupang Experience Team event.

I love how it reduces the time and effort spent on dishwashing, and the 12-person dishwasher is incredibly functional. I love the clean white design, and the fact that it's 12-person means it can be filled generously. It even fits large pots, so I'm overall satisfied with the product. Pros: Generous 12-person capacity. It's incredibly convenient to be able to wash everything from family dishes to pots after a day's worth of meals all at once. It can be arranged efficiently according to your needs. Excellent cleaning power: The hot water wash and spray method thoroughly remove grease and rice cakes. The dishes are squeaky clean after washing, and they dry cleanly without water stains or odors, significantly reducing the stress of dishwashing. Washing dishes is a daily chore, and it's a waste of time, but having this dishwasher has truly improved my quality of life. Sophisticated White Design: The modern, uncluttered white color blends seamlessly into any kitchen. The simple button layout and intuitive LED display are fantastic. Overall Review: I'm very satisfied with the cleaning power, design, and capacity. I can definitely recommend this dishwasher to families and even those who cook frequently. It's so great that it saves me the hassle of washing dishes every day. And because it's so large, you can fit a lot of dishes in it. Cooking uses a lot of dishes, so they pile up. I used to be hesitant, but now I can just run it through the dishwasher, which is so convenient. I recommend it to anyone looking for a large-capacity dishwasher. I'm satisfied with its functionality. I think it's truly comparable to other models. Of course, I have photos for your reference regarding the design. In my case, because my house is older, I couldn't fit it inside, so I placed it next to the sink. I moved the refrigerator to its original location.

Whenever I help her, I realize just how tiring it can be. I've been thinking about buying her a decent dishwasher someday, and when I received the opportunity to receive the product, I immediately placed my order. While it's a donation, I'll be honest and share my subjective thoughts. Delivery & Installation: It was great that I could receive the product on my preferred day, as it's a rocket-installed product. Plus, I can choose my weekend schedule, which is great for working professionals.
