I had a rough idea of the size, but it was actually larger. In my home, the built-in unit wasn't available (it's the size of a 28-pyeong apartment kitchen), so I left it freestanding. If a built-in unit isn't feasible or you're renting, freestanding is a great option, which is another plus. However, if you're planning on using a built-in unit, I recommend carefully checking the size before ordering. And since it's a very large 12-person unit, you can easily load and unload everything from large frying pans to bowls without having to play Tetris. That's the best part about its large size! The cleaning power exceeded my expectations. It's excellent at cleaning everything from greasy frying pans to glasses and rice bowls in one go. The drying function is also quite powerful. The automatic door opening after washing, which helps remove moisture, was a useful feature. I haven't tried the app integration yet, but I plan to use it soon. I think it's a very useful and essential feature in today's busy lifestyle. Because it's freestanding, I don't have to worry about installation, and both the cleaning and drying capabilities are excellent. As is typical of modern electronics, it also integrates with my smartphone, making it incredibly convenient. I'm planning to use the freestanding unit for a while, but if I ever move, I'll be able to remove it and install it in my new space. All I have to do is connect the water and drain connections, so I think the average adult male shouldn't have much trouble connecting it. Sentence (English): This review was written after receiving a free product as part of the Coupang Experience Team event.
Comments (English): This review was written after receiving a free product as part of the Coupang Experience Team event. It reduces the time and effort spent on dishwashing, and the 12-person dishwasher is incredibly functional. I love the clean white design, and the fact that it's a 12-person dishwasher means it can be filled generously. It even holds large pots, so I'm overall satisfied with the product. Pros: Generous capacity for 12 people. It's incredibly convenient to be able to wash everything from family dishes to pots after a day's worth of meals all at once. It can be organized efficiently according to your needs. Excellent cleaning power. The hot water wash and spray method thoroughly remove grease and rice cakes. The dishes are squeaky clean after washing, and they dry cleanly without water stains or odors, significantly reducing the stress of dishwashing. Washing dishes is a daily chore, and it's a waste of time, but having this dishwasher has truly improved my quality of life. Sophisticated white design. The modern, uncluttered white color blends seamlessly into any kitchen. The simple button layout and intuitive LED display are fantastic. Overall: I'm very satisfied with the cleaning power, design, and capacity. I can definitely recommend this dishwasher to families and even those who cook frequently. It's so great that it saves me the hassle of washing dishes every day. And because it's so large, you can fit a lot of dishes in it. Cooking uses a lot of dishes, so they pile up. I used to be hesitant, but now I can just run it through the dishwasher, which is so convenient. I recommend it to anyone looking for a large-capacity dishwasher. I'm satisfied with its functionality. I think it's truly comparable to other models. Of course, I have photos for your reference regarding the design. In my case, because my house is older, I couldn't fit it inside, so I placed it next to the sink. I moved the refrigerator to its original location.
Comments (Original): 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료 제공받아 작성한 리뷰입니다.설거지에 드는 시간과 수고를 줄이어들고 12인용 제품이 기능이 너무 좋은 것 같아요. 깔끔한 화이트 디자인도 마음에 들고 12인용 이다보니 넉넉하게 채울 수 있다는 점이 너무 좋네요. 큰 냄비도 들어가고 전반적으로 만족스러운 제품이었습니다. 장점넉넉한 12인용 대용량 하루 치 식사를 마친 뒤 쌓인 가족 식기부터 냄비까지 한 번에 세척 가능해 정말 편리합니다. 용도에 따라 효율적으로 배치 가능해요.우수한 세척력고온수 세척과 분사 방식으로 기름기나 밥풀도 말끔히 제거됩니다. 세척 후 식기가 뽀득뽀득하게 마무리되니 물자국이나 냄새 없이 깨끗하게 건조돼서 설거지 스트레스가 확 줄었어요. 이게 설거지를 매일 해야하는 거다보니 정말 하려고 하면 시간도 아깝고 그런데 이게 있으니 정말 삶의 질이 향상되는 걸 느낍니다. 세련된 화이트 디자인모던하고 군더더기 없는 화이트 색상이라 어느 주방에도 자연스럽게 어울립니다. 심플한 버튼 배치와 LED 디스플레이가 직관적이어서 좋네요. 총평세척력, 디자인, 용량 등등 만족스럽게 이용했습니다.  가족 단위는 물론 요리를 자주 하는 분들께도 충분히 추천할 수 있는 성능이며 이게 매일 반복하는 설거지에서 벗어나도 된다는 것이 너무 좋더라고요. 그리고 용량도 크니 많은 걸 넣을 수도 있고 요리를 하다보면 식기를 많이 쓰잖아요. 그래서 너무 많이 쌓이는데 전에는 엄두가 안 났지만 이제는 식기세척기에 돌리면 되니 너무 편하더라고요.  용량 식기세척기를 찾는 분 추천드립니다. 저는 기능적으로는 만족스럽다고 생각합니다. 이정도면 정말 다른 거와 비교해도 손색이 없을 정도로 좋다고 생각하긴 해요. 물론 디자인적인 부분은 사진이 있으니 참고하시면 될 것 같아요. 저 같은 경우 옛날 집이다보니 안에는 못 넣고 싱크대 옆쪽으로 해서 놓았습니다. 기존에 냉장고 있던 자리에 냉장고를 옮기고 놓았네요 ㅎ

If you are a family raising a child, you can feel firsthand how much your quality of life can change with just one dishwasher. We are currently raising a 9-month-old baby, and preparing baby food and washing feeding supplies three times a day was a lot of work. However, since we purchased this product, there has been a huge change. The first advantage that stands out is that it is very energy efficient. Since it is a product with the highest energy efficiency, you can use it with confidence, and you can actually reduce your financial burden by receiving a high-efficiency appliance purchase reward from KEPCO. The estimated annual electricity bill is around 36,000 won, so it is very economical! In addition, you can feel at ease that baby dishes, bottles, and baby food containers are hygienically and cleanly washed thanks to the high-temperature steam cleaning function without having to boil or sterilize them separately. Thanks to the steam mode, you no longer have to worry about water stains or odors. Is there a better parenting item for busy moms and dads? Above all, the quality of life has changed dramatically. I can now spend the time and energy I used to spend on dishwashing on spending time with my baby, and my parenting stress has also decreased a lot. With the burden of cleaning up the dishes after a meal reduced, the whole family can enjoy a leisurely evening. If you are still thinking about buying a dishwasher, don’t hesitate. I highly recommend it, especially if you have a baby in your home!

I think the dividers are shorter? I use to use the bottom silverware/utensil basket ALOT in our old dishwasher, it had 6 baskets. This one only has 3. The last thing is the controls are SO sensitive, we have to be careful not to acidentally brush against them or it will activate. Again, these are things I probably have to get use to. The bottom line is it cleaning is AWESOME! I would buy again and recommend.

Comments (English): [ Awesome Dishwasher - Super Quiet and Cleans Great! ] || ---------------- || Having previously owned several Bosch dishwashers, I was looking forward to installing the latest Bosch product when my 2005 Bosch product finally failed. The product looks great from the outside - sleek, minimalist finish that goes great with my kitchen. On the inside, I probably have 50% larger capacity given the way the unit's shelves are designed. Love the ability to move the second shelf for glass stemware. The unit is soooooo quiet - I often have to press my ear against the door to make sure it's on! And the sanitize and crystal dry features make sure the dishes and glassware are super clean. Once a cycle finished, the plates and flatware are always super hot - I generally allow some time for them to cool down before unloading. As for the app, love the ability to track usage and get notified of cycle completion. The app has the features I need, and is easy enough to use once you get used to where things are. Overall, love my new Bosch dishwasher and can highly recommend it to others looking for a good looking, well performing machine!
